description:
**Talent Acquisition Specialist Intern — Job Description**  
*The Hustler Brands · Graderise Achievers Pvt. Ltd. · Ahmedabad, India (Remote)*

**About the Role**  
The Hustler Brands is a student\-focused career development company running paid workshops, internship programs, and a Campus Ambassador network across India. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist Intern to help us source, screen, and onboard the next batch of interns and Campus Ambassadors as we scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Source candidates for open internship roles (Data Analyst \& Promoter, Campus Ambassador, and other verticals) via LinkedIn, college groups, and referral networks
* Screen applications and resumes against role requirements
* Coordinate and conduct initial screening calls/interviews with shortlisted candidates
* Draft and send offer letters, JD documents, and onboarding communication
* Maintain a candidate tracker — pipeline stage, interview notes, decision status
* Support onboarding of selected interns (WhatsApp group setup, checklist follow\-through, first\-week check\-ins)
* Assist in improving hiring templates, JDs, and screening questions based on what's working

**Who We're Looking For**

* Strong written communication — you'll be drafting messages and documents candidates see first
* Comfortable reaching out to strangers and running structured conversations
* Organized — comfortable maintaining a clean, up\-to\-date tracker with no dropped candidates
* Interested in HR, people ops, or recruitment as a career direction
* No prior HR experience required — this is a learning role

**Working Hours**  
Flexible, remote — expect roughly 1\-2 hours/day, plus a weekly check\-in call. Works around your college schedule.

**What You Get**

* Real recruitment experience — sourcing, screening, and closing candidates, not just paperwork
* Certificate on completion
* Direct mentorship from the founder
* A genuine portfolio piece: your own hiring pipeline, with real placed candidates you can point to

**How to Apply**  
Reply with your resume and one line on why HR/recruitment interests you.

Pay: ₹3,000\.00 \- ₹5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
**Job Description** **Role: Data Operations Analyst**

**Location: Chennai**


Every insight NIQ delivers starts with Operations getting it right.


Behind every report, every market trend, and every business decision our clients make is trusted, high\-quality data. As a Data Operations Analyst, you'll play a key role in making that happen.


Working within NIQ's global Operations function, you'll ensure market data is accurate, complete, and ready for delivery to some of the world's most recognized brands. You'll investigate data issues, validate information, and help maintain the quality standards our clients rely on.


But this role is about more than data quality.


Operations at NIQ is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history. Automation, AI\-enabled workflows, smarter technologies, and digital platforms are reshaping how we work. Rather than replacing human expertise, these technologies enable our teams to focus on critical thinking, solving complex problems, and continuously improving how we deliver value to clients.


From day one, you'll work alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative global environment while developing future\-ready skills in data, technology, automation, and operational excellence.


If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career where technology and human judgement work together, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Do

* Research product information and accurately classify and maintain data within NIQ databases.
* Perform quantitative and qualitative quality checks to ensure market data meets NIQ's global quality standards.
* Manage monthly production activities using NIQ's proprietary platforms, ensuring data is delivered accurately and on time.
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve data issues and exceptions.
* Monitor market developments and understand how they impact data quality.
* Work alongside AI\-enabled tools and automated workflows, applying critical thinking and human judgement to validate outputs and resolve exceptions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Use data and operational insights to identify trends, improve quality, and enhance performance.
* Collaborate with colleagues across global teams to deliver trusted, high\-quality data that supports client decision\-making.


Qualifications

**Bachelor's degree is mandatory to apply for this role.**

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* English proficiency (B1\-B2 level or above).  



**Skills for Success**


We're looking for curious, adaptable people who are excited about learning and solving problems.


You'll thrive in this role if you have:
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and knowledge of Market Research.
* A passion for working with data and solving problems.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and digital tools.
* A growth mindset and willingness to embrace change.
* The ability to work effectively within structured processes while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* A commitment to delivering high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Nice to Have**
* Exposure to data processing or data quality activities.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled technologies or automation tools.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Python, or similar analytical tools.
* Experience improving or documenting operational processes.
* Structured onboarding and comprehensive training from day one.
* Cross\-functional collaboration within a global organisation.
* Commercial awareness and understanding how operational excellence creates value for clients.
* Change and transformation.
* Digital fluency.
* Performance analytics.
* Data\-driven decision\-making.
* Automation and process improvement.
* As Operations continues to evolve, you'll have opportunities to develop capabilities that are increasingly valuable across the industry, including:
* Working confidently alongside AI\-enabled technologies.
* **What You Can Expect**
* Structured onboarding and comprehensive training from day one.
* Cross\-functional collaboration within a global organisation.
* Commercial awareness and understanding how operational excellence creates value for clients.
* Change and transformation.
* Digital fluency.
* Performance analytics.
* Data\-driven decision\-making.
* Automation and process improvement.
* As Operations continues to evolve, you'll have opportunities to develop capabilities that are increasingly valuable across the industry, including:
* Working confidently alongside AI\-enabled technologies.

title: Tender Manager
description:
**5–8 years** of relevant experience in tender management, bid management, proposal management, or IT business development.

Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field**. MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Business Development, or related areas will be an added advantage.

Job Summary

The Tender Manager will be responsible for managing the complete **tender and bid management lifecycle** for IT projects. The role involves identifying relevant tender opportunities, analyzing tender requirements, coordinating with technical, finance, legal, HR, and management teams, preparing compliant technical and commercial proposals, and ensuring timely submission of high\-quality bids.

Key Responsibilities1\. Tender Identification \& Opportunity Management

* Identify and track relevant IT tenders, RFPs, RFQs, EOI, RFI, and government procurement opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals and other sources for new business opportunities.
* Evaluate tender opportunities based on eligibility, scope, commercial viability, technical requirements, and organizational capabilities.
* Maintain a tender opportunity tracker and bid calendar.
* Coordinate internally for **Go/No\-Go** decisions.

2\. Tender Document Analysis

* Review tender/RFP documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, timelines, commercial conditions, and contractual terms.
* Identify mandatory documents, compliance requirements, evaluation criteria, EMD/Bid Security, Performance Bank Guarantee, and other tender conditions.
* Prepare tender requirement checklists and compliance matrices.
* Identify risks, deviations, and clarification requirements before bid submission.

3\. Proposal \& Bid Management

* Lead the preparation and submission of complete technical and commercial bids.
* Coordinate with technical teams for solution design, methodology, architecture, project plans, and technical write\-ups.
* Coordinate with the finance/commercial team for pricing, costing, taxes, and financial proposals.
* Coordinate with legal and management teams for contractual and statutory requirements.
* Prepare executive summaries, covering letters, declarations, undertakings, and other bid documents.
* Ensure all documents comply with tender specifications and prescribed formats.

4\. Team Coordination

* Coordinate with **Business Development, Sales, Technical, Project Management, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Senior Management** teams.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish internal timelines for each tender.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely receipt of required information and documents.
* Conduct internal bid review meetings before submission.

5\. Compliance \& Quality Control

* Ensure 100% compliance with tender eligibility and submission requirements.
* Verify all forms, certificates, declarations, annexures, credentials, and supporting documents.
* Ensure that technical and financial proposals are complete, accurate, consistent, and error\-free.
* Maintain version control and confidentiality of tender documents.
* Ensure bids are submitted within the specified deadline and through the required procurement portal/mode.

6\. Commercial \& Pricing Support

* Work with the finance and management teams to prepare competitive and commercially viable pricing.
* Analyze BOQ, manpower requirements, project costs, licenses, infrastructure, and other cost components.
* Support preparation of financial proposals and price schedules.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis wherever possible.
* Ensure pricing is aligned with tender requirements and organizational margins.

7\. Post\-Bid Activities

* Track tender opening, technical evaluation, commercial evaluation, and award status.
* Respond to clarification requests from clients/tendering authorities.
* Coordinate presentations, demonstrations, technical discussions, and negotiations where required.
* Support contract finalization and handover to the project/delivery team after successful award.
* Maintain records of submitted bids, outcomes, and lessons learned.

Key Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **IT tendering and proposal management**.
* Excellent understanding of RFP, RFI, RFQ, EOI, and government/enterprise procurement processes.
* Strong technical proposal and business writing skills.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good commercial and financial understanding.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work under strict deadlines.
* Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially **Word, Excel, and PowerPoint**.
* Experience with government e\-procurement/tender portals will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT services, software development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and managed services will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of tenders successfully submitted.
* Tender submission accuracy and compliance percentage.
* Timely submission of bids.
* Bid\-to\-win/conversion ratio.
* Value of contracts won.
* Quality of technical and commercial proposals.
* Compliance with tender requirements.
* Timeliness of internal coordination and documentation.
* Reduction in bid errors, omissions, and disqualifications.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in handling tenders for **Government Departments, PSUs, Corporates, Banks, Educational Institutions, Healthcare Organizations, and other large enterprises** will be preferred.

Experience with **GeM, CPPP/e\-Procurement portals, state government tender portals, and other online tendering platforms** will be an added advantage.

title: Assistant Manager - IT
description:
We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Manager – IT** to manage the organization's overall IT infrastructure, systems, applications, network, cybersecurity, end\-user support, and technology operations across the Corporate Office and Project Sites.

The role will be responsible for ensuring **IT availability, security, reliability, business continuity, and effective technology support** to all departments and project locations. The position will also coordinate with internal teams, SAP/ERP teams, software vendors, service providers, and external IT consultants for smooth operation and implementation of IT systems.

Key Responsibilities

1\. IT Infrastructure Management

* Manage the overall IT infrastructure of the Corporate Office and project sites.
* Oversee desktops, laptops, servers, printers, scanners, storage, UPS, and other IT assets.
* Ensure proper installation, configuration, maintenance, and replacement of IT hardware.
* Monitor IT infrastructure performance and availability.
* Plan infrastructure requirements based on business and project requirements.
* Ensure proper backup and recovery arrangements for critical systems.

2\. Network \& Connectivity

* Manage LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and network infrastructure.
* Monitor connectivity between Corporate Office and project sites.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and network vendors for uninterrupted connectivity.
* Manage routers, switches, firewalls, access points, and other network equipment.
* Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues.
* Ensure appropriate network access controls and segregation.

3\. IT Security \& Cybersecurity

* Implement and monitor IT security policies and controls.
* Manage endpoint security, antivirus/EDR, firewall, email security, and access controls.
* Ensure timely security patches and software updates.
* Monitor unauthorized access, suspicious activities, malware, and security incidents.
* Conduct periodic review of user access and privileges.
* Implement appropriate password, access, backup, and data protection practices.
* Conduct employee awareness programs on cybersecurity, phishing, password security, and data protection.
* Coordinate with external cybersecurity consultants where required.

4\. Server \& System Administration

* Coordinate administration and maintenance of Windows/Linux servers and other enterprise systems.
* Monitor server performance, storage, availability, and system health.
* Ensure scheduled backups and periodic restoration testing.
* Coordinate with server, database, and application administrators.
* Maintain system documentation, configurations, licenses, and support details.
* Ensure appropriate disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.

5\. SAP / ERP \& Business Application Coordination

* Coordinate with SAP Basis, functional teams, developers, and external consultants for SAP/ERP availability and support.
* Ensure timely resolution of application\-related issues affecting business operations.
* Coordinate system access, connectivity, interfaces, printing, and infrastructure requirements.
* Support implementation and enhancement of ERP and other business applications.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Procurement, Projects, Sales, CRM, and other departments for application requirements.
* Monitor IT dependencies related to SAP HCM, Finance, Procurement, Sales, and other business functions.

6\. IT Helpdesk \& User Support

* Ensure timely IT support to employees at Corporate Office and project sites.
* Manage IT helpdesk and ticket\-resolution process.
* Establish service\-level standards for IT support.
* Monitor recurring IT issues and implement permanent solutions.
* Support onboarding and exit processes relating to IT assets, email accounts, system access, and user credentials.
* Ensure proper allocation and recovery of IT assets.

7\. IT Asset Management

* Maintain an updated IT asset register covering:
* Desktops
* Laptops
* Servers
* Printers
* Network equipment
* UPS
* Software licenses
* Mobile devices and other IT equipment
* Track asset allocation, movement, repairs, warranty, AMC, and replacement.
* Establish proper asset handover and return procedures.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets.

8\. Email \& Collaboration Systems

* Manage corporate email systems and user accounts.
* Coordinate with email/service providers for technical issues.
* Manage user creation, deletion, access, groups, and permissions.
* Monitor email security, storage, spam, phishing, and availability.
* Support collaboration tools, video conferencing, cloud applications, and productivity platforms.

9\. Software \& License Management

* Maintain an inventory of software applications and licenses.
* Ensure compliance with software licensing requirements.
* Coordinate renewal of software subscriptions and licenses.
* Evaluate software requirements and recommend cost\-effective solutions.
* Prevent unauthorized software installation and usage.

10\. IT Projects \& Digital Transformation

* Lead or coordinate implementation of new IT systems and technology projects.
* Evaluate technology solutions based on business requirements.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, budgets, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate UAT, testing, migration, deployment, and post\-implementation support.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digital transformation.
* Support integration between various business applications wherever required.

11\. Vendor \& AMC Management

* Manage IT vendors, service providers, consultants, and AMC partners.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations for IT hardware, software, infrastructure, and services.
* Monitor vendor performance and SLA compliance.
* Negotiate commercial terms and renewal contracts.
* Ensure timely preventive maintenance and service support.
* Maintain vendor database, contracts, AMC details, warranties, and escalation contacts.

12\. IT Budget \& Cost Control

* Prepare the annual IT budget covering hardware, software, licenses, AMC, connectivity, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT projects.
* Monitor IT expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality.
* Evaluate CAPEX and OPEX requirements.
* Provide management with cost\-benefit analysis for major IT investments.

13\. IT Policies \& Compliance

* Develop and implement IT policies, SOPs, and procedures.
* Establish policies relating to:
* IT security
* Password management
* Internet usage
* Email usage
* Asset management
* Data backup
* Access control
* Software installation
* Remote access
* IT incident management
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, contractual, and organizational requirements.
* Maintain IT audit documentation and support internal/external audits.

14\. Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery

* Develop and maintain IT disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Identify critical systems and business dependencies.
* Ensure regular backup of critical business data.
* Conduct periodic backup restoration and DR testing.
* Maintain appropriate recovery procedures for critical IT systems.

15\. IT MIS \& Management Reporting

Prepare and submit periodic IT MIS covering:

* IT incidents and ticket status
* System/network uptime
* Hardware and software inventory
* IT asset movement
* AMC and warranty status
* License renewals
* IT expenditure
* Cybersecurity incidents
* Backup status
* IT project status
* Vendor performance
* Pending IT issues
* Site\-wise IT infrastructure status

Qualification

* MBA / PG qualification in IT Management will be an added advantage.
* Relevant certifications in IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or IT service management will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience managing IT infrastructure across **multiple offices / project sites**.

**E\-Commerce Coordinator**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a highly organised, detail\-oriented and proactive **Production Manager** to take complete ownership of the planning, coordination, execution and post\-production follow\-up for our monthly website and content shoots. The role will be the key coordination point between the internal team, creative/marketing agency, photographer, videographer, models, influencers and other production partners, ensuring every shoot and content requirement is planned properly, executed smoothly and delivered on time and to the required standard.

**1\. PRE\-PRODUCTION – PLANNING \& PREPARATION**

* Understand the shoot concept, creative direction, products and required deliverables before every shoot.
* Ensure all shoot requirements are identified and planned well in advance.
* Prepare and maintain a Pre\-Production SOP/checklist for every shoot.
* Coordinate and confirm concept and scenes; products/sarees; props and accessories; models; photographer/videographer; makeup artist/stylist/other crew; location/studio; shoot date and schedule; equipment and production requirements; budget and expenses.
* Ensure all products, props, accessories and other materials are available, organised and ready before the shoot.
* Follow up with all stakeholders and ensure there are no last\-minute gaps.
* Prepare shoot schedules, requirement lists, briefs and coordination emails.
* Ensure the production is good to go before the shoot date through proper checks and confirmations.

**2\. SHOOT\-DAY MANAGEMENT**

* Be present during the shoot and take ownership of production coordination and execution.
* Ensure the shoot follows the approved concept, scenes, schedule and requirements.
* Coordinate between the photographer, videographer, models, stylist, internal team and agency.
* Ensure the correct products, accessories and props are used for each scene.
* Track the progress of planned scenes and deliverables.
* Ensure all required photographs and video content are captured.
* Resolve production\-related issues and coordinate solutions when required.
* Ensure the shoot stays within the approved scope, timeline and budget.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail throughout the shoot.

**3\. POST\-PRODUCTION**

* Prepare and maintain a Post\-Production SOP/checklist for every shoot.
* Coordinate with the agency, photographer, videographer, editor and internal team for all post\-production requirements.
* Track the editing and delivery of product photographs, website photographs, reels/videos and other agreed content deliverables.
* Review edited photographs and videos against the approved concept and requirements.
* Check for product accuracy, framing and composition, styling, continuity, image/video quality, brand alignment and overall visual standards.
* Consolidate feedback from the internal team and communicate revisions clearly to the agency/editor.
* Follow up until all final deliverables are completed, reviewed and approved.
* Ensure final files are properly organised and delivered to the relevant teams.

**4\. SOP \& DOCUMENTATION**

* Create and maintain clear Pre\-Production and Post\-Production SOPs for every monthly shoot.
* Ensure the relevant SOP/checklist is reviewed and signed off by the responsible parties before proceeding.
* Maintain records of shoot requirements, concepts and scenes, budgets, approvals, schedules, vendor/team details, deliverables, feedback and final approvals.
* Ensure every shoot follows a consistent and repeatable production process.
* Continuously improve the SOP based on learnings from previous shoots.

**5\. AGENCY \& INTERNAL TEAM COORDINATION**

* Act as the primary coordination point between the internal team and external agency/production partners.
* Coordinate with the agency on all monthly shoot requirements and deliverables.
* Ensure the agency has all required information, products, concepts and approvals on time.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect requirements, feedback and approvals.
* Ensure communication between all parties is clear and timely.
* Strongly follow up with all stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify potential delays or gaps in advance and proactively resolve them.
* Draft professional shoot\-related emails, briefs, confirmations, follow\-ups and feedback.
* Escalate delays, budget issues or production challenges when required.

**6\. INSTAGRAM INFLUENCER COORDINATION**

* Coordinate monthly with the agency for Instagram influencer collaborations.
* Review and understand the proposed influencer, story and content concept.
* Ensure the story, concept, styling and overall content direction align with the brand identity.
* Ensure influencer content reflects the brand's positioning, tone and visual standards.
* Coordinate with the agency and influencer to communicate brand requirements clearly.
* Follow up on timelines, content submission and publishing schedules.
* Review proposed influencer content before publishing and coordinate any required changes or approvals with the internal team.
* Ensure the final influencer content is aligned with the approved concept and brand expectations.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE

* Prior experience in production management, content production, photography/video production or a similar role.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent organisational and time\-management skills.
* Strong email drafting and professional communication skills.
* Basic understanding of photography and video production standards and workflows.
* Ability to understand creative concepts and translate them into clear production requirements.
* High attention to detail.
* Strong ownership and accountability from pre\-production through final delivery.
* Ability to coordinate multiple people, vendors, agencies and deliverables simultaneously.
* Ability to identify potential issues before they become problems.
* Comfortable working with agencies, photographers, videographers, creatives, influencers and internal teams.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and ensure consistent follow\-through.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

A highly organised **doer and owner** who can independently take a shoot and related content requirements from:

**CONCEPT → PRE\-PRODUCTION → COORDINATION → SHOOT → POST\-PRODUCTION → REVIEW → APPROVAL → FINAL DELIVERY**

The ideal candidate should not simply coordinate tasks but should **own the complete production process**, ensure every detail is covered, follow up consistently, identify gaps proactively and make sure the final output is delivered to the expected quality, brand standard, timeline and budget.

title: Mechanical HOD (SID)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – MECHANICAL HEAD OF DEPARTMENTDRI / SPONGE IRON PLANT

**Designation:** Head of Department – Mechanical  
**Department:** Mechanical Maintenance  
**Plant:** DRI / Sponge Iron Plant  
**Reporting To:** Plant Head / General Manager  
**Location:** Plant Site

1\. JOB PURPOSE

To lead and manage the complete Mechanical Maintenance function of the DRI Plant and ensure high equipment availability, reliability, safety, and optimum maintenance cost.

The Mechanical HOD will be responsible for preventive, predictive, breakdown, shutdown, and project maintenance of all mechanical equipment associated with the DRI plant.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. DRI Plant Mechanical Maintenance

* Overall responsibility for mechanical maintenance of the DRI/Sponge Iron Plant.
* Ensure maximum availability and reliability of plant equipment.
* Plan and execute preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance.
* Monitor equipment health and identify potential failures in advance.
* Reduce mechanical breakdowns, downtime, and production losses.
* Ensure proper maintenance history and equipment records.

B. Rotary Kiln \& Cooler

* Ensure reliable operation and maintenance of Rotary Kiln and Cooler systems.
* Monitor kiln supporting systems, girth gear, pinion, rollers, bearings, seals, drive systems, and lubrication systems.
* Monitor alignment, vibration, temperature, lubrication, and mechanical condition of critical equipment.
* Plan inspection and maintenance of kiln internals and associated equipment during shutdown.
* Coordinate with Operations for kiln\-related mechanical issues.

C. Material Handling Equipment

Ensure maintenance of:

* Raw material feeding systems
* Belt conveyors
* Bucket elevators
* Apron feeders
* Screw conveyors
* Vibrating feeders
* Crushers
* Screens
* Transfer points
* Hoppers and chutes
* Product and char handling systems

D. Fans, Pumps \& Utilities

* Ensure proper maintenance of ID fans, FD fans, cooling fans, blowers, and other rotating equipment.
* Supervise maintenance of process and utility pumps.
* Monitor bearings, couplings, shafts, impellers, mechanical seals, and lubrication systems.
* Ensure proper alignment and balancing of rotating equipment.

E. Breakdown Maintenance

* Lead the Mechanical team during critical and emergency breakdowns.
* Ensure quick identification of failure and restoration of equipment.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major and repeated failures.
* Implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain breakdown history and analyze recurring problems.

F. Preventive \& Predictive Maintenance

* Prepare and implement preventive maintenance schedules.
* Ensure 100% compliance with planned maintenance activities.
* Establish inspection routines for critical equipment.
* Monitor vibration, temperature, lubrication, alignment, and other equipment health parameters.
* Develop condition\-based maintenance practices wherever applicable.

G. Shutdown Maintenance

* Prepare monthly/quarterly/annual shutdown maintenance plans.
* Identify critical jobs before shutdown.
* Prepare manpower, tools, spares, consumables, and contractor requirements.
* Monitor shutdown activities and ensure completion within the planned time.
* Conduct post\-shutdown inspection and equipment trial runs.

H. Manpower Management

* Lead Mechanical Engineers, Shift In\-charges, Supervisors, Technicians, Fitters, Welders, Helpers, and contract manpower.
* Prepare manpower deployment and shift schedules.
* Assign jobs according to employee skill and plant requirements.
* Monitor performance and discipline of the maintenance team.
* Conduct training and skill\-development programs.

I. Spare Parts Management

* Identify critical mechanical spares for DRI plant equipment.
* Maintain minimum/maximum stock levels.
* Coordinate with Stores and Purchase departments.
* Ensure timely procurement of critical spares.
* Control spare consumption and maintenance expenditure.
* Maintain proper records of critical equipment spares.

J. Safety Management

* Ensure strict compliance with plant safety procedures.
* Implement LOTO before maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper PPE and safe working practices.
* Conduct toolbox meetings and safety inspections.
* Ensure safe execution of height work, confined\-space work, hot work, lifting operations, and heavy equipment maintenance.
* Investigate mechanical maintenance\-related incidents and implement corrective actions.

K. Cost Control \& Budget

* Prepare the Mechanical Maintenance annual budget.
* Control maintenance expenditure without compromising safety and reliability.
* Reduce breakdown and emergency maintenance costs.
* Optimize manpower, spares, consumables, and contractor utilization.
* Identify opportunities for maintenance cost reduction.

L. Project \& Modification Work

* Review mechanical requirements for plant expansion, modification, and improvement projects.
* Supervise installation, erection, commissioning, and trial runs of new mechanical equipment.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Projects, Production, Electrical, and Instrumentation departments.
* Ensure proper handover of newly installed equipment to Maintenance.

3\. KEY EQUIPMENT RESPONSIBILITY

The Mechanical HOD should have strong working knowledge of:

* Rotary Kiln
* Kiln Drive \& Gearbox
* Girth Gear \& Pinion
* Kiln Rollers \& Bearings
* Cooler
* ID/FD Fans
* Blowers
* Crushers
* Screens
* Vibrating Feeders
* Belt Conveyors
* Bucket Elevators
* Screw Conveyors
* Pumps
* Gearboxes
* Couplings
* Bearings
* Hydraulic \& Pneumatic Systems
* Lubrication Systems
* Hoppers, Chutes \& Gates
* Material Handling Systems
* Structural and mechanical maintenance equipment

4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

* Mechanical equipment availability
* Reduction in breakdown hours
* Reduction in repeat breakdowns
* Improvement in MTBF
* Reduction in MTTR
* Preventive Maintenance Compliance
* Shutdown completion within planned time
* Reduction in maintenance cost
* Critical spare availability
* Reduction in production loss due to mechanical failures
* Safety compliance and zero major maintenance accidents

5\. QUALIFICATION

**Essential:**

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in DRI/Sponge Iron/Steel Plant mechanical maintenance.

6\. EXPERIENCE

* **10–15\+ years** of experience in mechanical maintenance.
* Preferably **5\+ years in a senior management/leadership role** in a DRI/Sponge Iron or Steel Plant.
* Strong experience in Rotary Kiln, Cooler, Material Handling, Fans, Pumps, Gearboxes, Conveyors, and shutdown maintenance.

7\. REQUIRED SKILLS

* Strong knowledge of DRI plant mechanical equipment
* Mechanical troubleshooting and breakdown analysis
* Preventive and predictive maintenance
* Root Cause Analysis
* Shutdown planning and execution
* Team leadership and manpower management
* Spare parts and inventory management
* Maintenance budgeting and cost control
* Safety management
* Good communication and coordination skills
* MS Office / Excel and maintenance reporting

8\. AUTHORITY \& ACCOUNTABILITY

The Mechanical HOD will be accountable for the overall performance of the Mechanical Maintenance Department, including **equipment reliability, plant availability, breakdown control, preventive maintenance, shutdown execution, manpower productivity, spare management, maintenance cost, and safety compliance**.

**Prepared By:** HR Department  
**Reviewed By:** Plant Head  
**Approved By:** Management  
**Department:** Mechanical Maintenance  
**Plant:** DRI / Sponge Iron Plant

About Tryfecta Management Solutions

Tryfecta Management Solutions Pvt Ltd provides professional **HR and management services** to businesses, helping organisations establish structured, professional and technology\-enabled HR systems.

Our work includes **HR policies and documentation, employee management, HR process implementation, HRMS implementation, payroll support and ongoing HR management** for clients.

We are looking for a **full\-time HR Executive** to join our team and take responsibility for HR operations, HR documentation, Zoho systems and supporting the HR requirements of our clients.

This is a **hands\-on role** involving HR operations, technology, documentation, process implementation and direct interaction with clients.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The HR Executive will be responsible for supporting **Tryfecta's internal HR activities** as well as managing assigned HR activities for our clients.

The role will involve working extensively with **Zoho People, Zoho Payroll and Zoho Workplace**, along with preparing HR policies, employee handbooks, employment documents, HR processes and reports.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding different businesses, identifying HR requirements and implementing practical HR solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. HR Operations

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations for Tryfecta and assigned clients.

* Maintain attendance, leave and holiday records.

* Assist with performance management processes.
* Support employee communications.
* Assist with employee grievances and HR\-related matters.
* Support exit and separation processes.
* Ensure HR records are accurate, complete and up to date.

2\. Zoho People, Zoho Payroll \& Zoho Workplace

The candidate will be expected to work extensively with the **Zoho ecosystem**.

Zoho People

* Set up and maintain employee records.
* Manage departments, designations and organisational structures.
* Configure and manage attendance and leave.
* Manage holidays, workflows and approval processes.
* Support employee onboarding.
* Assist employees and clients with Zoho People queries.
* Maintain accurate HR data.
* Assist with HRMS implementation for clients.
* Identify opportunities for HR automation and process improvement.

Zoho Payroll

* Assist with monthly payroll processing.
* Verify attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Maintain payroll information.
* Assist with salary changes and payroll updates.
* Support payslip generation and distribution.
* Assist with Zoho People–Zoho Payroll integration.
* Identify and assist in resolving payroll discrepancies.

Zoho Workplace

Use and administer relevant Zoho Workplace applications for HR operations, communication, collaboration and document management, including:

* **Zoho Mail**
* **Zoho WorkDrive**
* **Zoho Cliq**
* **Zoho Writer**
* **Zoho Sheet**
* **Zoho Show**

Responsibilities will include:

* Organising HR documents and files in WorkDrive.
* Managing HR\-related communication through Zoho Mail.
* Using Cliq for internal coordination.
* Preparing policies and HR documents using Zoho Writer.
* Preparing HR trackers and reports using Zoho Sheet.
* Preparing presentations and HR materials using Zoho Show.
* Maintaining appropriate organisation and confidentiality of HR information.
* Supporting clients in adopting and effectively using relevant Zoho applications.

**Hands\-on experience with Zoho People, Zoho Payroll and Zoho Workplace will be an advantage.**

3\. HR Policies \& Documentation

A significant part of this role will involve **drafting and maintaining professional HR policies and documentation** for Tryfecta and its clients.

Responsibilities include:

* Draft, review and update HR policies.
* Prepare Employee Handbooks and HR Manuals.
* Customise HR policies according to client requirements.
* Prepare HR forms, templates, checklists and process documents.
* Draft employment and HR\-related documents.
* Maintain document control and version management.

Policies may include:

* Attendance \& Working Hours
* Leave \& Holidays
* Remote Working
* Code of Conduct
* Confidentiality
* Information Security
* Grievance Management
* Recruitment
* Onboarding
* Probation
* Performance Management
* Compensation \& Salary Revision
* Disciplinary Procedures
* Travel \& Expenses
* Exit \& Separation
* Data Privacy
* Workplace Conduct
* Equal Opportunity
* POSH

The candidate should be able to **write clear, professional and practical HR policies**, rather than simply use standard templates.

4\. Client HR Management

* Support the HR requirements of assigned clients.
* Communicate directly with client management and employees when required.
* Understand client requirements and assist in implementing HR processes.
* Maintain client employee records and HR documentation.
* Coordinate with clients for required information and approvals.
* Follow up on pending HR activities.
* Prepare HR reports and status updates.
* Ensure assigned activities are completed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients.
* Handle client information with a high degree of confidentiality.

5\. HR Process Implementation

* Review existing HR practices of clients.
* Identify gaps in HR processes and documentation.
* Assist in developing structured HR processes.
* Prepare HR process maps, workflows and checklists.
* Implement employee documentation systems.
* Assist with HRMS implementation.
* Support implementation of attendance, leave, onboarding, performance and exit processes.
* Help clients transition from informal HR practices to structured HR systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology and automation.

6\. Payroll \& HR Administration

* Assist in monthly payroll processing for Tryfecta and clients.
* Verify attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate with clients regarding employee and salary changes.
* Maintain payroll\-related records.
* Assist with payslip generation.
* Support payroll queries and discrepancies.
* Maintain confidentiality of salary and employee information.

Communication Skills

Personal Attributes

* **Confidential and trustworthy**

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

**"The client needs a better leave process."**

and work through:

**Understand the requirement → Review the existing process → Identify gaps → Develop the HR process → Draft the policy → Configure Zoho → Communicate the process → Implement → Follow up**

The Engineering background should bring **analytical and structured thinking**, while the Master's in HR should provide the foundation for professional HR practices.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.

Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

title: Insurance Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Insurance Executive

**Department:** Insurance / Sales  
**Industry:** Automobile Dealership\-Unnati Vehicle Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Fatima Nagar Pune  
**Reporting To:** Sales Manager / Insurance Manager

Job Purpose

To manage and grow the vehicle insurance business at the dealership by coordinating with customers, insurance companies, sales teams, and other stakeholders. The Insurance Executive will be responsible for generating insurance business, ensuring timely policy issuance and renewals, and providing excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. New Vehicle Insurance**

* Handle insurance requirements for new vehicle deliveries.
* Explain available insurance plans, coverage, add\-ons, and benefits to customers.
* Prepare insurance quotations based on customer requirements.
* Coordinate with insurance companies for policy issuance.
* Ensure insurance policies are issued before vehicle delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of all insurance policies and transactions.

**2\. Insurance Renewals**

* Maintain and monitor the dealership's insurance renewal database.
* Contact existing customers for policy renewals.
* Generate renewal quotations and convert renewal opportunities into business.
* Follow up with customers until renewal completion.
* Ensure timely renewal of policies to avoid policy lapses.

**3\. Coordination with Sales Team**

* Coordinate closely with Sales Consultants, Team Leaders, and Sales Managers.
* Support the sales team in converting insurance opportunities.
* Provide regular updates on insurance quotations, policies, and pending cases.
* Participate in daily/weekly sales and insurance review meetings.

**4\. Customer Handling**

* Explain policy terms, coverage, exclusions, IDV, deductibles, and add\-on covers to customers.
* Resolve customer queries related to insurance policies.
* Provide support during policy endorsement, cancellation, and other service requirements.
* Maintain professional relationships with customers.

**5\. Insurance Company Coordination**

* Coordinate with insurance companies, brokers, and insurance representatives.
* Obtain quotations and negotiate wherever applicable within approved guidelines.
* Follow up for policy issuance, endorsements, and claim\-related documentation.
* Ensure proper documentation and timely submission of insurance proposals.

**6\. MIS \& Reporting**

* Prepare daily and monthly insurance sales reports.
* Maintain records of new policies, renewals, pending cases, cancellations, and conversions.
* Track insurance targets and achievement.
* Share regular MIS with the reporting manager.
* Maintain customer and policy data accurately.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Insurance penetration percentage
* New vehicle insurance conversion
* Insurance renewal conversion
* Monthly insurance premium / business generated
* Number of policies issued
* Customer satisfaction
* Renewal follow\-up and conversion
* Accuracy and timely completion of documentation

Required Skills

* Good communication and convincing skills.
* Customer handling and relationship management.
* Good follow\-up and negotiation skills.
* Basic knowledge of motor insurance.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.
* Ability to work with sales targets.
* Good coordination skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Educational Qualification

* Graduate preferred.
* Candidates with relevant experience in **motor insurance, automobile dealership, insurance brokerage, or automobile sales** will be preferred.

Experience

* **1–3 years** of experience in motor insurance, automobile dealership, or a related field preferred.
* Freshers with good communication and sales skills may also be considered.

Additional Requirements

* Knowledge of motor insurance products and add\-on covers.
* Willingness to work in a customer\-facing dealership environment.
* Strong follow\-up skills.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated approach.
* Knowledge of local language will be an advantage.

Employment Type

**Full\-time**

Salary

**As per company norms and candidate experience.**

title: Inventory Assistant
description:
SYLCON SHOES \& BAGSJOB DESCRIPTION – INVENTORY ASSISTANTPosition Details

**Job Title:** Inventory Assistant  
**Department:** Store Operations / Inventory  
**Location:** Store / Warehouse  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. Job Purpose

The **Inventory Assistant** is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day inventory and stock management activities of the store. The role involves receiving, checking, arranging, counting, recording, and maintaining stock accurately in both physical and system records.

The Inventory Assistant must ensure that the right products are available at the right location, stock records are accurate, and all inventory movements are properly documented.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Stock Receiving \& Verification

* Receive stock from the warehouse, suppliers, or other stores.
* Verify received products against invoices, stock transfer documents, and system records.
* Check product quantity, size, colour, model, barcode, and condition.
* Report shortages, excess quantities, damaged products, or mismatches immediately.
* Ensure all received stock is properly entered/updated in the system.

B. Physical Stock Management

* Arrange and organize products systematically in the godown/store.
* Ensure products are properly numbered, labelled, and stored.
* Maintain cleanliness and proper utilization of inventory storage areas.
* Ensure fast\-moving and high\-demand products are easily accessible.
* Prevent damage, loss, misplacement, or unauthorized movement of stock.

C. Inventory Counting \& Reconciliation

* Conduct regular physical stock counts as instructed.
* Compare physical stock with system stock.
* Identify and report stock discrepancies.
* Assist in stock reconciliation and corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of inventory counts and adjustments.

D. Stock Transfer \& Movement

* Prepare and process stock transfers between stores and warehouse locations.
* Verify quantities before dispatching or receiving transferred stock.
* Maintain proper documentation for every stock movement.
* Ensure no stock is moved without proper authorization/documentation.

E. Back\-Order \& Stock Availability

* Check product availability in the store and system.
* Identify unavailable or insufficient stock.
* Raise back\-order requests when required.
* Coordinate with the Store Manager/Inventory In\-Charge regarding stock requirements.
* Follow up on pending stock requirements.

F. Billing \& Stock Documentation

* Maintain proper records of stock\-related bills, transfer documents, and supporting documents.
* Ensure inventory documents are filed systematically.
* Assist in tracing stock\-related documents whenever required.
* Report missing or incorrect documentation immediately.

G. Coordination with Store Team

* Coordinate with Sales Executives, Cashiers, ASM, Store Manager, and warehouse teams.
* Support the sales team by providing accurate information about product availability.
* Ensure requested products are located and supplied promptly.
* Communicate stock\-related issues to the concerned person without delay.

3\. System \& Data Management

* Update inventory\-related information accurately in the designated system/PDT.
* Scan and verify product barcodes where applicable.
* Ensure system stock and physical stock remain aligned.
* Avoid duplicate, incorrect, or unauthorized entries.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of inventory information.

4\. Qualifications

**Minimum Qualification**

**.DEGREE/DEPLOMA**

**GOOD KNOWLEDGE IN EXCEL(PVOT TABLE ,VLOOK ETC..)**

**Preferred:**

* Diploma or Graduate qualification in Commerce, Logistics, Retail Management, or a related field.
* Previous experience in retail, warehouse, inventory, or stock management will be an advantage.

5\. Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in inventory, retail, warehouse, or store operations.
* Freshers with good numerical and organizational skills may also be considered.
* Experience in footwear, fashion, apparel, supermarket, electronics, jewellery, or other retail sectors is preferred.

6\.**Technical Skills:**

* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel**
* Proficiency in **VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP**
* Good knowledge of **Pivot Tables**
* Ability to prepare and analyze inventory reports
* Strong data entry and data reconciliation skills
* Basic knowledge of **Excel formulas and functions**

Behavioural Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Accuracy and accountability.
* Good organizational skills.
* Ability to identify discrepancies.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Time management.
* Teamwork and cooperation.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Honest and responsible approach to stock handling.

7\. Performance Expectations / KPIs

The Inventory Assistant will be expected to maintain high standards in the following areas:

Inventory Accuracy

* Maintain high accuracy between physical and system stock.
* Minimize stock discrepancies and errors.

Stock Handling

* Ensure products are received, checked, arranged, and transferred correctly.
* Minimize product damage, loss, and misplacement.

Documentation

* Ensure all stock movements are properly documented.
* Maintain complete and accurate inventory records.

System Accuracy

* Ensure timely and accurate system/PDT updates.
* Avoid unauthorized or incorrect stock entries.

Responsiveness

* Provide timely stock availability information to the sales team.
* Complete assigned inventory tasks within the required timelines.

Compliance

* Follow company inventory procedures and instructions.
* Maintain proper stock security and confidentiality.

8\. Reporting Structure

**Inventory Assistant**  
↓  
**Inventory In\-Charge / ASM**  
↓  
**Store Manager**  
↓  
**Operations / Management**

The Inventory Assistant is responsible for immediately escalating major stock discrepancies, damaged stock, missing products, system errors, or unauthorized stock movements to the reporting manager.

9\. Daily Responsibilities

The Inventory Assistant should ensure the following on a daily basis:

* Check and verify incoming stock.
* Update stock/system records.
* Arrange and maintain inventory.
* Support product requirements from the sales team.
* Check stock availability.
* Process authorized stock movements.
* Maintain stock\-related documents.
* Identify and report discrepancies.
* Keep the inventory area clean and organized.
* Complete all assigned inventory tasks within the specified timeline.

10\. Professional Expectations

The Inventory Assistant is expected to:

* Handle company stock with complete responsibility and care.
* Maintain honesty and transparency in all inventory\-related activities.
* Follow instructions from the reporting manager.
* Maintain discipline and punctuality.
* Protect company property and inventory.
* Maintain a professional attitude with customers and colleagues.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Immediately report any loss, damage, discrepancy, or unusual inventory activity.

11\. Success in the Role

A successful Inventory Assistant will ensure that:

**Right Product \+ Right Quantity \+ Right Location \+ Accurate System Record \+ Proper Documentation \= Effective Inventory Management**

The overall objective of the role is to ensure **accurate, organized, secure, and efficient inventory operations**, thereby supporting smooth store operations and improving customer service.

 **Intern, Talent Acquisition** 
 to work closely with our TA team and own hiring processes end to end across multiple roles. You’ll get hands\-on exposure to the entire recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to candidate communication, interview management, stakeholder coordination, and offer negotiation.
 



  





 You’ll also work on improving how we hire by experimenting with AI tools, automations, and new ways of working.
 



  





 If you want to build a strong foundation in Talent Acquisition while getting exposure to real hiring problems, fast\-paced teams, and global talent, this is the role for you.

* **Own hiring end to end:**

description:
**Broad outline of the Role**


* Responsible for implementation of HR initiatives, policies and processes related to recruitment, employee engagement, learning and development, and talent management and to improve business outcome. * Partner with HR COE to drive implementation of talent management practices.

* hr business partner
* hrbp
* talent management
* employee engagement
* succession planning
* performance management
* business requirements
* hr policy

title: Factory Account Executive
description:
**Job title:** Factory Account Executive — Garment Industry SaaS Sales (Gurugram)

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹32,000 – ₹65,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹32,000/month \+ uncapped commission, ₹30,000/month on target **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, factory visits across NCR

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink gives garment and textile factories a verified wage ledger and a verified pool of workers to hire from. Subscriptions run ₹2,499 to ₹19,999 a month. The accounts you close are yours to own, grow and earn from for as long as they stay.

What you'll do

* Own factory acquisition in your territory: get to the owner or the production head, run the demo on the floor, close the subscription
* Take each account live — jobs posted, seats accepted, QC entry actually running on the line
* Stay the account owner after the sale. Your commission is recurring and tied to retention, so churn is your problem and your upside.
* Grow accounts: more job seats, higher tier, more AI tech\-pack usage
* Work with the field officer team so every job your factory posts gets filled with verified workers

Garment trade experience — required

You will be sitting across from garment factory owners and production heads. They decide in the first two minutes whether you know the business.

* **Minimum 2 years selling to, or working inside, garment/apparel/textile manufacturing** — B2B sales into garment units, or a production/merchandising/IE/HR/compliance role you are moving out of into sales
* You can hold a real conversation about order delivery dates, line balancing, labour shortage before a shipment, piece\-rate wage sheets, contractor labour, and buyer social compliance audits (SEDEX, BSCI, SA8000 type) that demand clean wage and attendance records
* You know how NCR garment units are structured — own roll versus contractor labour, job\-work units, buying house pressure, the peak\-season scramble for tailors
* You are comfortable walking a production floor, not just a conference room
* Existing relationships in NCR garment units are a serious advantage and will be discussed in the interview

What you'll earn

* **Fixed ₹32,000/month**
* **₹1,500 per factory converted to paid** (on first payment received)
* **5% of subscription revenue from your own accounts, every month, for as long as they stay** — plus 5% of their AI usage spend
* **₹5 per worker** whose first verified job is at your account; **₹2 per job seat accepted** at your accounts
* Realistic at 20 Professional accounts: ₹62,000–77,000/month, with the recurring share growing every month you retain

Also required

* 1–4 years in B2B field sales, with a closing record you can talk through
* Fluent Hindi and working English
* Own vehicle, and a smartphone or laptop

What we offer

* Fixed salary on the 1st, uncapped recurring commission
* Employee stock options — every employee holds equity by Series A
* Provident Fund, ESI, travel allowance
* Health insurance from our next funding round
* Path to Ops Lead / Hub Manager (₹6–9 LPA \+ ESOP \+ hub bonus)
* Single\-digit employee number on the commercial team. What you build, you own.

**Work Location:** In person

Screening questions

* How many years have you sold to, or worked inside, garment/apparel/textile manufacturing?
* Name the kinds of garment units you have worked with and roughly how many.
* Have you sold a software or subscription product to businesses? What was the average monthly ticket size?
* Which NCR garment clusters do you already have contacts in?
* What is your current fixed salary and your current on\-target earning?
* Do you have your own vehicle?

Pay: ₹32,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Field Officer
description:
**Job title:** Field Officer — Garment Worker Onboarding (Gurugram)

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹20,000/month \+ performance incentive up to ₹15,000/month **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, travel within assigned garment cluster

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink runs a verified wage ledger for garment and textile factories. Every worker gets a permanent record of the jobs they did and the money they earned. Every factory gets a verified pool of tailors, checkers and finishers it can hire from. We are building the NCR network cluster by cluster.

What you'll do

* Sign up garment workers in your cluster onto the SilaiLink app — Aadhaar and bank/UPI verification, done correctly the first time
* Get each new worker through their first job on the platform so their earnings actually start
* Own a pod of 100–500 workers as their personal account manager. You are the person they call when a payment or a job is in question.
* Keep the pod active: monthly check\-ins, resolving wage queries, bringing back workers who go quiet
* Visit units in your cluster with the account team when a factory's job posts need filling
* Log every visit and signup in the app the same day. No paper, no backdating.

Garment trade experience — required

This role is only open to people who already know the garment line. You should be able to walk into a stitching unit and know what you are looking at.

* **Minimum 1 year working in or around garment/apparel/textile manufacturing** in NCR — as a supervisor, line in\-charge, jobber, master, checker, production or HR/time\-office assistant, contractor's coordinator, or in field recruitment for garment units
* You know the operations by name: cutting, stitching (single needle, overlock, flatlock), checking, thread cutting, ironing, finishing, packing
* You understand how garment workers are actually paid — piece rate, daily wage, monthly, and how contractor (thekedari) labour differs from a factory's own roll
* You are already comfortable in Udyog Vihar, Sector 37, Kapashera, Okhla, Faridabad or Noida Phase 2 type clusters, and in the worker colonies around them
* You can speak to a tailor about their rate and their attendance without them feeling sold to

If you have sold loans, insurance or SIM cards but have never been on a garment floor, this role is not the right fit. Apply to our Factory Account Executive posting instead if you have B2B sales experience.

What you'll earn

* **Fixed ₹20,000/month**, paid on the 1st, every month. Your rent and food never depend on incentive.
* **₹50 per activated worker** — ₹20 on verified signup (Aadhaar \+ bank/UPI), ₹30 when they finish their first verified job within 30 days
* **₹3 per active worker in your pod, every month** — 500 active workers \= ₹1,500/month, recurring, on a pod you have already built. This rate rises as platform revenue per worker grows.
* **₹1 per verified job** completed by a worker you recruited

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹20,000/month \+ performance incentive up to ₹15,000/month **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, travel within assigned garment cluster

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink runs a verified wage ledger for garment and textile factories. Every worker gets a permanent record of the jobs they did and the money they earned. Every factory gets a verified pool of tailors, checkers and finishers it can hire from. We are building the NCR network cluster by cluster.

What you'll do

* Sign up garment workers in your cluster onto the SilaiLink app — Aadhaar and bank/UPI verification, done correctly the first time
* Get each new worker through their first job on the platform so their earnings actually start
* Own a pod of 100–500 workers as their personal account manager. You are the person they call when a payment or a job is in question.
* Keep the pod active: monthly check\-ins, resolving wage queries, bringing back workers who go quiet
* Visit units in your cluster with the account team when a factory's job posts need filling
* Log every visit and signup in the app the same day. No paper, no backdating.

Garment trade experience — required

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Role Purpose

To build, manage, and retain a high\-performing clinic team by owning recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance support, attendance, documentation, and staff coordination. The HR ensures smooth people operations, strong discipline, and a professional workplace culture that supports patient experience and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning

\- Handle end\-to\-end hiring for clinical and non\-clinical roles: doctors, therapists, nurses, counselors, receptionists, sales staff, support staff, and coordinators.

\- Work with management to forecast manpower needs and plan hiring timelines

\- Source candidates via job portals, social media, references, WhatsApp groups, and local networks.

\- Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, coordinate final interviews, and manage offer discussions

\- Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future vacancies.

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

\- Manage joining formalities, documentation, and employee file creation

\- Conduct structured onboarding: clinic tour, role briefing, SOP introduction, team introduction, and basic training coordination.

\- Ensure new hires receive ID, access, uniform, and required tools on Day 1\.

\- Conduct onboarding check\-ins in the first 30–60 days to improve retention.

3\. Employee Records, Attendance \& Compliance

\- Maintain accurate employee files, attendance, leave records, and HR trackers.

\- Ensure proper documentation for compliance and internal audits.

\- Coordinate payroll inputs, incentive records, and F\&F settlements with finance/operations.

\- Enforce HR policies, SOPs, and workplace rules consistently.

4\. Performance, Discipline \& Employee Relations

\- Support managers in tracking performance, KRAs/KPIs, and workplace conduct.

\- Handle grievances, conflicts, counseling, warning letters, PIPs, and disciplinary matters professionally.

\- Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends to reduce turnover.

\- Promote a culture of trust, accountability, and respect across the team.

5\. Training, Engagement \& Retention

\- Identify training needs and coordinate skill development sessions for staff.

\- Support engagement activities: recognition, milestones, team meetings, and morale\-building initiatives.

\- Work with management on retention strategies, incentives, and career\-path discussions.

6\. HR Reporting \& Coordination

\- Prepare monthly HR reports: hiring status, attrition, attendance summary, open positions, and recruitment pipeline.

\- Act as the main HR point of contact for staff and managers.

\- Collaborate with operations, sales, and clinical heads for smooth workforce planning.

Required Skills \& Qualities

\- Strong recruitment and screening skills with good judgment of attitude and fit.

\- Excellent communication, coordination, and follow\-up ability.

\- Confident handling of staff issues, discipline, and sensitive matters.

\- Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to maintain accurate records.

\- Professional, mature, and able to work in a fast\-paced clinic environment.

Preferred Experience

\- 3 years\+ of HR and recruitment/administration experience.

\- Experience in clinic, hospital, salon, wellness, dermatology, or service industry is a strong plus.

\- Graduate in any stream; HR background preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

 LENS Corporation is an AI, Computer Vision, and Biometrics company building enterprise\-grade platforms deployed across government, defence, infrastructure, smart cities, and large enterprises.

**Role Overview**




  





 We are looking for a QA Engineer who can take ownership of product quality, stability, and release confidence across complex, multi\-module platforms.
 



 This role goes beyond basic test execution.
 



 You will work closely with product, engineering, business analysts, and support teams to ensure features behave correctly in real\-world, large\-scale deployments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





 Functional \& Regression Testing
 



 Perform functional testing across:
 


* Web platforms (VMS, ICCC, UNMS, SAFER)
* Mobile applications (Android \& iOS)
* Execute regression testing before every release.
* Validate fixes, enhancements, and configuration changes.



 Release \& Stability Ownership
 


* Participate in release planning and pre\-release sanity testing.
* Ensure critical workflows remain stable across updates.
* Identify edge cases related to scale, permissions, roles, and configurations.



 Test Design \& Documentation
 



 Create and maintain:
 


* Test cases
* Test scenarios
* Bug reports with clear reproduction steps
* Work closely with Business Analysts to align test coverage with functional requirements.



 Cross\-Team Collaboration
 


* Coordinate with developers to explain issues clearly and verify fixes.
* Support internal teams during deployments and demos when required.
* Help ensure production issues are minimized through strong pre\-release validation.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience**



* 2–5 years of experience as a QA Engineer in a product or enterprise tech environment.



  





**Strong understanding of:** 



* Functional testing
* Regression testing
* Release validation
* Experience testing web\-based platforms and mobile applications.
* Ability to think in terms of real\-world usage, workflows, and failure scenarios.
* Clear communication and structured bug reporting.

* Exposure to VMS, AI/ML systems, Surveillance, IoT, GovTech, or Smart City platforms.

* Not a manual testing\-only checkbox role.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  




**Description**
 We are looking for an early\-career Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help us build and maintain the automated tests that keep our products reliable. You will work alongside developers and senior SDETs to write test automation, expand our regression coverage, and investigate failures in our CI pipelines. This is a hands\-on engineering role: you will spend most of your time writing code, not clicking through screens.
   

 It is an ideal role for someone who enjoys breaking things on purpose, is comfortable in a codebase, and wants to grow into a strong quality engineer with a solid automation foundation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Write, execute, and maintain automated API tests using Playwright and Robot Framework.
* Review requirements and user stories, design and document test cases covering functional and non\-functional scenarios.
* Execute manual exploratory testing on new features where automation coverage does not yet exist, and convert repeatable checks into automated tests.
* Triage failing tests in CI/CD pipelines, distinguish genuine product defects from flaky or environment\-related failures, and escalate appropriately.
* Log clear, well\-evidenced defects with reproduction steps, logs, and screenshots, and track them through to closure.
* Use Git for day\-to\-day version control\- branching, pull requests, and responding to code review feedback on your test code.
* Contribute to test data setup, environment configuration, and small automation utilities that reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with developers and product managers on quality risks.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0\-2 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language \- Python preferred.
* Exposure to an automation framework such as PyTest, Playwright, or Robot Framework, through work, coursework, or personal projects.
* Understanding of REST API concepts (HTTP methods, status codes, JSON) and familiarity with a tool such as Postman or the requests library.
* Familiarity with Git and basic branching workflows.
* Solid grasp of software testing fundamentals: test case design, defect lifecycle, regression testing, and the difference between functional and non\-functional testing.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to learn quickly and take direction from senior engineers.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 
* Hands\-on experience with PyTest, Playwright (TypeScript or Python bindings) or Robot Framework.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Concourse, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Awareness of Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Jira.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or Locust.

Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.

Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

title: Executive, IPQA
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for ensuring day\-to\-day compliance with global GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) during manufacturing, packing, and dispensing activities at the site. The role provides on\-floor quality assurance support, ensuring operations are performed as per approved procedures, validated processes, and regulatory expectations. The role performs line clearance, in\-process checks, routine area monitoring, and documentation review, ensuring data integrity, product quality, and patient safety. The position supports cleaning validation, process validation, and aseptic process simulations, and assists in deviation management and inspection readiness, contributing to consistent, compliant, and right\-first\-time pharmaceutical manufacturing.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Perform IPQA (In\-Process Quality Assurance) activities during manufacturing and packing operations
* Oversee calibration of IPQA instruments
* Review of and release of Batch
* Review the in\-process and finished product COA before batch release
* Keeping records \& review of equipment’s logbooks, dispensing logs, housekeeping records, environmental monitoring records, calibration record, batch records
* Execute Line Clearance and Readiness for manufacturing, packing, and dispensing areas
* Conduct routine In\-Process Checks and coordinate with IPQC (In\-Process Quality Control)
* Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 210 \& 211 (Code of Federal Regulations – Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Drugs)
* Review BMR (Batch Manufacturing Record) and BPR (Batch Packing Record) for accuracy
* Perform Environmental Monitoring and routine monitoring of manufacturing areas
* Ensure assurance of cleaning, sterilization, and aseptic manipulations
* Support Sampling of Cleaning Validation and record compilation
* Assist in Process Validation Reports (PVR – Process Validation Report) activities
* Support Aseptic Process Simulation (Media Fill) monitoring
* Ensure Good Documentation Practices (GDP – Good Documentation Practices) compliance
* Participate in Routine GMP Inspections and quality record reviews


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Real\-time Monitoring and Compliance Reporting.
* Participation in Investigations.
* Provide on\-the\-job training to shop floor personnel on GMP practices, quality standards, and documentation practices.
* Maintain IPQA\-related documents and records in a state of audit readiness.
* To have good written and verbal communication skills in English language.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
* B. Pharm B. Pharm \- Required
* M. Pharm M. Pharm \- Preferred
