title: AI Intern
description:
Role Summary
 



 Teceze is looking for enthusiastic and technically curious
 **Artificial Intelligence Interns** 
 to support the design, development, testing and implementation of practical AI solutions.
 



 The internship will provide hands\-on exposure to generative AI, large language models, machine learning, natural language processing, data analytics, intelligent automation and AI application development.
 



 Interns will work with Teceze’s technology, service delivery and business teams to identify suitable use cases, develop prototypes and convert successful concepts into secure and scalable solutions.
 



 This role is suitable for students or recent graduates who possess strong programming fundamentals, analytical thinking and a genuine interest in building production\-oriented AI applications.
 



 Internship Objectives
 



 The program is designed to help interns:
 


* Understand how AI is applied to real business and technology problems.
* Gain practical experience with generative AI and machine\-learning technologies.
* Develop AI\-powered applications, assistants and automation workflows.
* Work with structured and unstructured business data.
* Learn how AI solutions are evaluated, secured and deployed.
* Understand responsible AI, data privacy and information\-security requirements.
* Collaborate within a professional software\-development environment.
* Build demonstrable AI projects for a professional portfolio.



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Generative AI and Large Language Models
 


* Assist in developing applications using large language models.
* Build AI assistants, chatbots, copilots and knowledge\-search tools.
* Develop and test prompts, prompt templates and system instructions.
* Experiment with model parameters and prompting techniques.
* Assist in implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation solutions.
* Process internal documents and knowledge sources for controlled AI retrieval.
* Develop embeddings and vector\-based search capabilities.
* Compare model responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency and safety.
* Help reduce hallucinations through grounding, validation and structured outputs.
* Explore AI\-agent and tool\-calling workflows under technical supervision.



 Machine Learning Development
 


* Support the development of supervised and unsupervised machine\-learning models.
* Prepare datasets for classification, prediction, forecasting or recommendation tasks.
* Perform feature selection and basic feature engineering.
* Train, validate and compare machine\-learning models.
* Evaluate models using appropriate performance metrics.
* Assist in identifying overfitting, bias and data\-quality limitations.
* Document experimental results and model decisions.
* Support the optimization of selected models for practical use.



 Data Collection and Preparation
 


* Collect, clean and organize structured and unstructured data.
* Identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated or inaccurate information.
* Transform raw data into suitable formats for analysis or model development.
* Create scripts for repeatable data\-processing activities.
* Assist in labeling and categorizing data.
* Maintain clear documentation of datasets and processing steps.
* Follow data\-retention, confidentiality and access\-control requirements.
* Ensure that sensitive data is not used in unauthorized public AI tools.



 AI Application Development
 


* Assist in building AI\-powered web applications and internal tools.
* Integrate AI models with applications through approved APIs.
* Develop backend components using Python or another approved language.
* Create simple user interfaces for AI prototypes.
* Connect applications to databases, document repositories and enterprise systems.
* Implement error handling, logging and input validation.
* Write modular, readable and maintainable code.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
* Support application testing and defect resolution.



 Automation and Business Process Improvement
 


* Analyze repetitive business processes that could benefit from AI or automation.
* Develop proof\-of\-concept solutions for document processing, classification and summarization.
* Assist in automating report generation, data extraction and information retrieval.
* Build workflows connecting AI models with business applications.
* Measure the time, cost and quality improvements produced by automation.
* Document the limitations, risks and dependencies of each proposed solution.
* Work with business users to validate whether a prototype addresses the intended requirement.



 Testing and Evaluation
 


* Create test cases for AI applications and model outputs.
* Evaluate generated content for accuracy, relevance and completeness.
* Test applications with different prompts, documents and user scenarios.
* Identify hallucinations, unsafe outputs and inconsistent behavior.
* Assist in measuring retrieval quality and response accuracy.
* Conduct functional, integration and basic performance testing.
* Document defects and support troubleshooting.
* Validate improvements after prompt, model or application changes.
* Contribute to repeatable AI evaluation datasets and scorecards.



 Research and Innovation
 


* Research developments in generative AI, machine learning and automation.
* Compare open\-source and commercial AI models for approved use cases.
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, libraries and development techniques.
* Prepare short technical summaries and demonstrations.
* Recommend tools based on capability, cost, security and scalability.
* Participate in internal innovation sessions and hackathons.
* Present prototype results to technical and business stakeholders.



 Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
 


* Prepare technical documentation for developed applications.
* Document architecture, data flows, prompts, APIs and configuration requirements.
* Create user guides and demonstration materials.
* Maintain source\-code comments and project README files.
* Present project progress during regular review meetings.
* Share lessons learned and reusable technical components with the team.
* Ensure another developer can understand, reproduce and maintain the completed work.



 Potential AI Use Cases at Teceze
 



 Interns may contribute to projects such as:
 


* AI\-powered IT service desk assistants
* Ticket classification and routing
* Incident summarization and resolution recommendations
* Knowledge\-base search assistants
* Customer\-support chatbots
* Automated proposal and statement\-of\-work generation
* Procurement quotation analysis
* Supplier and product comparison
* Recruitment résumé screening support
* Candidate\-to\-job matching
* Sales lead research and qualification
* Contract and document summarization
* Customer sentiment analysis
* Resource\-demand forecasting
* Engineer scheduling and dispatch optimization
* Predictive IT asset maintenance
* Security\-event analysis
* Employee productivity assistants
* Business intelligence and management reporting

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience building and deploying machine learning and Generative AI applications. You will contribute across the product lifecycle—from data preparation and experimentation to API development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines practical AI/ML knowledge with strong software\-engineering discipline and a demonstrated ability to build reliable enterprise\-grade solutions across multiple industries.
   

  

**What You Will Do**

* Create reproducible evaluation pipelines for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost; maintain regression or “golden” test datasets.
* Develop production services using Python, REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and well\-defined interfaces; write clean, modular, documented, and testable code.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, code review, issue tracking, and release management; implement CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and cloud services; contribute to Kubernetes\-based deployments, autoscaling, secrets management, observability, and rollback strategies as needed.

title: Engineer II - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 Cloud Support engineers at LPL run the cloud — they're the first humans on every ticket from an application team and the people who turn 'this happened again' into 'we automated it.' As Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll triage tickets, execute runbooks, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents inside the Support team, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support close at hand. If you want to learn AWS at a Tier 1 financial firm by running it for real with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on mid\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support LPL's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 production support for the AWS landing zone — the run\-the\-cloud function inside CCOE — alongside senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support. Day\-to\-day you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, execute and improve runbooks, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alert routing into ServiceNow and runbook execution, and you escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when the issue is beyond the Support team's remit. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in tickets, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self\-service paths.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs: own the ticket end\-to\-end if it's Tier 1 / Tier 2 scope, and escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when it's not
* Fulfill account / IAM / access requests for the landing zone and actively turn the repeatable ones into self\-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Execute and improve runbooks for known incident classes; pair with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to feed incident lessons back into durable monitoring and runbook improvements
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation, ServiceNow change\-record discipline, and verification of changes against the affected accounts and workloads
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage and routing, conversational self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests via MCP, runbook generation and lookup, and on\-call copilots that summarize recent telemetry and chat during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on experience working a production cloud operations or cloud support queue (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable ITSM): ticket triage SLAs, runbook execution, account / IAM / access\-request fulfillment, change\-window participation, and primary on\-call response


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: SOC Engineer - L2
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for designing and implementing security systems to protect the organization's computer networks from cyber\-attacks, and to help set and maintain security standards.
   

  

 This role is required to monitor the organization's computer networks for security issues, install security software, and document any security issues or breaches found.
   

  

 The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is responsible for assisting in the planning, implementation, and management of information security measures to safeguard the organization's digital assets and systems and contributes to maintaining a secure and compliant environment.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Monitors security alerts and events from various sources, investigates potential threats, and escalates incidents as necessary.
* Assists in the implementation and monitoring of security controls, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls.
* Performs regular vulnerability assessments, analyses scan results, and assists in prioritizing and remediating identified vulnerabilities.
* Supports the incident response team in investigating security incidents, documenting findings, and participating in remediation efforts.
* Assists in ensuring compliance with industry standards (for example, GDPR, ISO 27001\) by conducting assessments and implementing necessary controls.
* Installs security measures and operates software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and data encryption programs.
* Documents security breaches and assess the damage they cause.
* Works with the security team to perform tests and uncover network vulnerabilities.
* Fixes detected vulnerabilities to maintain a high\-security standard.
* Develops organizational best practices for IT security.
* Performs penetration testing and upgrades systems to unable security software.
* Installs and upgrades antivirus software and tests and evaluates new technology.
* Assists with the installation of security software and understands information security management.
* Researches security enhancements and makes recommendations to management.
* Stays abreast of information technology trends and security standards.
* Contributes to security awareness initiatives by creating training materials, conducting workshops, and educating employees about best security practices.
* Maintains accurate records of security incidents, assessments, and actions taken for reporting and audit purposes.
* Assists in the management and maintenance of security tools, including antivirus software, encryption tools, and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
* Participates in risk assessments to identify potential security threats, vulnerabilities, and associated risks to the organization.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams, IT, and other teams to ensure security measures are integrated into the organization's processes and projects.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**Knowledge and Attributes:**
* Good communication skills to effectively convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to prevent hacking on a network.
* Ability to identify and evaluate potential risks and to develop solutions.
* Ability to identify and mitigate network vulnerabilities and explain how to avoid them.
* Understands firewalls, proxies, SIEM, antivirus, and IDPS concepts.
* Understands patch management with the ability to deploy patches in a timely manner whilst understanding business impact.
* Developing proficiency with MAC and OS.
* Familiarity with security frameworks, standards, and regulations (for example, NIST, CIS, GDPR).
* Basic understanding of network and system architecture, protocols, and security controls.
* Ability to analyze security incidents and assess potential risks.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.


**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in information security, cybersecurity, computer science, or related.
* Security certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) are advantageous.


**Required Experience:**
* Moderate level of demonstrated experience in information security or cybersecurity, or related roles.
* Moderate level of demonstrated experience working in a global IT organization.
* Moderate level of demonstrated experience with computer network penetration testing and techniques.
* Moderate level of demonstrated experience with security assessment and vulnerability scanning tools.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer
description:
LSEG is seeking a
 **Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer** 
 to join our internal offensive security team with focus on driving closure of penetration testing findings. This role bridges offensive security and engineering by translating penetration test results into clear, actionable remediation guidance and partnering with application and platform teams to implement secure fixes. The successful candidate has a strong penetration testing or application security background, hands on remediation experience, and the ability to coordinate multiple collaborators to reduce risk at scale. This is a highly technical, delivery focused role with responsibility for both individual findings and systemic improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze and review penetration test reports to understand technical impact, exploitability, and business risk.
* Develop, document and maintain remediation guidance, patterns, and blue\-prints for common vulnerability types (e.g. injections, access control, auth, session management, misconfigurations).
* Provide consultation to application and platform teams on secure design and remediation approaches, including code\-level, configuration\-level and business\-level recommendations.
* Coordinate remediation activities across multiple teams, ensuring, clear ownership, agreed timelines, and risk\-based prioritization.
* Validate fixes by retesting vulnerabilities (manually and/or via tools/scripts) and updating the status of findings through closure.
* Manage and track the remediation backlog, including SLAs, aging finings, and critical issues when needed.
* Produce and maintain documentation on remediation processes, workflows, and controls for audit and compliance purposes.
* Prepare and deliver regular status reports and metrics on remediation progress, trends, and risk reduction to management and partners.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring or systemic issues and work with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to implement long\-term corrective actions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the pentest\-to\-remediation lifecycle, including automation, standardization and integration with SDLC/DevSecOps pipelines.
* Compile technical documents, track and document remediation metadata
+ Engagement details (who, what, when, where)
+ Testing team members and roles
+ Tools and methodologies used
+ Schedule and timelines
+ Target systems and environments
+ Constraints, exclusions, and limitations
+ Testing activities and event logs

* Contribute to team improvement efforts and ensure all initiatives and feedback are well documented for future references.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, tooling, automation.
* Stay ahead of with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security techniques.
* Participate in R\&D initiatives as guided from leadership.
* Support knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Proven hands\-on experience in penetration testing of Web Applications, APIs, Thick Client and Common Infrastructures (Active Directory, Cloud and Cloud\-native based environments).
* Proficiency with tools such as Burp Suite, common command\-line tools, and ability to write custom scripts when needed.
* Experience in automating pentesting tasks.
* Solid understanding of application security, network protocols, and operating systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and exposures (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25\) and secure coding practices in at least on major language stack (e.g. Java/Springboot, .NET, JavaScript/Node, Python)
* Ability to write clear, technical reports and communicate findings and fixes to both technical and non\-technical partners.
* Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments.
* Proficient communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
* Relevant certifications and engagement with the security community is a plus
* Threat Modelling experience is a plus.
* Proven track record of successfully managing and driving security engagements for various organizations with differing operational and technical profiles.
* Ability to identify, assess, and communicate technical and project risks to partners.


 Understanding project requirements and aligning work with agreed upon objectives and timelines.

title: Analyst II - Information Security
description:
**Role Description**
 Identity Security Engineer
   

  

 Function: Security Architecture \& Engineering
   

  

 Reports to: Identity Security Architect \& IGA Service Owner
   

  

 Location: India (Trivandrum, Bangalore or Hyderabad)
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 UST is looking for an Identity Security Engineer to own the engineering and operational delivery of identity security controls across the enterprise. Identity is UST's primary security control plane \-this role exists to make it robust, resilient, and difficult to abuse.
   

  

 This is not just an IGA administration role. The focus is security: closing identity\-based attack paths, enforcing least privilege, eliminating orphaned and over\-privileged accounts, securing non\-human and AI\-driven identities, and ensuring that identity signals are feeding detection and response. The platforms \- IGA, IAM, NHI controls are the means to that end.
   

  

 The engineer works directly under the Identity Security Architect \& IGA Service Owner and is the primary technical resource responsible for building, automating, and operating identity security controls across the full identity lifecycle. This is a build\-and\-operate role \- ownership includes both engineering delivery and the ongoing security integrity of what is built. The expectation is engineering\-led operations: automation\-first, security\-outcome\-focused, with continuous improvement built in.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* IGA \- Identity Lifecycle Security


 Engineer The IGA Platform To Enforce Secure Identity Lifecycle Controls. The Goal Is Not a Functioning Workflow Engine \- It Is Zero Orphaned Accounts, Enforced Least Privilege, And Audit\-ready Access Governance
   

  

* Build and automate Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver controls ensuring access is granted only when it should be, scoped correctly, and revoked without delay
* Engineer SoD rule enforcement and automated violation detection\- reducing the window between a violation occurring and being closed
* Implement access certification campaigns that are meaningful, not ceremonial \- right reviewers, right scope, automated remediation of uncertified access
* Build provisioning connectors with security controls embedded \- least privilege defaults, approval gates, and deprovisioning automation
* Engineer repeatable evidence collection for audit and compliance \- access reviews, provisioning logs, and certification completion rates
* Own platform change and release engineering \- ensuring changes are tested, controlled, and do not introduce access regressions
* IAM \- Authentication \& Access Security
* Engineer and harden IAM integrations across Entra ID and other identity providers \-with a focus on reducing authentication attack surface, not just enabling access
* Implement and validate federation and SSO configurations (SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC) \- including token security, claim scoping, and session controls
* Build and maintain SCIM provisioning integrations \- ensuring over\-provisioning is structurally prevented, not just periodically reviewed
* Engineer Conditional Access and identity protection policies \- risk\-based controls, not blanket policies
* Build automation for directory hygiene \- stale account detection, group membership enforcement, and privilege creep remediation
* Non\-Human Identity (NHI) Security
* Engineer controls to reduce the NHI attack surface \- service accounts, API keys, workload identities, bots, and automation credentials are a primary lateral movement vector and must be treated accordingly
* Build lifecycle governance for NHIs: ownership enforcement, automated rotation, and decommissioning \-eliminating the long\-lived, unowned credential as a risk class
* Integrate secrets vaults into application and workload pipelines \- replacing static credentials with dynamic, short\-lived secrets
* Implement workload identity federation for cloud\-native workloads \- removing the need for stored credentials entirely where possible
* Engineer detection for NHI abuse \- identifying stale, over\-privileged, or anomalously behaving machine identities before they are exploited
* AI \& Agentic Identity Security
* Implement security controls for AI agent and copilot identities \- scoped credentials, token lifecycle management, and enforced least privilege
* Build data access governance controls for AI pipelines \- ensuring AI systems access only what they need, with full auditability
* Engineer controls to prevent and detect API key sprawl, over\-permissioned AI service accounts, and credential misuse by AI systems
* Identity Threat Detection \& Response
* Engineer identity signal feeds into SIEM, UEBA, and EDR/XDR platforms \- ensuring identity events are visible and actionable in detection workflows
* Build and tune detection logic for identity\-based attack patterns: credential abuse, privilege escalation, service account misuse, and impossible travel
* Investigate identity\-related security events and support incident response \- tracing access paths, containing compromised identities, and remediating the root cause
* Proactively hunt for identity risk: over\-privileged accounts, dormant credentials, shadow access, and SoD violations
* Security Compliance \& Access Risk
* Engineer evidence collection and access review processes to support ISO 27001, SOC 2, and applicable regulatory requirements \- automated and repeatable, not manual and point\-in\-time
* Identify and close access risk gaps: orphaned accounts, excessive entitlements, SoD violations, and uncertified access
* Contribute to risk reporting by surfacing identity risk metrics \- not just activity logs
* Documentation \& Engineering Standards
* Maintain build documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures for all identity security controls owned
* Document integration patterns and security configuration standards to ensure consistency across the identity ecosystem
* Feed operational insight back to the Identity Security Architect \- surfacing gaps, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities from the engineering layer


**Required Experience**
* 5\+ years in IT/security, with at least 3 years in hands\-on identity security engineering \-not IAM administration
* Proven experience implementing enterprise IGA platforms \- SailPoint Or Savyint strongly preferred
* Practical experience with Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent IAM platforms \- security configuration, not helpdesk\-level administration
* Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and SCIM \- able to implement and troubleshoot, not just describe
* Experience securing non\-human identities \- service accounts, API keys, secrets vaults, workload identity
* Scripting or automation capability (PowerShell, Python, or equivalent) \- used to eliminate manual identity operations, not just run reports
* Understanding of identity\-based attack techniques: credential abuse, privilege escalation, lateral movement via service accounts
* Familiarity with Cloud IAM across at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience producing compliance evidence and supporting security audits


 What Good Looks Like
   

  

 The right person thinks like a security engineer who specialises in identity \- not an IAM engineer who handles security on the side. They understand how identity gets abused: credential theft, privilege escalation, lateral movement through service accounts, SoD bypass. They build controls with that threat model in mind, automate away the manual work, and feed signal back into detection. They are not waiting for the architect to tell them something is a risk they are finding it, flagging it, and fixing it.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* SailPoint Or Savyint certifications
* Experience with PAM platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Beyondtrust) and privileged access security controls
* Hands\-on experience with SIEM or UEBA platforms from an identity threat detection perspective
* Understanding of identity attack techniques \- MITRE ATT\&CK coverage across credential access, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
* Exposure to Zero Trust architecture and how identity security controls underpin it


**Skills**
 Identity governance and administration,zero trust security,powershell,python,scim,oidc,oauth 2\.0,

 Integrations \& System Awareness

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**



 Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
 





 This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI\-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
 





**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 The Senior Data Engineer owns the data ingestion, transformation, and quality infrastructure that forms the foundation of Artemis. The data layer is the first unlock for everything else on the product roadmap — nothing downstream in analytics, synthesis, or AI automation works without clean, well\-structured client data. Senior Data Engineers build and maintain pipelines that take raw commercial datasets \- media spend, impressions, sell\-out point\-of\-sale data, household panel data (e.g., Kantar, Numerator), retailer electronic point\-of\-sale feeds, and campaign performance data and transform them into structured, reliable inputs for Artemis's Bayesian marketing mix models and channel allocation analytics.
 





 This role requires both the engineering discipline to build production\-grade pipelines and enough domain understanding to design data models that accurately represent the commercial and marketing data Artemis works with.
 





**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Data Ingestion and Transformation
 
* Build and maintain pipelines that ingest, validate, and transform Artemis client datasets \- including media platform feeds (spend, impressions), sell\-out volumes, household panel data, and macro indicators — handling the full wrangling workflow from initial data diagnosis through mapping, transformation, and imputation to produce clean, model\-ready outputs.
* Design and implement ETL pipelines that are reliable, testable, and adaptable to the variety of data formats and naming conventions encountered across different client engagements.



 Data Quality
 
* Build the data quality assessment logic that validates completeness, consistency, format, and referential integrity across client datasets. Produce programmati
 
 c data quality reports that the consulting team and clients can act on.
* Ensure all data assets produced by Artemis pipelines conform to the shared Demand Generation Suite data model: structured, documented, and available via API to enable benchmarking and cross\-engagement analytics.



 Data Modeling and External Integrations
 
* Design and maintain adaptable data models that keep data structured, consistent, and accessible as business needs and the technology continue to evolve.
* Manage integrations with third\-party and Bain\-proprietary data sources used for enriching Artemis client datasets, including Nielsen, Circana, or GfK sell\-out data, Kantar or Numerator panel data, media platform APIs, macro data feeds (weather, holidays, inflation), and digital shelf data.
* Work closely with AI Engineers to ensure the data layer produces outputs that are reliably structured for large language model\-powered workflows.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies

* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.

**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical

title: Real-Time Graphics, GPU Physics & Vulkan Engineer
description:
Real\-Time Graphics, GPU Physics \& Vulkan Engineer
 
**Founding Engineering Team / Core LLD** 




**Compensation:** 
 ₹1,50,000 – ₹2,00,000 per month
 



**Engagement:** 
 Full\-time / Core Engineering Role
 



**Experience:** 
 Strong final\-year/postgraduate candidates with exceptional project experience, or engineers with approximately 2–5 years of relevant systems/graphics experience
 


 About the Role
 
 We are building a proprietary, ultra\-low\-latency real\-time virtual fitting and digital human engine from the ground up.
 



 We are looking for a highly capable
 **Real\-Time Graphics, GPU Physics \& Vulkan Engineer** 
 to join the Founding Engineering Team and work on the low\-level graphics, simulation, rendering, and character\-runtime architecture.
 



 This is a hands\-on systems engineering role for candidates who have built or meaningfully contributed to real graphics engines, GPU pipelines, physics simulations, rendering systems, research projects, or technically demanding thesis work.
 



 The system is being engineered for a hard performance target of:
 



**60 FPS with a total frame budget below 16\.6 ms on dedicated NVIDIA RTX hardware.** 



 What You Will Work On
 
 You will contribute to a real\-time pipeline involving:
 



**3D skeletal / body transforms → CUDA–Vulkan zero\-copy memory → Vulkan RHI → OpenRigLogic / MetaHuman runtime → GPU skeletal skinning → NVIDIA PhysX 5 / NvCloth → real\-time PBR rendering** 




 Your responsibilities will include:
 


 Character Runtime \& Animation
 * Build robust Modern C\+\+ loaders for MetaHuman DNA assets and skeletal hierarchies.
* Integrate OpenRigLogic / RigLogic into the runtime character pipeline.
* Drive character rigs using live skeletal joint rotations and transform data.
* Implement GPU\-based skeletal skinning and procedural body correctives.
* Optimize character deformation for extremely low latency.


 Vulkan Rendering \& GPU Systems
 * Maintain and extend a lightweight custom Vulkan C\+\+ rendering engine.
* Build low\-latency frame and memory\-management systems.
* Implement CUDA–Vulkan zero\-copy interoperability using shared GPU memory.
* Minimize unnecessary CPU–GPU data transfers.
* Work with Vulkan command buffers, descriptor sets, barriers, memory management, and synchronization.


 Real\-Time Cloth \& GPU Physics
 * Integrate NVIDIA PhysX 5 and NvCloth\-based cloth simulation.
* Implement dynamic fabric behavior including tension, shear, bending, gravity, and collision.
* Maintain cloth simulation within a strict real\-time GPU compute budget.
* Develop body–garment collision systems.
* Reduce cloth\-body clipping during real\-time character motion.


 Shader \& Rendering Pipeline
 * Develop and optimize GLSL / HLSL vertex, fragment, and compute shaders.
* Build physically based rendering pipelines for materials such as:
* Textile and micro\-fiber materials
* Silk
* Denim
* Human skin
* Implement efficient Level\-of\-Detail strategies.
* Optimize GPU workloads to maintain the 60 FPS performance target.


 Core Technical Stack
 
 We are particularly interested in candidates with hands\-on experience in:
 


* Modern C\+\+ — C\+\+17 / C\+\+20
* Vulkan
* DirectX 12
* CUDA
* GPU compute
* GLSL / HLSL
* NVIDIA PhysX 5
* NVIDIA NvCloth
* OpenRigLogic / MetaHuman DNA SDK
* GPU skeletal skinning
* PBR rendering
* 3D linear algebra
* Quaternions and dual quaternions
* Numerical simulation
* Multithreading and data\-oriented design


 Profiling \& Performance Tools
 
 Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued:
 


* NVIDIA Nsight Graphics
* NVIDIA Nsight Systems
* RenderDoc
* PIX



 You should be comfortable identifying GPU bottlenecks, pipeline stalls, synchronization issues, unnecessary memory transfers, and frame\-time spikes.
 


 What We Want to See
 
 Candidates should ideally be able to demonstrate relevant work through:
 


* GitHub repositories
* Custom Vulkan or DX12 engines
* Real\-time 3D renderers
* PBR implementations
* Compute\-based GPU pipelines
* Skeletal animation systems
* GPU skinning
* Blend\-shapes
* Character rigging systems
* Cloth or GPU physics simulations
* Position\-Based Dynamics
* Mass\-spring simulations
* CUDA kernels
* Compute shaders
* GPU optimization or profiling projects
* Research papers
* Thesis projects
* Production codebases



 We value
 **demonstrable engineering work more than keyword familiarity** 
 .
 


 Compensation \& Benefits
 
**Compensation:** 
 ₹1,50,000 – ₹2,00,000 per month.
 



 Additional benefits associated with the role include:
 


* Direct architectural guidance
* Technical code reviews
* Engineering mentorship and technical sparring with senior graphics leadership with NVIDIA / Sony experience
* Access to a dedicated high\-end workstation with discrete NVIDIA RTX hardware
* Opportunity to work on core architecture rather than peripheral application development
* Exposure to graphics, GPU physics, real\-time simulation, character systems, and performance\-critical engineering in one integrated platform


 Hiring Process
 
 Our hiring process is designed to focus on demonstrated engineering ability.
 



 Typical stages may include:
 



**1\. Application Review** 




 Review of your CV, GitHub, portfolio, research, thesis work, or relevant production projects.
 



**2\. Technical Portfolio / Project Discussion** 




 A detailed conversation about systems you have actually built, including architecture, performance constraints, technical decisions, and trade\-offs.
 



**3\. Core Technical Interview** 




 Discussion around Modern C\+\+, Vulkan / graphics APIs, GPU systems, rendering, skeletal animation, physics simulation, CUDA, synchronization, and performance optimization.
 



**4\. Practical Technical Assessment, if required** 




 Selected candidates may be asked to complete or discuss a focused engineering problem relevant to the role.
 



**5\. Final Technical / Founding Team Discussion** 




 Discussion around ownership, engineering approach, expectations, collaboration, and the role within the core team.
 



 The exact process may vary depending on the candidate's background and demonstrated experience.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Please send:
 


* Your CV / résumé
* GitHub profile
* Portfolio or technical website, if available
* Links to relevant projects, engines, repositories, demos, research, or thesis work
* A short description of the most technically challenging real\-time graphics, rendering, GPU, or simulation system you have worked on



 Candidates who can clearly demonstrate hands\-on systems\-level work will be prioritized.
 


 Applicant Privacy
 
 Information submitted during the recruitment process should be used only for evaluating your candidacy, communicating with you regarding the role, and managing the hiring process.
 



 Applicants should avoid submitting passwords, financial information, government identification numbers, or other unnecessary sensitive personal information with their initial application.
 



 Application materials may be reviewed by relevant members of the hiring and technical evaluation team.
 



 Where candidate information is retained for consideration for future opportunities, applicants should be informed in accordance with the organization's applicable recruitment and privacy practices.

 We are seeking a Numerical Algorithms \& Data Modeling Engineer with 2\-5 years of experience to design, implement, and evaluate algorithms that estimate position using sensor data or similar. This role sits at the intersection of numerical computing, geometric modeling, and applied inference. You will collaborate with experts across hardware, signal processing, and embedded systems to develop robust, real\-time algorithms for spaceborne platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**

* Build numerical and geometric models that account for measurement noise, sensor placement, timing and synchronisation errors, and signal characteristics.
* Work with signal processing engineers to derive relevant observables from sensor data and incorporate them into localisation formulations.
* Perform coordinate transformations between geodetic (WGS84\), Earth centered (ECEF), and local Cartesian frames, and reason about geometry, baselines, and localisation accuracy.
* Run simulation and Monte Carlo studies to characterise accuracy, sensitivity to error sources, and performance envelopes across representative mission scenarios.
* Validate algorithms on simulated and recorded RF data, including analysis of outliers, ambiguous solutions, and edge cases.
* Work closely with embedded and systems engineers to translate algorithms into implementable designs with realistic compute, latency, and memory constraints.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Aerospace, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in algorithm development for localisation, tracking, sensing, navigation, or related estimation problems.
* Strong foundation in probability, random processes, linear algebra, and optimisation.
* Hands\-on experience with Python and or MATLAB for numerical computing, simulation, and data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience taking at least one algorithm from concept or paper through simulation to validation on real world or lab data.
* Comfort working with spatial and coordinate based data, including 3D geometry and transformations.



  





**Preferred Skills and Experience** 



* Master’s degree or advanced coursework in signal processing, communication systems, estimation theory, or computational modeling.
* Experience with passive localisation, navigation, or tracking problems involving multiple sensors or platforms.
* Familiarity with uncertainty modeling and performance analysis such as error bounds, dilution of precision, error propagation, and Monte Carlo simulation.

title: Maker In Residence
description:
**Maker\-in\-Residence — The Deep\-Tech Foundry** 




  





**Raghu University \| Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site** 




  





  





**About Us** 




  





 Raghu University is a newly formed Deemed to Be University in Visakhapatnam, founded by an entrepreneur who also built a 300\-person enterprise SaaS company serving clients across 12 countries.
 



  





 The Deep\-Tech Foundry is where students take ideas from screen to physical product. We’re setting up a prototyping lab with 3D printers, PCB fabrication, soldering stations, CNC machines, and edge AI hardware. The goal: student projects that become startups with real, shippable hardware products.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




  





 A student team has an idea for a water quality monitoring device for aquaculture farms. They can write the software. But who helps them design the enclosure, fabricate the PCB, solder the sensor array, 3D\-print the housing, and CNC\-mill the mounting bracket? Who turns their screen mockup into something a farmer can hold in their hands?
 



  





**That’s you.** 




  





 The Maker\-in\-Residence runs the prototyping lab inside The Foundry. Your job is to help student teams go from working code to working hardware — the kind you can demo to a customer, pitch to an investor, or ship to a first user. You’re not maintaining equipment for a college lab. You’re building an environment where student hardware startups are born.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





 • Mentor student teams on hardware prototyping end\-to\-end: concept → CAD → 3D print / CNC → electronics design → PCB fabrication → assembly → working prototype
 



 • Help teams design and fabricate custom PCBs — schematic, layout, fabrication, soldering, testing, iteration
 



 • Run 3D printing operations: help students prepare CAD files, select materials, optimise prints, troubleshoot failures
 



 • Guide CNC operations when needed (we have CNC specialists on campus — you coordinate with them for student projects that require milling)
 



 • Bridge hardware and software: help teams integrate sensors, microcontrollers, and edge AI devices into physical products. A trained AI model is useless until it lives inside something a user can touch.
 



 • Push teams toward startup\-grade prototypes, not science fair demos: “This can’t have exposed wires if you’re demoing to a customer. Let’s design a proper enclosure.”
 



 • Manage the prototyping lab: inventory, consumables (filament, solder, components, PCB substrates), equipment maintenance, workspace organisation
 



 • Conduct safety inductions: soldering, 3D printing, ESD protection, workshop discipline
 



 • Participate in weekly standups and monthly Demo Days — help teams present hardware that works, not just slides about hardware
 



  





  





**What You Won’t Do** 




  





 • Sit in a storeroom waiting for requests
 



 • Teach lectures or grade lab exams
 



 • Fill out equipment utilisation reports
 



 • Manage CNC operations (we have dedicated specialists for that)
 



 • Report to any academic department
 



  





  





**Who You Are** 




  





 • You’ve built physical products — not just one\-off prototypes, but things that were designed to be used by someone. You have photos or videos to show.
 



 • You’ve designed and fabricated PCBs: schematic to layout to working board. KiCad, Eagle, or Altium.
 



 • You’re comfortable with 3D printing (FDM). Slicing, material selection, troubleshooting.
 



 • You can solder confidently — through\-hole and basic SMD
 



 • You understand embedded systems: Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or similar. Firmware, datasheets, serial communication.
 



 • You know what CNC can do and when to use it, even if you’re not operating the machine yourself
 



 • You think in terms of “is this ready to show a customer?” not just “does it work on the bench?”
 



 • You’re patient with beginners but push advanced teams toward production\-grade quality
 



 • 2–6 years in hardware prototyping, product engineering, electronics design, or a hardware startup
 



  





  





**Nice to Have** 




  





 • Experience at a hardware startup where you took a product from prototype to manufacturing
 



 • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or other edge AI deployment platforms
 



 • DFM (Design for Manufacturing) awareness — helping teams think about how their prototype becomes a product
 



 • CAD expertise (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, FreeCAD)
 



 • Enclosure design for electronics products
 



 • Experience running or working in a makerspace or prototyping lab
 



 • Sensor integration for IoT / industrial / agriculture applications
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 




  





 • Compensation commensurate with experience
 



 • A prototyping lab you help set up from scratch — you’ll shape the layout, workflow, and culture
 



 • A team around you: software mentoring, GTM strategy, and operations are handled by others. You own hardware prototyping.
 



 • The chance to help student teams build hardware startups — not just projects, but products
 



 • Visakhapatnam — India’s emerging AI capital. A growing tech ecosystem and a city that’s genuinely pleasant to live in.
 



  





  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Send to ceo@akriviahcm.com:
 



 1\. Photos or videos of hardware you’ve built (mandatory)
 



 2\. A few lines on: what’s the most complete physical product you’ve taken from idea to working prototype?
 



 3\. Why helping students turn projects into products sounds like your kind of work
 



  





 No formal resume needed. Show us what you’ve made.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager / Associate Product Manager**
**Turn messy real\-world problems into simple products.**
 AbleCredit builds software for complex enterprise workflows where AI, APIs, business rules, human decisions, and real\-world operations have to work together reliably. We care about building products that work in production \- not just in demos. Our customers don't arrive with clean product requirements. They have operational problems involving people, policies, existing systems, edge cases, and workflows built over years. Product at AbleCredit means understanding that complexity deeply and turning it into reusable, simple product capabilities.
   

  

**What You'll Own?**
* Spend time with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, constraints, and the real problem behind requests.
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering and design from discovery through rollout rather than handing off specifications.
* Prioritize based on customer impact, product strategy, effort, risk, and reuse across customers.
* Define success metrics and evaluate whether shipped products actually improve the workflow.
* Own launches, feedback loops, adoption, and iteration after release.
* Identify patterns across customer requests and turn them into reusable platform capabilities instead of one\-off customizations.
* Maintain clarity on what we are building, why we are building it, and what we deliberately are not building.


**What We're Looking For?**
* 1\-5 years of product, engineering, analytics, consulting, operations, or adjacent experience; level will be calibrated to experience.
* Strong problem decomposition and structured thinking.
* Ability to understand technical systems, APIs, data flows, and constraints well enough to work deeply with engineers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Comfort speaking with customers and asking detailed questions until the underlying workflow is understood.
* Bias toward evidence, prototypes, and shipped outcomes rather than process for its own sake.
* Ability to operate with ambiguity and make sensible trade\-offs.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, workflow products, fintech, or AI\-assisted products.
* Technical background or prior engineering experience.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, analytics, or operational products.
* Experience taking a product from discovery through adoption.


**How Product Works Here?**
 Product managers are expected to understand the problem deeply, not act as ticket routers. The best solution may be a new feature, a platform primitive, a workflow change, an API, or deciding not to build something. Success is measured by customer and product outcomes, not PRD volume.
   

  

 Skills:\- Product Management, Product Discovery, Problem Definition, Requirement Analysis, Problem Decomposition, Structured Thinking, User Research, Customer Research, Customer Workflow Understanding, Product Strategy, Prioritization, User Journey, Workflow Mapping, Product Requirement Documentation, Wireframing, Prototyping, Data\-Driven Decision, Product Metrics, Success Metrics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, A/B Testing, Agile/Scrum, Stakeholder management, Collaboration, Product launch, Adoption, Feedback Loops, Iteration, Enterprise Product Management and Workflow Product Management

title: Generalist - Ops, Product & GTM
description:
**Homeie is building the consumer company for where you live.** 




  






 The first product is the smartest way to rent a home in India. You tell Homeie what matters once, and our AI understands your taste, searches and coordinates across a fragmented offline market, helps you see only the homes actually worth considering, and gets the transaction done, including ₹0 security deposit upfront. What takes weeks today should eventually feel like one really good afternoon.
 




  






 But renting is only where we enter the relationship. Where you live quietly shapes a huge part of your life: how you commute, where you spend, which neighbourhood you become part of, how much you pay every month, and eventually where you choose to buy a home. We think AI makes it possible to build an entirely new consumer experience around that relationship, one that becomes more useful the longer someone stays with Homeie.
 




  






 Over time, Homeie should help you rent a home, understand your housing history, know what matters around where you live, make every move easier than the last, and eventually help you buy your first home.
 




  






 We’ve raised 
 
**$750k** 

  from a stealth fund, whose backers include Abstract Ventures, Bain Capital and Long Journey. We are still a very small team, which means the people joining now will have an absurd amount of influence over what Homeie becomes.
 




  





 What will you do:
 


* Figure out how we get our first few hundred renters. Reddit, offices, partnerships, classifieds, referrals, going on the ground, weird hacks nobody has tried. Whatever works.
* Figure out where the best supply actually comes from, how we work with those people, what incentives make sense, and how we consistently get great homes when a renter shows up.
* Spending time on the ground with renters, brokers and partners instead of forming opinions from a spreadsheet.
* Work with engineering and product to turn things we repeatedly do manually into software.
* Figure out how we win one small part of Gurgaon, then turn that into the playbook for the next 50 markets.



  





 Who we're looking for:
 


* I don’t care too much about pedigree. This is probably a good fit if you have repeatedly found yourself taking ownership of things nobody formally gave you, enjoy switching between thinking and doing, are comfortable speaking to customers in the morning and working through a product flow at night, and care a lot about the quality of what eventually reaches the user.
* You could be 21 and have never had a proper job; you could have spent two years at Bain; you could have tried building a company, worked at an early\-stage startup, or done something completely unrelated.
* You should enjoy messy problems. A lot of things here will not have an obvious answer yet.
* We’re very early. You’ll be one of the first people building Homeie, and will have an unreasonable amount of ownership from day one.
