title: AI Product Manager – Creative Engine
description:
**AI Product Manager – Creative Engine** 




**Focus:** 
 Copywriting and Media Generation
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, India
 



**Work arrangement:** 
 5 days a week from office
 



**Experience:** 
 3–6 years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Head of Product / Creative Engine Lead
   




 About the role
 
 We are building a Creative Engine that helps brands produce high\-quality, on\-brand content at scale\-from marketing copy and campaign concepts to images and other media.
 



  





 The platform brings together brand intelligence, creative briefs, generative AI models, reusable characters and visual identities, batch generation, review workflows, and human creative judgment. Our goal is not simply to generate more content. It is to help teams consistently create content that is relevant, distinctive, safe, and ready to use.
 



  





 We are looking for an AI Product Manager to own the content\-generation experience across two core areas:
 


* **Copy generation:** 
 Campaign concepts, headlines, captions, scripts, descriptions, marketing copy, and content variations for various communication channels like Email, SMS, Push, Whatsapp etc.
* **Media generation:** 
 Images and, over time, video, audio, avatars, and other emerging formats.



 You will define how users move from an idea or creative brief to approved content—and how AI models, creative controls, evaluation systems, and human review come together throughout that journey.
   




 What you will own
 * The product strategy and roadmap for AI\-powered copywriting and media generation.
* Workflows that translate campaign and creative briefs into structured generation experiences.
* User journeys for generating, refining, comparing, reviewing, and approving content.
* The use of brand guidelines, product information, audience context, campaign objectives, and previous creative work to improve output quality.
* Consistency of characters, products, environments, visual styles, and brand identities across creative assets.
* Creative controls that give users meaningful direction without requiring prompt\-engineering expertise.
* Iteration capabilities such as rewriting, regenerating, expanding, shortening, restyling, localizing, resizing, and creating variations.
* Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows for feedback, approval, versioning, and export.
* Model selection and orchestration based on quality, speed, cost, reliability, format, and use case.
* Evaluation systems for brand alignment, creative quality, factual accuracy, visual consistency, safety, and usability.
* Generation reliability, latency, failure recovery, observability, and cost efficiency.
* Product requirements related to content safety, copyright, consent, data privacy, and responsible AI.


 Key responsibilities
 * Develop and execute the product roadmap for AI\-powered copy and media creation.
* Conduct regular research with marketers, creative teams, designers, copywriters, agencies, and brand managers.
* Identify high\-value creative workflows and translate them into clear product requirements.
* Work closely with design, engineering, applied AI, data, creative, legal, and go\-to\-market teams.
* Evaluate foundation models and specialist AI providers through structured testing and experimentation.
* Collaborate with the AI team on prompts, context management, model routing, guardrails, configuration, and fallback behaviour.
* Build evaluation datasets and feedback loops using automated measures and human creative review.
* Define and track metrics for adoption, output quality, acceptance, iteration time, retention, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Run experiments that increase the percentage of generated content users can confidently publish.
* Balance rapid experimentation with the reliability required from a production creative platform.
* Communicate product decisions, trade\-offs, results, and learnings clearly across the organisation.
* Stay current with developments in language, image, video, audio, and multimodal generation.


 What success looks like
 
 The primary measure of success is not generation volume. It is the creation of useful, approved content with less time and effort.
 



 Success will be measured through outcomes such as:
 


* Reduced time from creative brief to first usable output.
* Higher percentage of generations accepted, shortlisted, approved, or exported.
* Fewer iterations required to reach a publishable result.
* Stronger brand, product, and character consistency.
* Improved copy relevance, factual accuracy, and tone adherence.
* Increased adoption and repeat usage of generation workflows.
* Higher generation reliability and lower end\-to\-end latency.
* Reduced model and infrastructure cost per approved asset.
* Low rates of safety, compliance, or intellectual\-property incidents.


 What we are looking for
 * 3–6 years of product\-management experience, preferably in AI/ML, creative technology, marketing technology, SaaS, or content platforms.
* Understanding on Workflow tools.
* Experience taking complex products from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Practical understanding of generative AI, including LLMs, image models, prompting, context management, model evaluation, and human feedback.
* Strong judgment about the difference between technically impressive output and genuinely usable creative work.
* Experience working closely with designers, engineers, data or ML teams, and customer\-facing functions.
* Ability to turn ambiguous creative workflows into simple and coherent product experiences.
* Strong analytical skills and experience defining measurable product outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving environment where model capabilities, user expectations, and constraints evolve quickly.


 Good to have
 * Experience building copywriting, design, campaign\-management, digital\-asset\-management, or media\-generation products.
* Familiarity with image or video\-generation concepts such as reference conditioning, character consistency, inpainting, outpainting, style control, and upscaling.
* Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, brand knowledge systems, or structured content pipelines.
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks for subjective or creative output.
* Knowledge of advertising workflows, localization, channel\-specific creative requirements, and creative performance.
* Understanding of AI safety, copyright, likeness and consent management, provenance, and enterprise data governance.
* A strong personal interest in writing, visual storytelling, filmmaking, design, advertising, or another creative discipline.


 The kind of PM who will thrive here
 
 You are curious about AI but not distracted by novelty. You understand that excellent creative tools combine model capability with taste, context, control, and thoughtful workflows.
 



 You can discuss model trade\-offs with an AI engineer, critique a campaign with a creative director, understand a marketer’s operational constraints, and turn these perspectives into focused product decisions.
 



 Most importantly, you care about helping people produce better creative work—not merely generate more of it.

title: Product Manager (Growth - B2B Enterprise)
description:
**The Opportunity**
*This position is based in Adobe India’s Bangalore office; You should be able to work in a hybrid model needing to come into the office at least 3 days in a week.*
 The group passionate about Enterprise Growth (within Adobe’s Unified Platform organization) is seeking a Product Manager. This role will own Product\-Led Growth (PLG) across our B2B Enterprise business and turn end\-user demand into enterprise\-wide adoption. Our team is building new ways to bring enterprise customers into Adobe beyond traditional sales and marketing motions, workflows that channel individual product usage into broader enterprise adoption, pairing free product access and personalized onboarding with in\-product signals that point our sales team to the next upsell opportunity.
   

  

 In this position, you will own and drive PLG initiatives. These initiatives turn grassroots, end\-user demand into enterprise\-wide adoption. You'll partner with cross\-functional teams in engineering, building, analytics, and go\-to\-market to define and ship impactful product experiences.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 This role fits someone in product management beyond entry\-level execution. They are ready for increased ownership and growth toward the senior PM level. You'll have meaningful autonomy, the opportunity to drive real impact, and strong mentorship along the way.
   

  

* Own the roadmap and prioritization for turning end\-user demand into enterprise\-wide adoption — from onboarding and activation through the signals that flag an account as ready to expand.
* Turn hunches into structured experiments — write test charters, run A/B tests, and use the results to make the call on what ships next.
* Dig into dashboards, funnel data, and usage signals to find where the biggest opportunities sit and confirm that shipped features are actually moving the needle.
* Work closely with go\-to\-market, technical, creative, and analytics teams to bring features to market. These features drive enterprise acquisition and revenue. They can also be reused across other Adobe product lines.
* Be the customer advocate every step of the way — help the entire product team see what makes the difference between just another feature and a customer delight!


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–5\+ years experience, with a track record of shepherding initiatives from idea through launch. Experience in a growth or data\-heavy role is a plus.
* Experience driving growth directly from the product is important, ideally with free, freemium, trial, or conversion models. You understand what motivates users to pay. You have shipped features that demonstrate this.
* A natural inclination toward data with ability to define what success looks like and using the numbers to steer prioritization and strategy.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required — an MBA or related master's degree is a plus, not a mandate.
* Experience with AI: We seek a candidate experienced in building or working with AI\-powered features or products. The candidate should also be eager to keep learning and growing in this area.


**Our Company**
 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone — from emerging artists to global brands — everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
   

  

 We believe in hiring the best and are committed to crafting exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity.
   

  

**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
   

  

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Who are we?**
 Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go\-to\-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own product outcomes across our domain registration platforms. This is a multi\-platform role: your decisions affect retail customers buying their first domain, resellers who build businesses on our APIs, and registry partners who hold us to hard compliance deadlines. You will take initiatives from discovery through delivery and adoption, and you will carry domain operations responsibility alongside product work.
   

  

 You will join a small, product team where AI fluency is a first\-class skill. We build with AI tools daily and expect you to do the same.
   

  

**What you’ll do \& how you’ll make your mark.**
* Own domain registration, renewal, transfer, and expiry journeys across retail and wholesale platforms, and drive platform consolidation and portfolio migration initiatives.
* Translate registry and regulatory mandates (identity verification, KYC, data protection, country\-code TLD policy) into product requirements and deliver them against immovable external deadlines.
* Run domain operations: registry pricing changes, TLD launches and sunsets, registrar credential management, and coordination with registry partners.
* Improve the platforms and APIs that thousands of resellers integrate with programmatically, writing requirements that hold up for partners, not just end customers.
* Run structured voice\-of\-customer discovery with retail customers and reseller partners, turning support themes, churn signals, and partner feedback into a prioritized roadmap.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, pricing, and go\-to\-market for new domain products such as protection, security, aftermarket, and premium domains.
* Contribute to fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across purchase and account flows.
* Build prototypes and simple working tools with AI coding agents to validate ideas and de\-risk decisions before engineering investment.


**What Success Looks Like In Your First Year**
* You own two to three initiatives end to end, with requirements engineering trusts and stakeholders you keep aligned without escalation.
* Voice\-of\-customer inputs from your discovery work visibly shape the domains roadmap.
* Registry partners and internal teams treat you as the answerable owner for your platforms.


**Who you are \& what you’ll need to succeed.**
**Must Have**
* 4 to 7 years of product management experience on platforms, marketplaces, APIs, or transactional products.
* AI fluency as a daily working practice: you use AI agents and coding tools such as Claude Code to research, analyze, and build, not just to draft text.
* Ability to code: you can build prototypes and simple working applications yourself to test ideas, demo flows, and answer questions before committing engineering time.
* Data fluency: you can size an opportunity and defend a prioritization call with numbers.
* Strong written requirements; engineering teams across time zones will build from your documents.
* Proven ability to run multiple concurrent initiatives with different stakeholders and deadlines without dropping threads.
* Comfort with compliance\-driven work: legal and policy constraints, and decisions made with incomplete data where risks are explicit.


**Nice To Have**
* Domain industry, hosting, or registrar/registry experience.
* Experience with B2B2C or channel/reseller business models.
* Exposure to payments, fraud, or identity verification products.


**Why This Role?**
 Real ownership of a global portfolio at meaningful scale, direct exposure to registries and international partners, and a team that treats product craft and AI fluency as career accelerants.
   

  

**Why you’ll love us.**
* We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\- home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold

title: Product Management & Design Intern – Global AI-Native Talent Intelligence Venture (Fully Remote)
description:
We are looking for a Product Management \& Design Intern to help shape the future of our AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform serving customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East.
 



 This is not a routine internship.
 



 You will work closely with founders, product leaders, customers, and internal stakeholders while helping improve product experiences, optimize user journeys, gather customer feedback, validate ideas, and support the evolution of our platform.
 



 From day one, you will gain exposure to how modern SaaS and AI\-powered products are designed, validated, launched, and continuously improved based on customer needs, user behavior, and business outcomes.
 



 We are seeking individuals who enjoy problem\-solving, user experience design, product thinking, customer interaction, and building products that create meaningful value. You will be trusted with real responsibilities, ownership, and opportunities to contribute directly to product and customer experience initiatives.
 


 About SkillsCapital
 
 SkillsCapital is an AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform helping organizations discover, evaluate, and deploy specialized technology talent across SAP, Cloud, AI/ML, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data, and Enterprise Technology domains.
 



 We work with customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East, helping consulting firms, technology companies, startups, and enterprise organizations access highly specialized technology talent and teams.
 



 Over the past year, we have successfully built and scaled our AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform, expanded our customer base across multiple international markets, and established a profitable, bootstrapped business serving global clients. We are now entering the next phase of growth as we continue to expand our platform capabilities, strengthen our product offering, and scale our global operations.
 



 SkillsCapital is led by a team with deep experience across enterprise technology, global consulting, talent, and high\-growth technology businesses. The founding and advisory team brings experience from IBM, Accenture, PwC, Deloitte, Trilogy, and ESW Capital.
 



 Our leadership team includes alumni from The Wharton School, London Business School, IIT Delhi, IIIT Hyderabad, and BITS Pilani, bringing together expertise across technology, product development, business strategy, talent intelligence, and global operations.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 • Work closely with founders and product leadership to improve user experiences across the platform
 



 • Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer, prospect, and stakeholder feedback
 



 • Assist in defining user journeys, workflows, wireframes, and product requirements
 



 • Conduct product research, competitive analysis, and market intelligence activities
 



 • Support UI/UX initiatives focused on improving usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction
 



 • Collaborate with engineering, operations, customer success, and business teams to translate requirements into product enhancements
 



 • Assist in validating new features, workflows, and product concepts before launch
 



 • Participate in customer discovery sessions, feedback meetings, and user interviews
 



 • Create product documentation, user guides, release notes, and feature specifications
 



 • Support product demonstrations, walkthroughs, and platform presentations for prospects and customers
 



 • Help create product demo environments, use cases, and customer scenarios
 



 • Monitor product usage patterns, adoption metrics, and customer behavior to generate actionable insights
 



 • Contribute to product roadmap discussions and continuous improvement initiatives
 


 Candidate Profile
 
 We are looking for individuals who:
 



 • Are final\-year students, recent graduates, or early\-career professionals
 



 • Have strong communication and problem\-solving skills
 



 • Are naturally curious about technology, AI, SaaS products, startups, and user experience
 



 • Enjoy understanding customer problems and designing practical solutions
 



 • Are comfortable interacting with customers, prospects, and business stakeholders
 



 • Have strong analytical and critical\-thinking abilities
 



 • Are interested in Product Management, UX Design, Product Operations, Customer Experience, or Product Marketing careers
 



 • Are organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
 



 Previous experience with Figma, wireframing tools, product research, prototyping, customer\-facing activities, startup projects, or product development initiatives is an advantage but not required.
 


 What You'll Gain

title: Product Designer
description:
We're looking for a
 **Product Designer** 
 who can design products that are intuitive, polished, and enjoyable to use.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll only create screens in Figma. You'll own the visual experience across the product and marketing. From dashboards and web apps to landing pages and product visuals.
 



  





 A big part of this role is creating
 **product illustrations** 
 : stylized graphics built using interface elements like cards, windows, charts, buttons, and other UI components. Think premium SaaS websites where the product itself becomes the visual language.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can think through problems, simplify complexity, and create designs that are both beautiful and functional.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



* Designing web applications, dashboards, and product interfaces
* Designing landing pages and marketing websites
* Creating product illustrations and feature visuals using interface components
* Building and maintaining design systems
* Collaborating closely with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation
* Iterating quickly based on user feedback and product direction
* Occasionally creating visuals for product launches, announcements, and social media



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Strong proficiency in Figma
* Strong UI, UX, and visual design fundamentals
* Experience designing modern SaaS products
* Ability to create premium product illustrations using interface elements rather than traditional illustrations
* Strong understanding of typography, spacing, layout, color, and visual hierarchy
* Experience designing responsive interfaces
* Good communication skills and strong ownership



  





 A strong portfolio matters far more than years of experience. We'd much rather see real work than tutorial recreations.
 



  





 Freshers are welcome if your portfolio demonstrates exceptional design ability.
 



  





**Nice to have** 



* Motion design (Jitter, Rive, After Effects)
* Basic HTML \& CSS knowledge
* Branding experience
* Experience designing AI or SaaS products
* Understanding of marketing and conversion\-focused design



  





**Compensation** 




**₹30,000–₹60,000 per month** 




 Based on skill, speed, quality of work, and level of independence.
 



 One\-month probation at ₹20,000\.
 



  





**Work setup** 



* Full\-time
* Remote
* 8 hours per day
* 6 days a week



  





**How to apply** 




 Please send us:
 


* Your resume
* Portfolio
* Figma profile (if available)
* A short note explaining what you were responsible for in each project



  





 Applications should be sent to
 **hr@appexflow.com** 
 .
 



  





 We review every application ourselves. AI\-generated applications will be rejected. We'd rather see how
 *you* 
 think than what ChatGPT can generate.

title: UX/UI Design Intern | Global AI-Native Talent Intelligence Venture (Fully Remote)
description:
We are looking for a UI/UX Intern to help shape the user experience and interface design of our AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform serving customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East.
 



 This is not a routine design internship.
 



 You will work closely with founders, product leaders, engineers, customers, and business stakeholders while helping design intuitive workflows, user journeys, dashboards, customer portals, and AI\-powered product experiences.
 



 From day one, you will gain exposure to how modern SaaS and AI\-powered products are researched, designed, tested, and continuously improved through customer feedback, product analytics, and iterative design.
 



 We are seeking individuals who enjoy understanding user behavior, solving complex problems, creating intuitive experiences, and designing products that deliver measurable value for customers. You will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities, ownership, and opportunities to directly influence product experiences used by global customers.
 


 About SkillsCapital
 
 SkillsCapital is an AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform helping organizations discover, evaluate, and deploy specialized technology talent across SAP, Cloud, AI/ML, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data, and Enterprise Technology domains.
 



 We work with customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East, helping consulting firms, technology companies, startups, and enterprise organizations access highly specialized technology talent and teams.
 



 Over the past year, we have successfully built and scaled our AI\-powered Talent Intelligence platform, expanded our customer base across multiple international markets, and established a profitable, bootstrapped business serving global clients. We are now entering the next phase of growth as we continue to expand our platform capabilities, strengthen our product offering, and scale our global operations.
 



 SkillsCapital is led by a team with deep experience across enterprise technology, global consulting, talent, and high\-growth technology businesses. The founding and advisory team brings experience from IBM, Accenture, PwC, Deloitte, Trilogy, and ESW Capital.
 



 Our leadership team includes alumni from The Wharton School, London Business School, IIT Delhi, IIIT Hyderabad, and BITS Pilani, bringing together expertise across technology, product development, business strategy, talent intelligence, and global operations.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 • Design intuitive and visually engaging user interfaces across web applications, dashboards, customer portals, and platform workflows
 



 • Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs for new and existing product features
 



 • Work closely with founders, product teams, engineers, and users to understand business requirements and customer needs
 



 • Conduct user research, usability studies, competitive analysis, and feedback reviews to identify design opportunities
 



 • Improve customer journeys and optimize experiences across multiple product touchpoints
 



 • Design workflows and experiences that simplify complex user interactions
 



 • Contribute to the evolution of the platform's design system, visual language, and user experience standards
 



 • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate implementation of designs
 



 • Create and maintain reusable design components and UI patterns
 



 • Analyze user behavior, engagement trends, and feedback to improve usability and adoption
 



 • Participate in product discussions, design reviews, and feature planning sessions
 



 • Support product demonstrations and customer feedback sessions by helping communicate design decisions and user experience improvements
 


 Candidate Profile
 
 We are looking for individuals who:
 



 • Are final\-year students, recent graduates, or early\-career professionals
 



 • Are passionate about UI Design, UX Design, Product Design, and customer experience
 



 • Have experience using Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools
 



 • Are naturally curious about user behavior, product experiences, and design thinking
 



 • Have strong visual communication skills and attention to detail
 



 • Are interested in technology, AI, SaaS products, startups, and digital experiences
 



 • Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly
 



 • Are interested in building a career in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or Customer Experience
 



 Portfolio projects, personal design work, freelance assignments, hackathons, academic projects, or startup experience are valuable but not mandatory.
 


 What You'll Gain
 
 • Hands\-on experience designing a real AI\-powered SaaS platform used by global customers
 



 • Exposure to UI Design, UX Research, Design Systems, Customer Experience, and Product Strategy
 



 • Experience working alongside founders, product leaders, engineers, and customers
 



 • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful product experiences with real business impact
 



 • Exposure to AI\-powered products, enterprise technology, and modern SaaS platforms
 



 • Opportunity to build a strong portfolio of real\-world design work
 



 • A fast\-paced learning environment with meaningful ownership and responsibility
 



 • Potential consideration for future full\-time opportunities based on performance
 


 Compensation \& Benefits
 
 • Monthly stipend
 



 • Performance\-based incentives
 



 • Mentorship from experienced technology and business leaders
 



 • Significant learning and career development opportunities
 



 • Exposure to global customers, markets, and product initiatives
 



 If you are passionate about design, user experience, technology, and problem\-solving, and are looking for an opportunity to learn how modern SaaS products are designed and scaled, we would love to hear from you.

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost\-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

 Join our EDA team and work on cutting\-edge compiler technologies and optimizations that power the next generation of chip design. Based in Noida, you'll collaborate with global teams to develop innovative software solutions while gaining exposure to diverse projects across India and beyond. * Develop and optimize compiler solutions and tools using C/C\+\+ on UNIX/LINUX platforms
* Design and implement efficient algorithms and data structures for EDA applications
* Apply compiler concepts and optimization techniques to enhance software performance
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices
* Test, debug, and refine software components to meet quality standards

* Strong understanding of C/C\+\+ programming, including design patterns, data structures, and algorithms, with hands\-on development experience on UNIX/Linux platforms.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-functional teams in a collaborative environment


**Good to Have**
* Knowledge of ML/AI algorithms for data\-driven applications
* Familiarity with Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL
* Understanding of compiler concepts and optimization techniques
* Previous exposure to EDA tools or electronic design workflows

 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.  Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer (Frontend\-heavy Full Stack)** 
**Role Overview**
**Role:** 
 Software Engineer
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2\+ Years
   

  

**Team:** 
 Converse Engineering
   

  

**Primary Skillset:** 
 Frontend\-heavy full stack; real\-time, event\-driven interfaces
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore, Karnataka, India
   

  

 You will own product surfaces end to end: from design and implementation to production operation and debugging. The weight is on the frontend, but you are expected to build and own the APIs behind your own features.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Converse is LeadSquared's conversation platform. It comprises the agent\-facing chat applications and the underlying channel layer that delivers messages across an expanding portfolio of communication channels.
   

  

 Converse is shared infrastructure. Several LeadSquared products depend on it for message delivery, including products unrelated to chat. As a result, interface contracts, backward compatibility, and availability are first\-order concerns.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Build and own agent\-facing interfaces that are live and event\-driven, with several conversations in flight at once.
* Build the internal configuration and authoring tools that determine how quickly a new customer or provider can be brought online.
* Build customer\-facing web surfaces, including those carrying consent and privacy requirements.
* Turn dense operational data into interfaces that people use to make decisions.
* Write and own the APIs behind your own features.
* Instrument the frontend for production diagnosis through error tracking, performance monitoring, and real\-user metrics.
* Work within a micro\-frontend architecture embedded inside the CRM.
* Operate your work in production, debugging issues with Product, QA, and DevOps.


**Expected Candidate Profile**
* 2\+ years of experience building production frontend applications used by real users.
* Strong React and TypeScript skills, including hooks, component composition, and state management, along with a working understanding of rendering behaviour and performance.
* Experience building real\-time or event\-driven UIs using technologies and patterns such as WebSockets, SSE, and optimistic updates, with an understanding of correctness when events arrive out of order.
* Strong CSS and layout skills for dense, information\-heavy interfaces.
* Enough backend experience, in any language, to build and own the API behind your own feature.
* Ability to debug across the browser, network, and service boundary.
* Sound problem\-solving and data structures fundamentals.
* Accountability for code you did not write by hand, including code produced with AI assistance.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with micro\-frontend architecture, module federation, or embedding an application inside another product.
* Experience building or contributing to a shared component library or design system.
* Experience with Preact, Signals, or other fine\-grained reactivity models.
* Experience with Web Workers, rendering performance, or bundle and load\-time optimisation.
* Experience with data visualisation or dense dashboard and table interfaces.
* Experience with accessibility and internationalisation.
* Experience with Node.js/TypeScript or Java backend development.
* Experience with messaging or communication platforms, or other integration\-heavy SaaS products.


**Technology Environment**
**Frontend**
 React 18, Preact, TypeScript, Signals, micro\-frontends, WebSockets, Web Workers
   

  

**Backend You Will Touch**
 Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express, Serverless Framework; REST and GraphQL
   

  

**Data And Infrastructure**
 MySQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, AWS, Docker
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 The agent surface is one of the few places in the product where someone sits for a full working day, and the configuration surfaces determine how quickly a new customer can be brought online.
   

  

 The role offers broad exposure across the product surface, with direct ownership of what you build.

* Utilizing analytical thinking to enhance employee engagement strategies
* Excelling in conflict resolution and stakeholder communications
* Managing employee data with confidentiality and precision
* Embracing change and fostering a culture of inclusion
* Developing skills in process improvement and documentation administration

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist – NGO / Social Impact | Pune
description:
**Find the People Who Will Help Change Lives.**

**What if recruitment wasn't just about filling positions?**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, every person who joins our team contributes to creating better opportunities for young people from underserved communities.**

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Executive** who can own the recruitment journey end\-to\-end — from finding the right talent and conducting interviews to building a strong candidate experience and helping new team members begin their journey with Lighthouse.

If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, spotting potential, building relationships, and wants your recruitment work to contribute to meaningful social impact, we'd love to hear from you.

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation works in the area of **skilling and livelihoods for underserved youth**, with a vision of enabling socio\-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse model is built on a pioneering **Public\-Private Partnership (PPP)** approach that brings together:

**Government \+ Corporates \+ NGOs \+ Citizens \+ Communities**

The Government supports the Lighthouse centres through location and capital expenditure. Corporates contribute through CSR funding to support operational expenses, while NGOs and other partners contribute skilling and livelihood opportunities for young people.

With a strong presence across more than **400 of Pune's approximately 500 slum communities**, the Lighthouse program has expanded to **PCMC, Dombivali, Aurangabad, Delhi, Odisha, and Hyderabad**.

Our work is driven by four core values:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

About the Role

As a **Talent Acquisition Executive**, you will play a critical role in building the team that powers our mission.

You'll partner with hiring managers and internal teams to understand talent needs, source candidates, assess potential, coordinate interviews, support hiring decisions, and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

You'll work across a range of roles and interact with candidates from diverse professional and social backgrounds.

The role requires someone who can balance:

**Speed \+ Quality \| Process \+ People \| Hiring Needs \+ Mission Fit**

We are looking for a recruiter who doesn't simply ask:

**"Can this person do the job?"**

But also asks:

**"Will this person connect with our mission, values, and the communities we serve?"**

**What You'll Do**

**Own Talent Acquisition End\-to\-End**

**Take ownership of the recruitment lifecycle for positions across the organization.**

**You will**:

* Understand hiring requirements from managers and teams.
* Clarify role expectations, competencies, and candidate profiles.
* Develop appropriate sourcing strategies for different roles.
* Source and engage potential candidates.
* Screen applications and shortlist relevant profiles.
* Conduct initial phone/video screenings and interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Track candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Support offer discussions and closure.
* Ensure positions are filled within agreed timelines while maintaining hiring quality.

**Job Posting \& Candidate Sourcing**

**Think beyond simply posting a vacancy.**

**You will:**

* Post job openings across relevant job portals and platforms.
* Leverage social media and professional networks for sourcing.
* Explore NGO and social\-sector specific recruitment networks.
* Identify new and creative sourcing channels.
* Build and maintain relevant candidate pipelines.
* Proactively reach out to potential candidates.
* Engage passive candidates where appropriate.
* Experiment with different approaches to attract quality talent.

Your goal is to ensure that the right candidates **discover Lighthouse — and want to be part of the journey.**

**Screening \& Interviewing**

**Be the first meaningful point of contact between many candidates and Lighthouse.**

**You will:**

* Conduct initial phone screenings.
* Evaluate candidates against role requirements.
* Assess relevant experience, skills, communication, and motivation.
* Understand candidates' career aspirations and expectations.
* Assess alignment with Lighthouse's values and mission.
* Share structured feedback with hiring managers.
* Help ensure a fair, consistent, and candidate\-friendly selection process.

We believe recruitment should be about **understanding potential, not just matching keywords on a CV.**

**Create a Great Candidate Experience**

**Every interaction with a candidate shapes how they see the organisation.**

**You will:**

* Communicate clearly and professionally with candidates.
* Keep candidates informed about interview stages and timelines.
* Respond to candidate queries.
* Ensure a respectful and inclusive recruitment experience.
* Maintain professionalism even when candidates are not selected.
* Build positive relationships with potential future candidates.

Because even when someone doesn't join us today, **they should leave the process with a positive impression of Lighthouse.**

**Support Onboarding**

**Your responsibility doesn't end when a candidate accepts an offer.**

**You will:**

* Support the onboarding process for new hires.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure joining formalities are completed.
* Help new employees understand the organisation and their next steps.
* Ensure new team members feel welcomed and supported.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to enable a smooth transition into the organisation.

**Manage Recruitment Data**

**Good recruitment also requires good data.**

**You will:**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment records.
* Track candidate pipelines and hiring status.
* Update recruitment systems and trackers.
* Maintain candidate information systematically.
* Support recruitment reporting and hiring dashboards.
* Ensure appropriate handling of candidate information.
* Follow data privacy and confidentiality practices.

You should be comfortable working with recruitment data and using it to identify bottlenecks and improve hiring effectiveness.

**Champion Diversity \& Inclusion**

**Lighthouse works with diverse communities — and our teams should reflect that diversity.**

**You will:**

* Promote fairness and inclusion throughout the recruitment process.
* Proactively explore diverse talent pools.
* Encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds and perspectives.
* Help reduce unconscious bias in the hiring process.
* Ensure candidates are evaluated fairly against role requirements and organisational values.

**Build the Lighthouse Employer Brand**

**Help candidates understand why Lighthouse is a place worth joining.**

**You will:**

* Communicate the LCF mission, values, culture, and impact through recruitment.
* Support recruitment campaigns and employer\-branding initiatives.
* Create compelling job\-posting and candidate communication approaches.
* Highlight the opportunities for learning, growth, and social impact at Lighthouse.
* Help strengthen Lighthouse's presence across relevant talent communities.

**We want candidates to understand not just what the job is, but why the work matters.**

**Who We're Looking For**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in:
* Human Resources
* Social Sciences
* Business Administration
* or a related discipline.
* **Relevant HR or Recruitment certifications will be an advantage.**

**Experience**

* **2\+ years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition** preferred.
* Experience in the nonprofit, NGO, development, education, skilling, or social\-impact sector will be an advantage.
* Experience working with volunteers or mission\-driven organisations will be a plus.

**Skills We're Looking For**

**Recruitment Expertise**

* Strong understanding of recruitment processes and best practices.
* Experience managing multiple positions simultaneously.
* Strong sourcing and screening capabilities.
* Ability to assess candidate suitability against role requirements.
* Understanding of structured interviewing and candidate evaluation.

Communication

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and internal teams.
* Confidence conducting screening and interview conversations.

**Organisation \& Execution**

* Strong organisational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**People \& Relationship Building**

* Ability to build trust and positive relationships.
* Empathy and active listening.
* Candidate\-centric approach.
* Ability to interact comfortably with people from diverse backgrounds.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You Are...**

* Curious about people and what motivates them.
* Someone who enjoys discovering talent rather than simply processing applications.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
* Proactive and self\-motivated.
* Comfortable managing multiple hiring requirements at the same time.
* Empathetic but also focused on timelines and outcomes.
* Someone who believes diversity makes organisations stronger.
* Passionate about social causes and community transformation.
* Excited by the idea of building teams that create social impact.
* Someone who takes ownership and follows through.

**Why Join Lighthouse Communities Foundation?**

**Your Hiring Decisions Can Create Impact**

The people you bring into Lighthouse will work directly or indirectly towards creating better opportunities for underserved youth.

Your work will help build the teams that make this transformation possible.

**Learn Beyond Recruitment**

**You'll gain exposure to:**

* Talent acquisition.
* Employer branding.
* People management.
* Organisational development.
* Social\-sector talent ecosystems.
* Diversity and inclusion.
* Mission\-driven recruitment.

**Work With Purpose**

Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and purpose\-driven organisation where people and impact matter.

**Grow Your Career**

At Lighthouse, you'll have opportunities to learn, experiment, take ownership, and grow your recruitment capabilities while contributing to a larger mission.

**What Success Looks Like**

**You'll know you're making an impact when:**

* The right people are joining the right roles.
* Hiring managers trust you as a talent partner.
* Candidates have a positive experience with Lighthouse.
* Recruitment pipelines are healthy and diverse.
* Positions move efficiently through the hiring process.
* New employees feel welcomed from day one.
* Recruitment data helps the organisation make better hiring decisions.
* The teams you help build are stronger, more capable, and aligned with Lighthouse's mission.

Position Details

The question isn't just:

WorkPosition: Civil Engineer

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Civil Engineer** with good technical knowledge and practical understanding of civil engineering activities. The candidate will be responsible for **CAD drafting, preparation and modification of drawings, site visits, measurements, project coordination, documentation, and providing technical support for ongoing projects**.

The role will involve a combination of **office\-based CAD/design work and field/site work**. The candidate should therefore be comfortable travelling to project sites, company locations, or client locations whenever required.

Freshers with good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**, basic civil engineering concepts, and a willingness to work on\-site may also apply.

Key Responsibilities1\. CAD \& Drawing Work

* Prepare, modify, and update **2D drawings using AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Prepare civil engineering drawings based on project requirements and instructions from senior engineers.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, layouts, plans, and technical specifications.
* Make necessary corrections and revisions to drawings as per project requirements.
* Assist in preparing **plans, elevations, sections, layouts, and detailed drawings**.
* Maintain proper records of drawings and ensure the latest revisions are used.
* Coordinate with senior engineers/design teams for drawing\-related requirements.
* Ensure drawings are prepared accurately and according to the required specifications.

2\. Site Visits \& Field Work

* Visit project sites/company locations as required for **measurements, inspections, coordination, and technical support**.
* Take site measurements and collect relevant technical information.
* Verify site conditions against drawings and project requirements.
* Coordinate with site supervisors, contractors, vendors, and other personnel.
* Monitor ongoing civil work and report observations to the reporting manager.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions and communicate them to the concerned team.
* Assist senior engineers in resolving site\-related technical issues.
* Ensure that work is carried out according to approved drawings and instructions.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate between the **office/design team and site team**.
* Assist in planning and execution of civil engineering activities.
* Follow up on project\-related requirements with internal teams, contractors, and vendors.
* Assist in ensuring timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Communicate project updates, site observations, and technical requirements to the reporting manager.
* Attend site/client meetings when required.

4\. Measurement \& Estimation Support

* Take and record measurements at project sites.
* Assist in preparing **quantity calculations, BOQs, material requirements, and estimates**.
* Check measurements and quantities against drawings and actual site conditions.
* Assist in preparing material requirement statements and project documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of measurements and project\-related data.

5\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure civil work is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Identify and report quality\-related issues observed at the site.
* Assist senior engineers in maintaining project quality standards.
* Follow company and site safety procedures during site visits.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to basic safety practices while working at project sites.

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain project\-related drawings, documents, measurements, and records.
* Prepare daily/weekly site reports as required.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and approvals.
* Document site observations and communicate them to the reporting manager.
* Assist in preparing project progress reports and other engineering documentation.
* Maintain organized CAD files and project folders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Civil Engineer will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of CAD drawings.
* Timely completion of assigned drawings and engineering tasks.
* Accuracy of site measurements and documentation.
* Effective coordination between office and site teams.
* Timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Adherence to project specifications and quality standards.
* Ability to identify and communicate site\-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of engineering documents and records.
* Responsiveness to site and project requirements.

Required Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Ability to read and understand civil engineering drawings.
* Basic knowledge of civil engineering principles and construction practices.
* Understanding of plans, elevations, sections, and layouts.
* Basic knowledge of quantity estimation and measurements.
* Knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Ability to prepare and maintain technical documentation.
* Basic knowledge of construction materials and methods.
* Knowledge of surveying/site measurements will be an advantage.

Required Soft Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to travel to project sites/company locations.
* Comfortable working in both **office and site environments**.
* Ability to coordinate with contractors, vendors, supervisors, and internal teams.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Good time\-management skills.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Professional and positive attitude.

Educational Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering** from a recognized university/institution.
* Diploma in Civil Engineering candidates with relevant skills/experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in Civil Engineering, CAD Drafting, Construction, Site Engineering, or related roles.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

title: Product Support Engineer - Google Cloud
description:
****Synopsis of the role:**
 Ready to work on the front lines of data delivery, leveraging the power of Google Cloud? If you're a detail\-oriented problem\-solver who enjoys working with sophisticated technology and contributing to a mission\-critical platform, this role is for you!
   

  

 As a Product Support Analyst within the Technical Fulfillment team, you’ll configure, operate and monitor our high\-volume batch data delivery platform built on Google Cloud. You will play a key role in processing and enriching financial data for our clients, ensuring seamless and precise execution with a strong focus on quality and reliability gaining invaluable experience in a dynamic and evolving technological landscape.
   

  

**What you’ll do** 
 :**
**Platform Configuration and Operation:**
* Configure and execute data processing workflows on our batch delivery platform according to established procedures and client specifications.
* Deploy and manage complex data pipelines orchestrated via Apache Airflow.
* Leverage and extend Standard Airflow DAG Templates to ensure deployment consistency and rapid iteration across environments.
* Monitor the execution of data processing jobs, identifying and addressing any issues to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
* Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure the integrity and accuracy of processed information.
* Diagnose and resolve complex configuration, scheduling, and dependency issues within the GCP platform and its associated infrastructure.
* Adhere to established security protocols and maintain the highest standards of data security and privacy in all configuration activities.
* Follow SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) guidelines for any configuration deployments or changes.
* Maintain accurate records of configurations, processes, and any issues encountered.
* Stay up\-to\-date with platform updates, new features, and relevant technical information.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for process improvement and automation within the configuration workflows.
* Assist in the creation and maintenance of our configuration documentation and knowledge base articles.


**Client Focus:**
* Understand the importance of accurate and timely data delivery for our clients.
* Support the team in addressing client inquiries and resolving fulfillment\-related issues.
* Take ownership of precise, high\-stakes data configurations that directly impact client trust and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (including Engineering and Data Operations) to resolve issues and improve delivery processes.


****What experience you need:****
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, detail\-oriented, and proactive approach to problem solving.
* Familiarity with data processing concepts and batch delivery systems.
* Experience working with configuration files (e.g., YAML).
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts, ideally with some exposure to GCP.
* Familiarity with different file encoding formats.
* Experience with API tools for testing and understanding data interfaces.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., shell scripting) are an asset.


****What could set you apart:****
* Ability to verify issues by testing in higher environments, be on\-call support for Production Incidents as needed.
* Experience with GCP services such as Dataflow, Composer, Cloud Storage, or BigQuery.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools within a cloud environment (e.g., Google Cloud Logging and Monitoring)
* Proficiency in scripting (Python) or object\-oriented programming languages (Java).


**If you're eager to dive into the Google Cloud and the world of data delivery, apply now to join our innovative team!**

title: Transport Modeler
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
 Are you enthusiastic about how transportation, land use, socioeconomics, and technology intersect and its real\-world impacts on people’s lives and communities? Do you have a passion to empower regional planning policies and decisions with state\-of\-the\-art transportation planning tools? Are you ready to take on the challenge to deliver highly innovative transportation planning projects that will shape and inspire a sustainable, prosperous, and resilient future? If so, consider joining our innovative Planning team at WSP ! for Canada Business. We are looking for a Junior or Intermediate Transportation Planner/Engineer/Data Scientist to join our team.
   

  

 We focus on the development and application of travel demand models to support multi\-modal transportation planning and policy projects. We specialize in advanced, activity\-based demand modelling techniques to forecast regional population travel patterns and future transportation networks given proposed land uses, transportation infrastructure, and policies. Our proven record for developing industry\-leading solutions include the Cities, Municipalities and Regional Travel Demand Model and its implementations. We are trusted advisors and close collaborators with municipal, regional, and provincial governments, transportation agencies, and academia.
   

  

 We are also actively growing Transportation Planning practice that is rooted in our team’s strong data analytics and visualization capabilities. This involves developing bespoke software solutions to help clients analyze large and complex data sources to derive useful insights and answer complex questions.
   

  

 As a member of the GCC Planning team, you will be part of a forward\-thinking team that seeks to improve transportation mobility through the delivery of travel demand models and data\-driven insights.  As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices.
* Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies.
* Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems.
* Experience working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes.
* Experience working within large, globally distributed teams.
* Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success.
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies.
   

  

 We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 Kaleris is a private equity\-backed software firm focused on supply chain optimization, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are a global leader in the supply chain execution market, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best\-in\-class solutions for challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi\-mode transportation.
   

  

 We’re looking for a forward\-thinking engineer to join our team in supporting and monitoring our ever\-expanding Cloud platform.  You will execute on our key strategic initiative of ushering the maritime industry in the modern computing era.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Protect, maintain, and enhance the software and systems supporting Navis' cloud solutions, ensuring they consistently meet or exceed strict SLA requirements for mission\-critical systems powering global trade.
* Establish and promote standardized tools, processes, and frameworks across a diverse portfolio of solutions with varying levels of maturity, complexity, and criticality.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement security best practices, conduct audits and testing, and share results with all stakeholders.
* Define response protocols for monitoring alerts and contribute to a growing playbook of procedures. Lead Post Incident Reviews, enforce best practices, and provide recommendations for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Develop automation solutions to proactively prevent problem recurrence, ultimately aiming to automate responses to all non\-exceptional service conditions.
* Deliver 24/7/365 support and incident management for a portfolio of approximately a dozen Cloud SaaS solutions. Participate in on\-call support to ensure stability and performance of production environments.


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of experience in DevOps, Engineering, or Engineering in Test roles, including supporting and maintaining critical production environments.
* Demonstrated experience working with various Azure\-based PaaS and SaaS services such as Azure AD, Azure SQL, BLOB storage, Redis cache, and Azure Web Services.
* Proficient in managing Microsoft Azure environments, including VMs, NSGs, and Resource Groups. Familiarity with Docker and related orchestration technologies, including Docker, Rancher, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Skilled in both Windows and Linux administration, including knowledge of bash commands such as ssh, scp, sed, awk, grep, netstat, etc.
* Familiarity with cloud security guidelines, such as Security Operation Center (SOC) guidelines, and compliance requirements like GDPR and FIS.
* Extensive knowledge of networking, including protocols, virtual networks, subnets, and firewalls.
* Strong scripting experience in languages such as Python, PowerShell, Ansible, and Terraform. Additional ability to write SQL queries and investigate DB logs is a plus.
* Understanding and practical application of methodologies like ITIL, Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and SRE.
* Proficient in monitoring and logging tools like ELK, Site 24x7, New Relic, and Splunk.
* Collaborative mindset with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to remain calm and composed in high\-pressure situations, such as during major service outages.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze distributed systems on a global scale.
* Strong attention to detail, follow\-through, and ability to quickly prioritize tasks when dealing with multiple items.


*The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time or the scope of the position may change necessary to business demands.*
 Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Description**
 Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
   

  

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
   

  

 Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results\-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast\-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
   

  

 Mid\-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
   

  

 Afternoons bring cross\-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high\-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end\-to\-end live monitoring experience \-\- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience with distributed systems at scale


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
* Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence
* Experience in major facilities incident management
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment
* supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure

title: Abuse Mitigation & Compliance Associate
description:
**Who We Are.**
 Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go\-to\-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.
   

  

**What you’ll do \& how you’ll make your mark.**
* Review the dashboards and data provided by the technical and product teams to find customers taking advantage of our unmetered hosting policy by storing files that are prohibited by our acceptable usage policy.
* Email the clients to inform them of the policy breach and help them in deleting the restricted files.
* To address any queries the clients may have, you will be expected to work closely with the product and technical teams.
* Publish monthly reports to stakeholders about the number of cases handled and the results.
* Create, maintain, and improve processes for detection and mitigation of abusive activity perpetrated through usage of our products
* Liaison with various representatives of the intelligence community, domestic and global law enforcement, industry, and cyber\-crime watchdogs that specialize in abuse mitigation to enable rapid exchange of data and take prompt action against miscreants
* Perform forensic analysis of malware, spam, phishes/spoofs and other abuse incidents to understand modus operandi and implement countermeasures in partnership with support and system admin teams
* Proactively track and review abusive activity within our client base and take appropriate action, ensuring that our Terms of Usage are strictly adhered
* Work with and guide our dedicated operations team that receives complaints from Internet users about abusive activity, and communicates with clients and channel partners to take appropriate action
* Gather actionable intelligence and understand threats by using data obtained from various black lists, browsing various fraud forums, communicating with affected parties and so forth
* Participate in discussions within the Internet security community at large, with a view to gather intelligence and refine our processes based on industry/technology trends
* Educate our channel partners about best practices in abuse and fraud mitigation by conducting webinars and presentations, blogging etc.


**Who you are \& what you’ll need to succeed.**
* Experience: 0\-1 years in Customer Service or similar capacity, preferably on an IT platform
* Outstanding communication skills
* Sound knowledge of Internet, web technologies, operating systems and networking concepts; ability to rapidly learn new concepts
* Excellent presentation skills
* High level of interest in cyber security
* High degree of motivation, with excellent follow through skills
* Logical and analytical bend of mind, with a penchant for solving complex problems
* Good investigative skills and consummate attention to detail
* Inclination towards research, data analysis, problem solving
* Must be willing to work in shifts (including at night and on holidays)
* Prior training or experience in cyber forensics/cyber law or network security.
* Experience in a customer interaction capacity, preferably in a technical field


**Why you’ll love us.**
* We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a workfrom\-home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. . At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time. All our employees are eligible for a free domain and WordPress blog as we sponsor the domain registration costs.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold!
