description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Attack \& Penetration Testing \- Senior**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of web\-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non\-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802\.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 6 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3\-4\-9 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.


**What We Look For**
* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. * Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.

* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:*** Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: LinkedIn Executive
description:
LinkedIn \& Personal Branding Associate

We are looking for someone who is curious about marketing, understands how LinkedIn works, and wants to get really good at personal branding, content, engagement and lead generation.

You do not need years of experience for this role.

If you have 3 to 4 months of experience in marketing, social media, content, sales, outreach or a related field, and you have the hunger to learn, you can be a great fit.

You will work closely with our team to manage and grow the LinkedIn presence of founders, CEOs and senior professionals. We will train you on our processes, how we approach personal branding, how we write content, how we engage with the right people and how we turn LinkedIn activity into meaningful business conversations.

What You Will Do

* Manage and maintain LinkedIn profiles for founders, CEOs and senior professionals
* Help plan and execute LinkedIn content based on the client's positioning, industry and goals
* Research topics, ideas, people and conversations relevant to each client
* Assist with writing and refining LinkedIn posts
* Manage daily LinkedIn engagement and interact with relevant people in a thoughtful way
* Identify the right people and companies for networking and outreach
* Build relevant connections and write meaningful connection notes
* Support LinkedIn outreach and lead generation activities
* Track conversations, follow\-ups and prospects
* Monitor the overall presence and reputation of clients on LinkedIn
* Keep client profiles active, relevant and aligned with their positioning
* Use AI tools to improve research, content creation, ideation and day\-to\-day execution
* Work with the team to continuously improve content, engagement and outreach based on what is working

What We Are Looking For

You do not need to be an expert.

We are looking for someone who:

* Understands the basics of LinkedIn and knows how the platform works
* Understands what outreach means and why targeted outreach matters
* Knows what makes a good connection request and connection note
* Has a basic understanding of marketing and communication
* Can write clear, simple and grammatically correct English
* Is comfortable researching people, companies, industries and topics
* Has basic knowledge of AI tools and is comfortable learning new tools
* Has a genuine interest in LinkedIn, personal branding, content and marketing
* Pays attention to details and can follow a process consistently
* Is proactive, curious and willing to learn
* Can understand a client's voice and communicate in a way that feels natural rather than robotic
* Has the ability to take feedback and improve quickly

Experience

3 to 4 months of experience in marketing, social media, content, sales, outreach or a similar role is enough.

Freshers can also be considered if they have a strong understanding of LinkedIn, good communication skills and a genuine interest in learning.

What matters more to us than years of experience is your ability to learn, execute and improve.

Training \& Growth

You will receive training on:

* LinkedIn personal branding
* Content strategy and content writing
* LinkedIn engagement
* Founder and CEO positioning
* LinkedIn outreach
* Lead generation
* Prospect research
* Client profile management
* AI tools and workflows
* Managing the LinkedIn presence of senior professionals

You will not be expected to figure everything out on your own from day one.

We will teach you the process. Your job is to learn it, execute it well and keep getting better.

The Ideal Person

You might be a great fit if you are someone who sees LinkedIn and thinks:

"I want to understand how this actually works."

You enjoy learning about marketing, people, businesses and content.

You notice why some posts get attention while others don't.

You are curious about how founders build their reputation online.

You like talking to people, researching businesses and finding the right prospects.

And most importantly, you have the fire to become really good at something rather than simply looking for another job.

What This Role Can Become

This is an opportunity to build real expertise in one of the fastest\-growing areas of modern marketing: LinkedIn personal branding and founder\-led growth.

As you grow, you can take ownership of larger clients, strategy, content, engagement, outreach and eventually entire LinkedIn growth accounts.

If you are willing to learn and execute, there is a lot of room to grow here.

title: Interactive Web Developer (Contract-to-Perm) — 3D, Motion & HW-SW | Three.js · WebGL · GSAP · Framer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Antariksha Labs is focused on transforming education and innovation through practical, hands\-on learning experiences built around cutting\-edge hardware modules and a robust developer platform. The company specializes in satellite\-inspired technologies and modular hardware solutions that bridge the gap between theory and real\-world applications, from educational model satellites to industry\-grade systems. Its platforms support space technology exploration, aerial testing, and scalable research projects, giving learners and professionals the flexibility to prototype and deploy bold ideas. Antariksha Labs partners with educators, industry leaders, and creators to foster a collaborative community where new solutions can be developed, tested, and commercialized. Through its one\-stop platform, creators can bring their designs to market and leverage data\-driven tools for real\-world use cases.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Interactive Web Developer (Contract\-to\-Perm) will design, build, and maintain highly interactive 3D and motion\-rich product websites using technologies such as Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, and Framer. In this part\-time/contract remote role, the developer will collaborate with design, product, and hardware plus software teams to translate complex technical concepts into engaging, performant web experiences that showcase Antariksha Labs’ platforms and solutions. You will build two product websites — one for an energy intelligence platform spanning consumer, commercial, and utility products, and one for a modular space\-technology hardware line used in education and research.
 



  





 Both brands sell technical products that need to be understood before they are bought: hardware that must be seen from every angle, software interfaces that need to be shown in motion, and systems whose value only lands when the visitor can see how the pieces connect. We are looking for someone who can build product experiences — 3D hardware visualisation, scroll\-driven explanation, purposeful motion — not someone who assembles pages from a template. The technology stack is deliberately open. We have not decided whether these sites are best built hand\-coded, in Framer or Webflow pushed past their defaults, or as a hybrid. Part of what we want from you is that judgment. Come with a point of view on what each brand actually needs, and the range to build it either way.
 



  





 You will work closely with our graphics designer and marketing associate, not in isolation. Design direction, copy, brand assets, and campaign requirements will come from them, and you will be in continuous conversation with both — advising on what is technically feasible, what will hurt performance, and where a design needs to change to survive contact with the browser. Collaborative working is a requirement of this role, not a preference.We expect and encourage the use of AI development tools. What we assess is the finished site — its quality, performance, and maintainability — not how it was produced.
 



  





 Both websites to be delivered within 2 months at a fixed rate of ₹12,000 per month, followed by an ongoing maintenance retainer at a rate agreed at handover.
 



  





**What You'll Build** 



* Two complete product websites, concept through launch, each with its own distinct visual identity
* Interactive 3D product visualisation — hardware devices and satellite modules the visitor can rotate, explore, and inspect
* Scroll\-driven narrative sections explaining how technical systems work
* Product and application pages for both consumer and enterprise audiences
* Campaign landing pages and microsites on fast turnaround
* CMS structures the marketing team can update independently, without returning to you
* Component systems and design tokens that hold consistent as the sites grow
* Performance, accessibility, and responsive behaviour across devices and connection speeds
* On\-page SEO foundations — semantic structure, metadata, sitemaps, page speed
* Ongoing maintenance, content updates, and incremental feature work post\-launch



  





**Core Technical Requirements** 




 Frontend Engineering
 


* Expert JavaScript — modern ES, modules, async patterns, DOM performance
* HTML5 and CSS3 at depth: Grid, Flexbox, custom properties, container queries
* Fluid responsive design across the full range, not three fixed breakpoints
* Framework experience — React, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, or equivalent
* Build tooling and version control: Vite, npm, Git



 3D \& WebGL
 


* Three.js and WebGL in production — scenes, materials, lighting, camera work
* Model optimisation: glTF, Draco compression, LOD, texture and draw\-call budgets
* Graceful degradation where WebGL is unsupported or the device cannot sustain it
* GLSL shader fundamentals (advantageous, not essential)



 Motion \& Interaction
 


* GSAP — timelines, ScrollTrigger, complex sequencing
* CSS animation and the Web Animations API
* Genuine motion judgment: easing, timing, restraint, and knowing when not to animate
* Scroll\-driven experiences that do not wreck performance or accessibility



 Visual Development Platforms
 


* Framer — advanced use including code components, CMS, and custom interactions
* Webflow — custom interactions, CMS collections, and custom code beyond platform limits
* Clear understanding of where each platform's ceiling sits and when to move to code



 Design \& Animation Tooling
 


* Spline — 3D scene creation and web integration
* Rive — interactive, state\-driven animation and runtime integration
* Working fluently from Figma, with the judgment to improve on a design where needed



 Collaboration
 


* Working daily alongside a graphics designer and a marketing associate
* Translating design direction into technical reality, and explaining constraints clearly
* Taking brand, copy, and campaign input and integrating it without friction
* Direct communication on timelines, trade\-offs, and what a shortcut will cost later



  





**Advantageous** 



* Lottie / After Effects motion assets
* Headless CMS — Sanity, Contentful, Payload
* Physics, particle, or generative systems — Cannon, Rapier, custom
* WebGPU or advanced shader work
* Serverless functions, API integration, form handling
* Analytics and conversion instrumentation — GA4, Search Console, event tracking
* Deployment on Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare
* Prior work on hardware, deep\-tech, space, energy, or B2B technical products
* Fluent use of AI\-assisted development tooling



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Front\-End Development and Web Design skills, with experience in modern frameworks and tools for building interactive, responsive user interfaces.
* Candidates should possess solid Back\-End Web Development skills, including working with APIs, server\-side logic, and integrating data services into dynamic web applications.
* Candidates should possess broad Web Development skills that span both client\-side and server\-side considerations, including performance optimization and cross\-platform compatibility.
* Candidates should possess Programming skills with proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and familiarity with libraries and tools such as Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, and Framer for 3D and motion experiences.
* Candidates should possess experience in interaction design, accessibility best practices, and responsive layouts to ensure inclusive and reliable user experiences.
* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, using version control (e.g., Git), and working in remote, asynchronous environments is beneficial.
* Familiarity with STEM, edtech, or hardware\-driven products, along with a portfolio showcasing interactive or 3D web projects, is a strong advantage

title: Embedded Hardware Design Engineer — PCB, Analog & Sensor Systems
description:
**Company Description** 
 Antariksha Labs is an education\-focused technology company that delivers practical, hands\-on learning through advanced hardware modules and a versatile developer platform. The organization specializes in satellite\-inspired and modular hardware solutions that bridge the gap between theory and real\-world applications, ranging from educational model satellites to industrial\-grade systems. Antariksha Labs collaborates with educators, industry partners, and learners to build a community where experimentation and innovation are encouraged. The platform also enables creators to commercialize their designs, offering a one\-stop space to create, test, and sell hardware solutions. With strengths in modular hardware, collaborative research platforms, industry\-grade testing, and data\-driven solutions, Antariksha Labs supports projects that move from concept to deployment.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Embedded Hardware Design Engineer — PCB, Analog \& Sensor Systems will focus on designing, prototyping, and validating hardware modules for satellite\-inspired and sensor\-based applications. We build intelligent connected hardware across two domains: energy monitoring and metering devices that sense real electrical loads in homes and facilities, and modular space\-technology hardware used in education and research. Both are physical products that have to work reliably outside a lab. This is the hardware half of a two\-person embedded team. You design the schematics, lay out the PCBs, select and qualify components, bring the boards up, and prove they work — and our embedded software developer writes firmware on top of what you deliver. When a sensor reads wrong, when a rail is noisy, when a board draws more current than the budget allows, it lands with you.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on hardware role. You will spend your time in the schematic editor, at the bench with a scope, and with a soldering iron in hand for prototyping, buying components from local shops and working with assembly houses for production. You will handle analog signal chains for electrical measurement, power supply design, RF layout, sensor interfacing, and thermal and mechanical constraints — and you will be responsible for a board that measures accurately, not just one that powers on.
 



 You will work directly with our engineering leadership and with the firmware, mechanical, and product teams from schematic through to production. We are hiring at graduate level. Portfolio and hands\-on project depth matter far more than years of experience — if you have designed, fabricated, and debugged your own boards, we want to see them. Engagement at Rs. 10,000 per month during the probationary period, with an increase based on performance, and conversion to a full\-time role with time.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Schematic design around ESP32, STM32, and other ARM microcontrollers
* Analog front\-end design for electrical measurement — current and voltage sensing, signal conditioning, filtering, ADC interfacing
* Power supply design: SMPS, LDOs, battery charging, sequencing, protection
* Sensor interfacing over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and analog inputs
* Multi\-layer PCB layout, from schematic to fabrication\-ready output
* Mixed\-signal layout discipline — grounding, return paths, analog/digital separation
* RF and antenna layout: impedance control, placement, keep\-outs
* EMI/EMC\-aware design, thermal management, and design for manufacture
* Board bring\-up, rail verification, bus validation, and systematic debugging
* Measurement accuracy validation against reference instruments; power profiling
* Component selection with attention to sourcing, cost, and availability
* Schematics, BOMs, assembly drawings, and revision control
* Board support documentation the firmware developer can work from directly
* Prototype procurement, vendor coordination, and production test fixtures



  





**Core Requirements** 




**PCB \& Circuit Design** 



* Hands\-on with KiCad, Altium, Eagle, or OrCAD
* Schematic capture and multi\-layer layout for a board you actually had fabricated
* Working from datasheets, reference designs, and application notes
* Understanding how layout affects signal integrity and noise



**Electronics Fundamentals** 



* Analog: op\-amps, filters, amplification, ADC front\-ends, noise sources
* Digital: logic levels, level shifting, bus loading, terminations
* Power: regulator topologies, efficiency, ripple, decoupling strategy
* Measurement understanding — resolution, accuracy, drift, sampling, calibration



**Platforms \& Protocols** 



* ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex\-M, or Raspberry Pi hardware
* I2C, SPI, UART, CAN at hardware level
* Wireless integration: Wi\-Fi, BLE, LoRa, GSM — module selection and RF layout



**Bench Skills** 



* Oscilloscope, logic analyser, multimeter, bench supply
* Soldering and rework including fine\-pitch SMD
* Systematic fault isolation rather than part\-swapping



  





**Advantageous** 



* Energy metering ICs, current transformers, shunts, Hall sensors, isolation for mains\-referenced circuits
* Mains\-voltage design — creepage, clearance, isolation, safety practice
* Firmware capability: Arduino C/C\+\+, MicroPython, or RTOS
* CubeSat or pico\-satellite subsystems; thermally or power\-constrained design
* Mechanical CAD — Fusion 360 or SolidWorks for enclosure fit
* EMI/EMC pre\-compliance, BIS, CE, FCC exposure
* DFM reviews, assembly house coordination, panelisation
* Low\-power design: sleep modes, energy budgets, battery sizing



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical \& Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related — or equivalent demonstrable project work
* Freshers welcome. Self\-taught designers with strong board portfolios welcome.
* Available to start immediately
* Demonstrated experience in Electronics Hardware Design and Circuit Design, including analog and mixed\-signal circuits.
* Ability to define and implement robust Hardware Architecture for modular, scalable platforms.
* Proficiency with PCB design tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, Eagle) and hands\-on experience with schematic capture and layout for multi\-layer boards.
* Experience integrating and characterizing sensors (IMUs, environmental sensors, RF modules, etc.) and designing signal conditioning circuits.
* Knowledge of embedded systems fundamentals, microcontrollers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), and power management.
* Comfort with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) and systematic hardware debugging and validation processes.
* Ability to work independently in a hybrid setting, communicate clearly, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to make electronics components trade\-off, travel to procure components locally for prototyping, solder components, travel to assembly houses to manage production.
* Experience with space, aerospace, robotics, or educational hardware platforms is a plus, as is familiarity with design for manufacturability and reliability.



  





**What You'll Gain** 



* Ownership of real products that ship, not evaluation exercises
* Full cycle exposure — schematic through fabrication, bring\-up, and production
* Two very different hardware domains: energy measurement and space systems
* Direct work with engineering leadership and the firmware team
* Performance\-based progression and a path to full\-time

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager**
**Shift:** 
 UK
   

  

**The Team**
 Morningstar’s Analytics group develops and delivers proprietary methodologies, calculations, and analytical capabilities that help investors evaluate investments and make informed decisions. The Managed Investment Calculations team translates Morningstar’s research and intellectual property into accurate, scalable, and consistent analytics used across Morningstar products.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a Associate Product Manager with strong business analysis and data analysis skills to lead the development and ongoing enhancement of managed investment calculation capabilities.
   

  

 This role combines product ownership with hands\-on analytical work. You will partner with methodology experts, quantitative researchers, engineering, and quality assurance teams to translate investment methodologies and business needs into detailed calculation specifications and reliable production capabilities. You will analyze complex investment datasets, prototype and validate calculations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure that implementations faithfully reflect Morningstar’s proprietary methodologies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, relevant investment knowledge, and the ability to learn complex financial concepts quickly. You should be comfortable both prioritizing a product backlog and using SQL to investigate underlying data. Prior knowledge of Morningstar’s products or methodologies is not required.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own product priorities and delivery: Manage the tactical roadmap and backlog for managed investment calculations, balancing new capabilities, methodology enhancements, data quality, and platform improvements.
* Define business requirements: Partner with product teams, research, operations, and client support to clarify user needs, assess business impact, and establish scope and success criteria.
* Translate methodologies into calculation specifications: Work with methodology owners to document formulas, input requirements, eligibility rules, calculation frequency, exceptions, and expected outputs.
* Perform detailed data and business analysis: Use SQL and analytical tools to investigate datasets, assess coverage and quality, map data sources, and understand dependencies and downstream impacts.
* Prototype and validate calculations: Develop calculation examples and independently verify results, including edge cases, missing data, historical changes, and differences across fund structures and share classes.
* Drive execution with engineering and QA: Develop actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, resolve implementation questions, and partner on test scenarios, regression coverage, and release readiness.
* Safeguard calculation quality: Investigate discrepancies and production issues, identify root causes, and prioritize fixes based on investor, client, and business impact.
* Manage methodology and implementation changes: Evaluate effects on historical results and consuming products, coordinate stakeholder review, and maintain traceability between approved methodologies and production logic.
* Build shared understanding: Maintain clear calculation documentation and support materials that help global teams explain analytics and resolve client questions.
* Measure outcomes and communicate progress: Track calculation accuracy, timeliness, coverage, and adoption, while communicating priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or data analysis, preferably within investment analytics, financial data, or financial services.
* Strong hands\-on SQL skills and experience analyzing complex datasets to validate results and investigate issues.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs and financial methodologies into precise requirements, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of managed investments, including mutual funds, ETFs, share classes, and concepts such as investment performance, risk, fees, and peer group comparisons.
* Ability to learn complex financial concepts and methodologies quickly, question assumptions, and apply that understanding to data analysis and calculation requirements.
* Experience specifying, prototyping, or validating analytical calculations, with close attention to data dependencies, exceptions, and reproducibility.
* Experience prioritizing requirements or managing a backlog and collaborating with engineering and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish data issues from methodology or implementation issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with investment datasets, financial calculations, or proprietary analytical methodologies.
* Python or similar programming skills for data analysis, calculation prototyping, and validation.
* Familiarity with centralized calculation services, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud analytical platforms.
* Experience with data lineage, reconciliation, and automated calculation quality controls.


 Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Education:** 12th Pass / Graduate  
**Industry:** Government Subsidy, MSME, Manufacturing \& Business Consulting

ABOUT AMPLUS

Amplus Subsidy Solutions works with MSMEs, manufacturers and entrepreneurs to help them identify and access relevant Government Subsidies, Incentives, Finance\-linked Schemes, Compliances, Licences, Approvals and Project\-related Government Support.

We are building a professional sales team focused on **quality conversations, genuine opportunities, disciplined follow\-ups and long\-term client relationships.**

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive will be responsible for:

**Calling → Connecting → Understanding → Qualifying → Follow\-up → Appointment Setting → CRM Update**

The primary objective is to convert available leads and prospect databases into **qualified business conversations and appointments for the Business Development/Sales Team.**

This is not simply a calling job.

The candidate should learn to identify whether a business has a potential requirement related to:

* Government Subsidy
* Industrial Incentives
* MSME Schemes
* Compliance
* Licences
* Approvals
* Project\-related Government Support

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Outbound Calling

* Make outbound calls to prospective MSMEs, manufacturers and entrepreneurs.
* Contact leads received through:
* Website
* Digital marketing
* Social media
* Campaigns
* Existing databases
* Referrals
* Events and exhibitions
* Business networks
* Introduce Amplus professionally.
* Understand the prospect's basic requirement.
* Create interest in a relevant discussion.

2\. Lead Qualification

Ask relevant questions to understand:

* Business/industry
* Manufacturing activity
* Business location
* New project or existing business
* Expansion/modernization plans
* Approximate investment
* Machinery purchase/plans
* MSME/Udyam status
* Subsidy/incentive requirement
* Compliance/approval requirement
* Project timeline
* Decision\-maker availability

The objective is to identify:

**Raw Lead → Interested Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment**

3\. Appointment Setting

The Telecaller will be responsible for scheduling qualified prospects with the:

* Business Development Executive
* Sales Executive
* Sales Head
* Relevant Amplus Team Member

Before scheduling a meeting, the Telecaller should ensure that the basic requirement and interest of the prospect are understood.

4\. Follow\-Up Calls

* Follow up with interested prospects.
* Follow up on scheduled meetings.
* Reconnect with prospects who requested a callback.
* Follow up on incomplete information.
* Maintain systematic calling schedules.
* Reactivate older leads wherever relevant.

5\. WhatsApp \& Communication

Where appropriate:

* Share approved Amplus information.
* Send meeting confirmations.
* Send basic company/service information.
* Follow up professionally through WhatsApp.
* Maintain professional communication standards.

Only company\-approved information should be shared.

6\. CRM MANAGEMENT

Every meaningful conversation must be updated in CRM.

CRM information should include:

* Lead name
* Company name
* Contact details
* Lead source
* Industry
* Requirement
* Qualification status
* Conversation outcome
* Meeting status
* Follow\-up date
* Next action
* Remarks

**No important lead should remain without a defined next action.**

7\. LEAD NURTURING

Not every prospect will be immediately ready.

The Telecaller should:

* Identify interested but not\-ready prospects.
* Maintain follow\-up dates.
* Reconnect at the appropriate time.
* Share approved information where required.
* Move suitable prospects toward a sales conversation.

8\. COORDINATION WITH SALES TEAM

The Telecaller will work closely with the BDE/Sales Team.

Responsibilities include:

* Informing the salesperson about qualified leads.
* Providing relevant lead background before meetings.
* Confirming scheduled appointments.
* Updating meeting outcomes.
* Following up on missed appointments.
* Supporting lead reactivation.

IMPORTANT: NO FALSE COMMITMENTS

The Telecaller must **never guarantee**:

* Subsidy amount
* Eligibility
* Government approval
* Sanction
* Processing timeline
* Financial benefit

The correct approach is to communicate that the requirement will be assessed and eligibility/benefit will be validated by the relevant Amplus team.

This is particularly important because subsidy eligibility and benefit amounts require proper validation.

REQUIRED SKILLSCommunication Skills

* Clear verbal communication
* Active listening
* Good questioning ability
* Professional telephone etiquette
* Confidence while speaking
* Ability to communicate in English/Hindi/Marathi

Sales Skills

* Outbound calling
* Lead qualification
* Appointment setting
* Follow\-up
* Basic objection handling
* Lead nurturing

Technical Skills

* Basic computer knowledge
* CRM usage
* WhatsApp
* Email
* Google Sheets / Excel
* Basic internet research

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident on calls
* Energetic
* Positive
* Patient
* Good listener
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable making multiple calls
* Persistent but polite
* Professional
* Willing to learn
* Comfortable using CRM
* Comfortable speaking with business owners

EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE

**Education:**

* 12th Pass / Graduate
* Graduate preferred

**Experience:**

* 0–2 years
* Freshers can apply
* Telecalling experience preferred
* BPO / Inside Sales / Customer Calling / Lead Generation experience is an advantage
* B2B calling experience is an advantage

Freshers with strong communication skills and a positive learning attitude are welcome.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

Activity KPIs

* Daily outbound calls
* Meaningful conversations
* Follow\-ups completed
* Leads contacted

Quality KPIs

* Qualified leads
* Appointment rate
* Meeting attendance rate
* Lead\-to\-opportunity quality

Discipline KPIs

* CRM accuracy
* Follow\-up completion
* Calling discipline
* Timely updates

Business KPIs

* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings converted into opportunities
* Contribution to sales pipeline

**Quality of conversations is more important than simply making a high number of calls.**

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

A typical day may include:

**Morning**

* Review assigned leads
* Prioritize follow\-ups
* Plan daily calling

**During the day**

* Make outbound calls
* Qualify prospects
* Schedule meetings
* Follow up with interested leads
* Coordinate with BDE/Sales Team

**End of day**

* Update CRM
* Complete pending follow\-ups
* Review appointments
* Report important lead developments

CAREER GROWTH

**Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Senior Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Senior BDE / Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Manager**  
↓  
**Sales Manager**

WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY?

This role may not be suitable for someone who:

* Does not enjoy speaking on calls
* Is uncomfortable making outbound calls
* Does not want targets
* Avoids follow\-ups
* Is unwilling to learn
* Does not maintain CRM
* Gives false commitments to prospects
* Requires constant supervision
* Gives up easily after rejection

CORE SUCCESS STATEMENT

**Your responsibility is to turn conversations into qualified opportunities.**

A great Telecaller at Amplus does not simply make calls.

They **identify the right businesses, understand their basic requirements, create interest, qualify genuine opportunities, schedule quality meetings and maintain disciplined follow\-ups.**

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Job Description – Mechanical Engineer \| CAD \& Site

Work Position: Mechanical Engineer

Department: Engineering / Projects

Experience: 0–2 Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Location: Chinchwad

Reporting To: Project Manager / Senior Mechanical Engineer

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Mechanical Engineer** with good technical knowledge and a practical understanding of mechanical engineering activities. The candidate will be responsible for **CAD drafting, preparation and modification of mechanical drawings, site visits, measurements, project coordination, technical documentation, and providing engineering support for ongoing projects**.

The role will involve a combination of **office\-based design/CAD work and field/site work**. The candidate should therefore be comfortable visiting project sites, company locations, client locations, or vendor facilities whenever required.

Freshers with good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software, mechanical engineering fundamentals, and a willingness to work at project sites** may also apply.

Key Responsibilities1\. CAD \& Mechanical Drawing Work

* Prepare, modify, and update **2D mechanical drawings using AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Prepare mechanical layouts, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, and detailed drawings as per project requirements.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, layouts, and technical documents.
* Make drawing revisions and modifications based on engineering requirements and site conditions.
* Assist in preparing **component drawings, equipment layouts, fabrication details, and assembly drawings**.
* Maintain proper records of drawings and ensure that the latest revisions are being used.
* Coordinate with senior engineers and the design team for drawing\-related requirements.
* Ensure drawings are accurate and prepared according to required technical specifications.
* Assist in preparing drawings based on measurements and information collected from project sites.

2\. Site Visits \& Field Work

* Visit project sites, client locations, company premises, and vendor locations as required.
* Take measurements and collect technical information from the site.
* Verify actual site conditions against approved drawings and project requirements.
* Assist in installation, inspection, fabrication, and maintenance\-related activities wherever required.
* Coordinate with site supervisors, fabricators, contractors, vendors, and other technical personnel.
* Monitor mechanical work and provide regular updates to the reporting manager.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
* Assist in resolving technical and site\-related issues under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Ensure that mechanical work is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate between the **design/engineering team and site team**.
* Assist in planning and execution of mechanical engineering activities.
* Coordinate with production, fabrication, installation, procurement, and project teams as required.
* Follow up with vendors, contractors, and suppliers regarding project requirements.
* Assist in ensuring timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Attend site/client/vendor meetings whenever required.
* Communicate project updates and technical issues to the reporting manager.

4\. Fabrication \& Installation Support

* Assist in fabrication and installation activities as per approved drawings.
* Understand fabrication requirements and coordinate with fabricators.
* Check dimensions and specifications during fabrication and installation.
* Assist in inspection of fabricated components and assemblies.
* Verify that materials and components are as per approved specifications.
* Coordinate with the fabrication/site team to resolve drawing or dimensional issues.
* Assist senior engineers during testing, commissioning, and installation activities.

5\. Measurement \& Technical Support

* Take accurate site measurements and maintain measurement records.
* Assist in preparing **Bill of Materials (BOM), material requirements, and quantity calculations**.
* Check dimensions and specifications against drawings.
* Assist in identifying the required materials, components, and equipment for projects.
* Support senior engineers in technical calculations and project\-related activities.
* Prepare technical information and reports as required.

6\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure mechanical work is carried out according to approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Inspect work and report quality\-related issues to the reporting manager.
* Assist in maintaining required quality standards during fabrication, installation, and project execution.
* Follow company and site safety procedures during field visits.
* Use appropriate PPE and follow safety instructions while working at project sites.
* Report unsafe conditions or potential technical/safety issues to the concerned authority.

7\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain mechanical drawings, project documents, measurements, and technical records.
* Maintain proper records of drawing revisions and approvals.
* Prepare daily/weekly site reports as required.
* Document site observations, measurements, and technical requirements.
* Assist in preparing project progress reports.
* Maintain organized CAD files and project documentation.
* Prepare and maintain relevant Excel reports and engineering records.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of CAD/mechanical drawings.
* Timely completion of assigned drawings and engineering tasks.
* Accuracy of site measurements and technical documentation.
* Effective coordination between office, site, fabrication, and project teams.
* Timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Adherence to technical specifications and quality standards.
* Ability to identify and communicate technical/site\-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of engineering documentation.
* Coordination and follow\-up with vendors/contractors.
* Ability to support successful project execution.

Required Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Ability to read and understand mechanical engineering drawings.
* Good understanding of basic mechanical engineering principles.
* Knowledge of mechanical components, fabrication, and installation processes.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing and fabrication methods.
* Knowledge of **BOM and material requirements**.
* Basic knowledge of measurements and dimensional inspection.
* Knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Ability to prepare and maintain technical documentation.
* Knowledge of 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, or similar will be an advantage.

Required Soft Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong technical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail.
* Willingness to travel to project sites, client locations, and vendor locations.
* Comfortable working in both **office and field environments**.
* Ability to coordinate with different teams.
* Good follow\-up and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and processes.
* Professional and positive attitude.

Educational Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** from a recognized university/institution.
* Diploma in Mechanical Engineering candidates with relevant skills/experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in Mechanical Engineering, CAD Design, Production, Fabrication, Site Engineering, Project Engineering, or related roles.
* Freshers with good **AutoCAD knowledge** and willingness to work at project sites are welcome to apply.
* Candidates having experience in CAD, fabrication, installation, production, or project/site work will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

* Have a **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering**.
* Have good working knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Be able to understand and interpret mechanical drawings.
* Be comfortable working on drawings as well as visiting project sites.
* Be willing to travel to company, client, vendor, and project locations whenever required.
* Have basic knowledge of fabrication, manufacturing, installation, and mechanical components.
* Be comfortable taking measurements and coordinating with site/fabrication teams.
* Have good communication and reporting skills.
* Be willing to work in a practical, project\-oriented environment.
* Have a willingness to learn and take responsibility.

Nature of Work

This position involves a combination of:

**CAD/Drawing Work → Site Visits → Measurements → Technical Coordination → Fabrication Support → Installation Support → Documentation → Project Execution**

The candidate should be comfortable handling both **desk\-based engineering/design work and field/site responsibilities**.

Salary \& Benefits

**Salary:** ₹15\-20k per month

**Additional Benefits:** \[Travel Allowance / Incentives / Other Benefits, if applicable]

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at

**Email ID :** recruiterdefinitemanagent@gmail.com

**Contact Number** : 7038079597

**Candidates with good AutoCAD knowledge and a willingness to work both in the office and at project sites are encouraged to apply.**

description:
Management Associate / Trainee – Society Redevelopment \& Project Advisory
 



**Department:** 
 Project Management Consultancy / Real Estate Advisory / Business Development
 



**Industry:** 
 Real Estate / Architecture / Engineering / Society Redevelopment
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers / 0–2 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai /
 
 Mumbai
 




**Reporting To:** 
 Project Head / Senior Project Manager / Business Development Manager / Director
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



 We are looking for a motivated, confident and proactive
 **Management Trainee – Society Redevelopment \& Project Advisory** 
 to join our multidisciplinary Architecture, Engineering and Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team.
 



 The candidate will receive practical exposure to the complete lifecycle of
 **Co\-operative Housing Society Redevelopment Projects** 
 , including project coordination, Society interaction, business development, market research, tendering, developer evaluation, documentation, financial and technical data collection, project monitoring and stakeholder coordination.
 



 The role combines
 **Project Advisory, Real Estate Research, Business Development, Client Relations and PMC Coordination** 
 and is suitable for candidates who want to build a career in the real estate redevelopment and consultancy sector.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Society Redevelopment Project Coordination
 


* Assist in coordinating assigned Society Redevelopment Projects.
* Maintain project\-wise trackers, schedules and action\-point reports.
* Follow up with Society representatives, developers and consultants.
* Track project milestones, pending matters and deliverables.
* Assist Senior Project Managers in monitoring project progress.
* Coordinate communication between different project stakeholders.



 2\. Society \& Client Relationship Management
 


* Assist in communicating with Society Managing Committees and Redevelopment Committees.
* Schedule and coordinate meetings with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand Society requirements and assist in presenting appropriate PMC / consultancy services.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes and action\-point trackers.
* Maintain professional relationships with Society members, developers and consultants.
* Follow up on decisions and pending requirements after meetings.



 3\. Redevelopment Opportunity Identification
 


* Research and identify potential Co\-operative Housing Society redevelopment opportunities.
* Identify societies, commercial buildings, CIDCO / MHADA societies and other redevelopment opportunities.
* Maintain databases of potential redevelopment projects.
* Conduct preliminary research regarding project location, existing development, Society details and redevelopment potential.
* Assist in arranging introductory meetings with Managing Committees and prospective clients.
* Assist in collecting preliminary project information and documents.



 4\. Business Development \& Lead Generation
 


* Assist in generating new business opportunities for PMC, Architecture, Engineering and Redevelopment Consultancy services.
* Support lead generation through networking, referrals, calls, meetings, research and professional contacts.
* Develop relationships with Architects, Structural Consultants, Contractors, Legal Consultants, Valuers, Chartered Accountants, Developers and other industry professionals.
* Assist in maintaining an active business development pipeline.
* Track leads from initial contact through meeting, proposal and project appointment.
* Support senior management in business expansion initiatives.



 5\. Market Research \& Real Estate Research
 


* Conduct research on local real estate markets and redevelopment activity.
* Research property values, ongoing projects, developers and comparable developments.
* Study redevelopment trends and development opportunities.
* Assist in collecting information relating to FSI, TDR, development potential, construction trends and local regulations.
* Prepare concise market research and project opportunity reports.



 6\. Tender, EOI \& Proposal Coordination
 



 Assist the PMC team in:
 


* Preparing and coordinating
 **EOIs, tenders, proposals, fee quotations and presentations** 
 .
* Collecting required project information and documents.
* Coordinating with Architects, Engineers, Project Managers, CA and Legal Consultants for proposal preparation.
* Maintaining records of developer submissions and tender documents.
* Preparing developer\-wise comparison sheets.
* Tracking proposal status and follow\-ups until project appointment.
* Supporting technical and commercial presentation preparation.



 7\. Developer Research \& Evaluation
 


* Research prospective developers and their project history.
* Compile information regarding completed, ongoing and proposed projects.
* Assist in preparing Developer Profile Reports.
* Collect and organise technical, financial, legal and project\-related information.
* Assist the PMC team in preparing developer comparison and evaluation reports.
* Maintain an updated developer database.



 8\. Project Documentation \& Reporting
 


* Maintain project\-wise physical and digital documentation.
* Prepare project status reports and trackers.
* Assist in preparing professional correspondence, reports and presentations.
* Maintain records of:
* Society documents
* Tender / EOI documents
* Developer submissions
* Meeting minutes
* Approvals
* Consultant reports
* Project correspondence
* Project timelines
* Ensure documents are systematically maintained.



 9\. Financial \& Commercial Support
 



 Under the guidance of senior professionals:
 


* Assist in preparing comparative statements.
* Compile developer financial and commercial information.
* Assist in collecting data for feasibility reports.
* Support CA / Finance professionals with project data and documentation.
* Assist in preparing project cost and financial information.
* Maintain project\-wise financial and commercial trackers.



 10\. Technical \& Feasibility Support
 


* Assist in collecting information required for redevelopment feasibility studies.
* Compile existing Society details, member data, area statements and project information.
* Assist Architects and Engineers with preliminary project data collection.
* Support preparation of feasibility reports and project presentations.
* Assist in understanding basic concepts of FSI, TDR, development potential and construction planning.



 11\. Consultant \& Internal Team Coordination
 



 Coordinate and follow up with:
 


* Architects / All Consultants \& Project Managers / Chartered Accountants / Internal PMC teams



 Assist in obtaining drawings, reports, documents, certificates and other project deliverables.
 



  





 12\. Meetings, Presentations \& Site Visits
 


* Attend Society Committee meetings and project meetings as required.
* Assist in SGM / AGM / GBM preparation and coordination.
* Attend developer presentations and stakeholder meetings.
* Assist in preparing presentation material.
* Participate in project site visits and inspections.
* Prepare site visit observations and reports.
* Record member queries and follow\-up actions.



 13\. CRM, MIS \& Data Management
 


* Maintain CRM and lead databases.
* Maintain project and client databases.
* Prepare daily / weekly / monthly activity reports.
* Track leads, meetings, proposals and project status.
* Maintain follow\-up schedules.
* Prepare project MIS and management reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate updating of records.
* Assist in promoting the firm's Architecture, Engineering, PMC and Redevelopment Consultancy services.
* Support participation in seminars, exhibitions, conferences and networking events.
* Assist with professional presentations and marketing material.
* Support referral and professional networking initiatives.
* Assist in developing long\-term relationships with prospective clients and industry professionals.



 QUALIFICATIONS
 



 Candidates from the following backgrounds may apply:
 


* MBA / PGDM – Marketing / Finance / Operations / Real Estate / Construction Management
* B.Arch / Architecture
* B.E. / B.Tech – Civil Engineering
* Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Management, Finance, Real Estate, Commerce, Construction or related fields.Candidates with internship or prior exposure to Real Estate, Construction, PMC, Architecture, Finance, Business Development or Society Redevelopment will be preferred.



**Freshers are welcome to apply.** 




  





 REQUIRED SKILLS
 


* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities.
* Good command of
 **MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Ability to prepare professional reports and presentations.
* Basic understanding of financial and commercial concepts.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Good organisational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Professional attitude and business etiquette.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.



 Technical / Industry Knowledge – Added Advantage
 


* Basic understanding of Architecture and Building Planning.
* Basic knowledge of Civil Engineering and Construction.
* Understanding of Society Redevelopment processes.
* Basic understanding of FSI, TDR, Premiums and Development Regulations.
* Familiarity with UDCPR / DCPR and local approval processes.
* Basic knowledge of project lifecycle and construction methodology.
* Basic knowledge of CRM / project management software.
* AutoCAD knowledge will be an added advantage.



 WORKING REQUIREMENTS
 


* Willingness to travel across
 **Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Raigad and MMR** 
 .
* Willingness to attend
 **Society meetings, presentations, site visits and client meetings** 
 .
* Regular evening meetings may be required as Society Managing Committees and members are often available after normal office hours.
* Mandatory attendance at scheduled
 **GBMs, SGMs, Committee Meetings, presentations and stakeholder meetings** 
 .
* Availability to work on weekends / public holidays when required for Society meetings, project presentations or critical project activities.
* Willingness to travel at short notice for client meetings and site visits.
* Ability to work extended hours when required to meet project and client commitments.



 Preference
 



 Candidates residing in
 **Navi Mumbai / Mumbai / Thane** 
 will be preferred due to the nature of the role, which involves frequent local travel, Society meetings and client visits.

description:

 \- Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating capacity building of grassroots cadre and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results not as an end in itself but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on\-ground activities, data analytics, research and new\-age media as a force multiplier for the Prime Minister's messages and actions.

 Associates/ Senior Associates are part of project teams in the campaigns and work with the Organization team and client team members to develop political and campaign strategy for the client (political party).  During campaigns, teams interact closely with political leaders and organizers at the constituency, district, state and national level.  The job often requires evening and weekend work as well as extensive travel.

 \- The position would involve work in Gujarat and selected individuals will be expected to travel across the state and interact with multiple stakeholders.
 



  





 \- The role requires intelligent, passionate, and self\-driven professionals with a clear understanding of working in the consulting industry. 2. Possess the ability to project\-manage campaign initiatives end\-to\-end
3. Undertake research and present findings towards formulating on\-ground initiatives
4. Possess high\-quality problem\-solving, analytical skills and the ability to propose practical solutions for issues

**Desired Qualification and Experience:** 



1. Graduation with good grades from a reputed academic institution
2. Good knowledge of Gujarat's culture, geography, history, society and political landscape will be a plus
3. Political consulting or similar experience is an added advantage
4. Willingness to work, stay and travel in Gujarat
5. Language proficiency in Gujarati is a must

title: User Experience Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nirmaan Branding Studio is a creative agency where fun, humor, and innovative thinking drive brand\-focused design solutions. The studio specializes in crafting distinctive brand identities, dynamic visual systems, and compelling narratives that help clients connect with their audiences and stand out on social media. Nirmaan collaborates closely with clients to build unforgettable brand experiences that amplify their success. The team showcases its work on platforms such as Behance, Instagram, and Facebook, reflecting a culture of creativity, experimentation, and high\-quality design.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site User Experience Designer role based in Rajkot. The User Experience Designer will be responsible for translating brand strategies into intuitive, engaging digital experiences across web, mobile, and social platforms. Daily tasks include conducting user research, mapping user journeys, creating wireframes and interactive prototypes, and collaborating with visual designers, copywriters, and developers to deliver cohesive solutions. The role involves applying design thinking to solve client problems, running usability reviews, refining designs based on feedback, and ensuring consistency with each brand’s visual and verbal identity. The Designer will participate in brainstorming sessions, present concepts to internal teams and clients, and contribute to continuous improvement of Nirmaan’s design processes and standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong User Experience (UX) and Design Thinking skills to solve complex problems and create user\-centered solutions.
* Candidates should possess User Research skills, including conducting interviews, surveys, and usability testing, and synthesizing insights into actionable recommendations.
* Candidates should possess Prototyping skills, including creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, and user flows using modern design tools.
* Candidates should possess Visual Design skills, with the ability to craft clean, consistent, and brand\-aligned interfaces and layouts.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Adobe Creative Cloud) is beneficial.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present design rationale to both creative teams and clients.
* Relevant education in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
* Experience in branding, digital product design, or agency environments is an advantage.

**Role:** 
 Roblox Developer

 Remote, with preference to Onsite in Bangalore at our Kanakapura Road Office
 



**Experience required:** 
 Total 3 years of mobile games experience, with at least 3 Experiences shipped on Roblox
 



**Reporting to:** 
 CTO
 



 As a Roblox Developer, you will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, producers, and product teams to build scalable, engaging, and polished multiplayer game experiences on the Roblox platform.
 



  





**What do you need to do? (Role and Responsibilities)** 



* Read and interpret Game Design Documents, discuss requirements with producers and artists, and plan development with the team and leads at Games2Win.
* Take full ownership of delivering a game from concept through to publishing and operating live Roblox experiences — coordinating with art, design, and QA teams throughout.
* Rapidly prototype game concepts in Roblox Studio, including adapting gameplay systems and environments from existing Unity3D titles into Roblox\-native experiences.
* Adapt or recreate gameplay systems from existing Unity titles within Roblox Studio — including hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) to accelerate the porting process.
* Write clean, maintainable, production\-quality Luau code, applying solid architecture patterns suited to Roblox’s client\-server model.
* Implement secure client\-server communication using
 **Remote Events / Remote Functions** 
 and manage persistent player progression using
 **Datastores** 
 .
* Implement Roblox monetization systems including Game Passes, Developer Products , and Immersive Ads.
* Stay current on Roblox Engine updates, the
 **Open Cloud API** 
 , and platform best practices, and proactively suggest new mechanics or platform capabilities to the product team.



  





**Who could you be? Background and Experience:** 



* Minimum 3 years of total experience in game development
* Some Unity3D background is a significant advantage — ideally you have ported at least one Unity game to Roblox, or are highly motivated to do so.
* At least 3 shipped experiences on Roblox (share your Roblox profile / game links).
* Deep understanding of Roblox’s
 **client\-server architecture** 
 : when to run code on the
 **Local Script** 
 (client) vs
 **Script** 
 (server), and how to correctly replicate and synchronize gameplay state between them.
* Hands\-on experience with Roblox platform services:
 **Datastores** 
 (player data persistence),
