title: HR Intern
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

* 📍 Location: Koramangala, Bangalore
* 🕒 Working Days: 6 days/week, 1 rotational weekly off
* ⏰ Shift Timings: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Standard office hours)
* 💼 Experience: Fresher (0–1 year)
* 📅 Contract Duration: 3 Months


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly organized Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team at Instawork. In this role, you will get hands\-on experience working on end\-to\-end recruitment, serving as the critical bridge between our hiring teams and prospective candidates.
   

  

 If you enjoy speaking with people, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to build a strong foundation in human resources and talent acquisition, this opportunity is a great starting point.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage End\-to\-End Recruitment: Support the full recruitment lifecycle for various open positions.
* High\-Volume Outreach: Source, screen, and make 100–150 outbound calls daily to prospective candidates.
* Interview Coordination: Take ownership of lining up and scheduling interviews between candidates and internal hiring teams.
* Candidate Communication: Manage ongoing follow\-ups, gather feedback, and ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of calls, candidate statuses, and interview schedules.


**Requirements**
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a confident and professional phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills, multitasking abilities, and exceptional attention to detail (crucial for interview coordination).
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume calling environment.
* Prior experience in HR, recruitment, or customer\-facing roles is preferred but not mandatory.


**Compensation \& Benefits** 
  

  

* 💰 Base Stipend: ₹20,000 per month
* 🍱 Food Allowance: ₹200 per day
* Perks \& Benefits:
+ Collaborative team culture and vibrant office environment.
+ Hands\-on exposure to full\-cycle talent acquisition and HR operations.
+ Strong career growth opportunities by learning the core mechanics of tech and business hiring.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
job_function: Human Resources, Administrative, and Business Development
description:
Earthful is building India's most trusted clean\-label, plant\-based wellness brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. Hiring well is core to how we grow, and this role is where a lot of that hiring actually gets done — sourcing, screening, coordinating and closing the people who join our creative, marketing, sales and operations teams.
 



  





**Office Location : Mumbai, Lower Parel** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The TA Intern is the engine room of hiring at Earthful — the person who keeps candidates moving, interviews on calendar, and the applicant tracker honest. You'll work closely with the founders and hiring managers across functions, getting real, hands\-on exposure to how an early\-stage D2C brand builds its team. This is a fresher\-friendly role: you don't need prior recruitment experience, just strong communication, ownership, and a genuine interest in how great teams get built. You'll learn to evaluate candidates, not just find them, and you'll have a direct hand in closing the people Earthful eventually hires.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Screen candidates for open roles using job portals and LinkedIn, building shortlists hiring managers can act on quickly.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers, keeping both sides informed on next steps.
* Coordinate with candidates through the process and follow up on assignments so nothing quietly stalls.
* Update the applicant tracking system (ATS) with accurate, current candidate details.
* Assist in creating job descriptions and posting roles across the right portals.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Freshers are welcome; 0–1 year of experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Able to work full\-time, in\-office, from our Lower Parel, Mumbai location.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable speaking with candidates and senior team members alike.
* High ownership, urgency and attention to detail.
* Genuine interest in talent acquisition, startups and D2C brands, rather than a generic "any internship will do" attitude.
* A degree in HR, Business Administration or a related field is a plus, though not a requirement.

title: HR MANAGER (Compliances)
description:
Job Description – HR Manager (Payroll \& Compliance)

**Position:** HR Manager – Payroll \& Compliance (IMMEDIATE JOINER)  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8\+ years, preferably with strong hands\-on experience in payroll and statutory compliances  
**Location:** VIKASPURI

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Manager** with strong knowledge of **payroll processing, statutory compliances, labour laws, HR operations, and employee lifecycle management**.

The candidate should be capable of independently managing monthly payroll, statutory deductions and filings, employee records, HR policies, attendance and leave management, compliance documentation, and coordination with Finance, consultants, auditors, and government authorities.

The role requires a person who is **hands\-on, detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and capable of ensuring error\-free payroll and timely statutory compliance**.

Key ResponsibilitiesPayroll Management

* Independently manage **monthly payroll processing** for employees.
* Verify attendance, leaves, incentives, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, arrears, and other payroll inputs.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salary, overtime, incentives, full \& final settlements, and statutory deductions.
* Manage employee salary structures including **CTC, Gross Salary, Basic, HRA, allowances, employer contributions, and deductions**.
* Prepare payroll reports, salary sheets, bank transfer files, and salary slips.
* Reconcile monthly payroll with employee records and coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team.

Statutory \& Labour Law Compliance

* Ensure timely and accurate compliance relating to:
* **EPF / PF**
* **ESI**
* **Payment of Gratuity**
* **Payment of Bonus**
* **Minimum Wages**
* **Leave and Holiday regulations**
* **Maternity Benefit provisions**
* **POSH compliance**
* Other applicable labour and employment laws.
* Ensure timely deposit of statutory contributions and filing of applicable returns.
* Maintain all statutory registers, records, challans, returns, and employee documentation.
* Monitor changes in labour laws and ensure implementation of necessary changes in company policies and payroll.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, auditors, PF/ESI authorities, and other statutory bodies whenever required.
* Support statutory, internal, and payroll audits and ensure proper closure of observations.

HR Operations

* Manage the complete **employee lifecycle** from joining to separation.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Offer Letters
* Appointment Letters
* Confirmation Letters
* Increment / Promotion Letters
* Transfer Letters
* Warning / Disciplinary Letters
* Experience and Relieving Letters

title: Senior Manager – Human Resources (Fluent Hindi Mandatory)
description:
Senior Manager – Human Resources (Fluent Hindi Mandatory)
 



**Company:** 
 Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd
 **Location:** 
 Chennai (Velachery) — with travel to Bangalore and Hyderabad
 **Reports to:** 
 Managing Director
 **Team:** 
 HR \& Admin executives, recruitment support
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time, on\-site
 



 About Amadora
 



 Amadora is a premium artisanal ice cream brand founded in Chennai in 2011\. Everything we sell is made from scratch at our central kitchen — no premixes, no shortcuts. We operate roughly 30 company\-owned and franchise stores across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad, alongside a growing bakery, sauces and frozen novelty line. We are in an active expansion phase, which means the HR function has to scale ahead of the store count rather than behind it.
 



 Role Summary
 



 We are looking for a Senior Manager – HR who can own the entire people function end to end: hiring, payroll, documentation, statutory compliance and the HR team itself. A large share of our kitchen, production and store workforce is drawn from Hindi\-speaking states, so
 **fluency in Hindi is non\-negotiable** 
 — you will interview, onboard, counsel and resolve grievances in Hindi every single day. This is a hands\-on role in a founder\-led business; you will build the systems and also run them until the team is deep enough to take over.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 End\-to\-End Recruitment
 


* Own the full hiring cycle for all roles — store crew, production and kitchen staff, supervisors, and corporate/management positions across all three cities.
* Build and maintain a reliable sourcing pipeline: migrant labour channels and contractors, hotel management and catering institutes, job portals, referral schemes and local walk\-in drives.
* Run screening, interviews, salary negotiation, offer rollout and document verification; keep offer\-to\-joining drop\-offs low with structured follow\-up.
* Maintain a live manpower plan against store openings and seasonal peaks, so hiring starts before the vacancy bites.
* Own onboarding and induction end to end, including accommodation coordination and documentation for outstation hires.



 Managing the HR Team
 


* Lead, allocate work to and develop the HR and admin executives; set weekly priorities and review output.
* Build capability in the team so recruitment, payroll input and compliance filing continue without escalation to you or the MD.
* Act as the single escalation point for people issues across the central kitchen, stores and franchise network.



 Payroll
 


* Own the monthly payroll cycle end to end — attendance and biometric reconciliation, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, full\-and\-final settlements — and close it on a fixed date every month with zero slippage.
* Validate payroll inputs against rosters and store\-level attendance before processing; investigate and resolve discrepancies rather than passing them through.
* Coordinate with Accounts on salary disbursement, payroll accruals, reimbursements and statutory payments.
* Maintain salary structures and bands, and support the MD on compensation benchmarking and revision cycles.



 HR Documentation
 


* Maintain complete, audit\-ready employee files: offer letters, appointment letters, KYC and ID documents, background checks, confirmation letters, increment and transfer letters, warning letters and exit paperwork.
* Own and keep current the employee handbook, HR policies, SOPs and the code of conduct; ensure they are communicated in both Hindi and Tamil where the workforce requires it.
* Maintain the HRMS/employee database and all trackers — headcount, attrition, leave, probation and confirmation status — as the single source of truth.
* Draft and issue all disciplinary documentation, show\-cause notices and inquiry records in a legally defensible format.



 Statutory Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance across all locations with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Bonus, Shops \& Establishments, Labour Welfare Fund, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act and POSH.
* Manage timely returns, challans, registrations and renewals; maintain statutory registers for every establishment.
* Handle labour department inspections, notices and audits, and coordinate with consultants and legal counsel where required.
* Ensure contractor and third\-party manpower compliance, including verification of their statutory filings.
* Constitute and run the Internal Committee under POSH; conduct mandatory awareness sessions.



 Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Manage grievances, disciplinary action and conflict resolution across a largely frontline workforce.
* Run confirmation and performance review cycles; work with Operations and Training on appraisal inputs.
* Drive retention initiatives and track attrition by store, role and tenure with actual root\-cause analysis.
* Conduct exit interviews and convert findings into corrective action.



 Qualifications \& Competencies
 


* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent; 8–12 years of HR experience with at least 3 years in a managerial capacity.
* **Fluency in Hindi is mandatory** 
 — speaking, reading and writing. You will use it daily with the kitchen, production and store workforce. English is required; Tamil is a strong advantage.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership of payroll and statutory compliance for a workforce of 200\+, ideally multi\-state.
* Background in food service, QSR, retail, hospitality or manufacturing strongly preferred — high\-volume frontline hiring and high attrition are the norm here, not the exception.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and hands\-on experience handling inspections and audits.
* Strong Excel skills and comfort with HRMS/payroll software and biometric attendance systems.
* Ability to operate independently in a founder\-led, fast\-moving business with limited support structures — this is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.
* Willingness to travel to Bangalore and Hyderabad, and to be present at stores and the central kitchen, including during peak season.



 What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)
 


* Time\-to\-fill for store and kitchen roles is cut to under 15 days, with a standing pipeline that lets new store openings be staffed before launch day rather than after.
* Payroll closes on the same fixed date every month with under 1% error rate, and full\-and\-final settlements are completed within 30 days of exit.
* Zero statutory non\-compliance findings across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad; all registers, returns and registrations current and inspection\-ready at any time.
* Employee documentation is 100% complete and digitised — every active employee has a full file, and confirmation, increment and exit letters are issued on time without prompting.
* Frontline attrition is reduced measurably against the current baseline, with the drivers identified store by store and at least two retention interventions implemented and tracked.
* The HR team runs recruitment, payroll input and compliance filing independently, escalating only exceptions.

We have worked with the likes of Zepto, Cred, and Rippling for their talent recruitment. We have 100Mn\+ candidates in our database \& have helped 1000\+ startups \& companies hire. Why Weekday
-----------



We featured in LinkedIn’s top 4 startups and in Fobes. While we are a **YC\-funded** startup, we are also backed by the likes of Kunal Shah (CEO of WhatsApp), Venture Highway acquired by General Catalyst, among others.  

While we are investor led, we are **already profitable**, and growing rapidly across India and the US.
Description \- About the role
-----------------------------



You’d be doing a wide variety of things \- talking to the Founding team and CXOs to understand what they are looking for in the crucial person to join their team. Then, picking people who you think are up for the challenge. Communicating and coordinating with them to get a candidate placed in the firm. You’d also analyse trends in which candidates get selected, use internal tools to find the best talent, and understand trends across industries.

This role could **lead to a Founder’s office** role in a year or two.
Who are we looking for:
-----------------------


**An exceptional communicator**: Your communication is clear, you have the ability to communicate with CXOs confidently, and you can talk to candidates with clarity and empathy. The energy and enthusiasm to talk, express and “listen” in a conversation. English fluency is a must, and other languages are a plus.
**Hustler mindset**: high agency, strong personal accountability, and a preference for direct hands\-on execution \- essentially a go\-getter attitude.
**Coachable, detail\-oriented and action\-oriented**: You are willing to learn, absorb feedback rapidly, and adapt accordingly, looking forward to acting and not just observing. You have a keen eye for detail, and you don’t let go until your final work is polished.
**No hiring experience is required**; you’ll learn in our 4\-6 week training program \- you get full pay during this period :)
What’s in it for you
--------------------


**Recruitment**: You’d learn the skills to be a world class recruiter in a couple of years
**Conversations with Business leaders**: You get to interact with Founders (on the hiring front) and top talent across the world (on the recruitment side). Build an invaluable network across the world’s best talent.
**Regular interaction with leadership**: Currently, we are a very small team, so you'll interact and learn directly from the founders and the leadership team.
**Work from anywhere**: We are happy for you to work from home or the mountains or the beach, as long as you have a stable internet connection.
**Insurance coverage**: We have strong insurance coverage to protect you in case of an unfortunate incident.
**Team events**: We are a fun, young team, so you decide how it could be :)
The recruitment process
-----------------------



We value your time; the whole process is planned in a way that we’ll wrap up in 5 \- 10 days.  

**HR Round**: Let’s get to know each other and we’d want to clarify about the role
**Group Discussion**: We’d like to see you work with your peers
**Arithmetic ability test**: Let’s assess your analytical and arithmetic skills
**Interview with Hiring managers**: The people you’d work with will want to know you
**Interaction with a founder**: A brief conversation before you join Weekday, with one of the founders to see if Weekday is a good fit for you and vice\-versa.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are looking for a proactive and people\-oriented **HR Executive** to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, employee engagement, recruitment, onboarding, attendance, and employee relations. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good organizational abilities, and the confidence to handle employees and HR processes independently.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for various positions, from sourcing to joining.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, references, and other channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers and candidates.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining and ensure smooth onboarding.

Employee Onboarding \& Documentation

* Handle joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, NDAs, and other HR documents.
* Create and maintain employee records and HR databases.
* Conduct HR induction and explain company policies, processes, and benefits.
* Ensure new employees are properly introduced to relevant teams and systems.

Attendance, Leave \& HR Operations

* Monitor daily attendance, late marks, leaves, WFH, and half\-day requests.
* Manage employee records and HR processes through HRMS/GreytHR.
* Ensure employees follow company attendance and leave policies.
* Maintain accurate employee documentation and HR trackers.
* Coordinate monthly HR reports and employee\-related records.

Employee Engagement \& Relations

* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding HR\-related concerns.
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns professionally.
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations, and internal events.
* Conduct employee feedback and engagement initiatives.
* Support a positive, professional, and collaborative workplace culture.

Performance \& Employee Management

* Coordinate probation reviews, performance discussions, and confirmation processes.
* Track employee performance review timelines.
* Support managers in addressing performance\-related concerns.
* Maintain records related to warnings, performance improvement, and disciplinary actions.
* Assist management in implementing HR policies and procedures.

Exit \& Full \& Final Process

* Handle resignation formalities and exit documentation.
* Conduct exit interviews and collect employee feedback.
* Coordinate clearance, asset/access handover, and Full \& Final settlement.
* Ensure proper completion of the employee offboarding process.

Required Skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and employee\-handling skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and HR operations.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and HRMS tools.
* Ability to multitask and manage HR activities independently.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Professional and approachable personality.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job Title:** HR Executive  
**Company:** Detailing Bull  
**Salary Range:** ₹18,000 – ₹24,000 (in\-hand)

**Job Summary:**

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations at Detailing Bull, including recruitment, employee coordination, and HR administration. The role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple HR functions efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

**3\. HR Operations \& Employee Management**

* Handle day\-to\-day HR activities and employee queries.
* Monitor attendance, leave records, and employee data.
* Support performance management processes and employee engagement activities.
* Assist in implementing HR policies and ensuring compliance.

**4\. Reporting \& Coordination**

* Maintain recruitment trackers and HR reports.
* Coordinate with different departments for manpower planning.
* Ensure timely updates and communication across teams.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Management, or related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR (freshers with strong skills can be considered).
* Knowledge of job portals (Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

The Business Analyst will also prepare documentation, reports, and dashboards, support user acceptance testing, and help ensure that platform features align with customer and business needs.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and the ability to derive insights from data and user behavior.
* Candidates should possess Business Analysis expertise, including requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration.
* Candidates should possess clear and effective Communication skills, both written and verbal, for cross\-functional interaction.
* Candidates should possess understanding of Business Process design, mapping, and optimization in a digital product environment.
* Candidates should possess ability to define and manage Business Requirements that can be translated into technical specifications.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, economics, information systems, or a related field.
* Experience in PropTech, real estate, or digital platforms, and familiarity with agile methodologies are beneficial.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.

description:

title: QA & Testing Intern — AI-Assisted Testing
description:
Zudu AI builds enterprise AI voice agents that handle real customer calls across India and APAC. Testing directly affects call quality, customer experience and successful task completion.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone with strong manual testing fundamentals who uses AI extensively to test applications and can independently verify the results.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Perform functional, exploratory, regression and end\-to\-end testing across voice agents, chat widgets, dashboards and APIs.
* Use AI tools to generate test scenarios, identify edge cases, build test scripts, analyze transcripts and logs, and investigate defects.
* Execute AI\-generated tests, correct inaccurate assumptions and verify actual application behaviour.
* Test multilingual conversations, interruptions, silence, fallbacks, call transfers and task completion.
* Test APIs for authentication, input validation, response accuracy and changes to application data.
* Run load tests under agreed conditions to assess concurrent calls, latency and failures.
* Investigate issues through logs, Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics.
* Write clear bug reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, severity and evidence.



**Must Have** 



* Hands\-on testing experience on at least one deployed application used by real users, through an internship, freelance work or a live project.
* Practical experience using AI tools for testing, with an example of work you executed and a verified outcome.
* Understanding of LLMs, prompts, context and tokens, hallucinations, variable outputs, retrieval\-based grounding, and the speech\-to\-text → LLM → text\-to\-speech flow.
* Strong manual QA fundamentals: positive and negative scenarios, boundary testing, expected results, regression and exploratory testing.
* API testing basics using Postman or similar, including HTTP, REST and status codes.
* Working knowledge of JMeter, k6, Locust or similar, and basic ability to interpret logs and Grafana/Prometheus metrics.
* Curiosity, debugging discipline and the ability to explain your reasoning.
* Availability to work full\-time from our Chennai office for six months.



**Good to Have** 



* Python or JavaScript scripting.
* Playwright, Selenium, pytest or CI pipeline experience.
* Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, streaming or real\-time voice systems.
* Confidence evaluating Tamil, English or Hindi conversations.



**When Applying, Please Include** 



* Your latest resume.
* One live application you personally tested and your contribution.
* AI tools you have actually used for testing, with one successful example.
* Current and expected monthly take\-home salary/stipend in INR. Enter ₹0 for current take\-home if you are not currently earning.
* Notice period, earliest joining date and whether you can join within seven days of an offer.



  





 Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical exercise. AI use is encouraged; you must be able to explain and verify your work.

title: Salesforce QA - Consultant, Managed Services - DFO&I - Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Consultant, Managed Services
   

  

 As a Salesforce QA Consultant, you will ensure the quality and reliability of Salesforce CRM implementations across the full delivery lifecycle. Working within an Agile delivery team, you will design and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end scenarios across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud. You will leverage Salesforce\-specific testing tools alongside standard automation frameworks, collaborate closely with developers and business analysts, and drive a quality\-first culture across sprint delivery.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
* Design, build, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for Salesforce implementations covering functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end scenarios.
* Execute functional testing across Salesforce modules: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud — including custom Apex, LWC components, Flows, and declarative configurations.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Salesforce\-compatible testing tools (Provar, Copado Robotic Testing, or equivalent) and Selenium\-based frameworks.
* Perform API testing for Salesforce REST/SOAP integrations using Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent tools.
* Conduct data validation and data integrity checks across Salesforce objects, custom metadata, and integration endpoints.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews; provide QA estimates and contribute to Definition of Done.
* Collaborate with Salesforce developers and business analysts to clarify acceptance criteria, understand technical designs, and identify testable scenarios early.
* Log, triage, and track defects in JIRA; produce clear defect reports with reproducible steps, expected vs actual results, and severity classification.
* Maintain test documentation using JIRA/Zephyr or equivalent test management tooling; produce sprint\-level test execution reports.
* Support UAT execution: prepare test environments, coordinate with business stakeholders, and facilitate sign\-off.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines; support Salesforce DevOps toolchain (Copado, Gearset, or equivalent).
* Leverage AI\-assisted testing tools where applicable to improve test coverage, reduce maintenance overhead, and accelerate regression cycles.


**The team:**
 Our
 **Digital Foundry Operate \& Innovations** 
 (DFO\&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 3–6 years of QA/software testing experience with a minimum of 2 years dedicated to Salesforce platform testing.
* Hands\-on functional testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud — including Apex triggers, LWC, Flows, Validation Rules, and Permission Sets.
* Experience with Salesforce\-specific test automation tools: Provar, Copado Robotic Testing, or equivalent.
* Proficiency in Selenium or equivalent automation frameworks for web UI testing.
* Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) for Salesforce REST/SOAP API validation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules), and integration patterns.
* Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools: JIRA, PractiTest, Zephyr, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum QA practices; experience contributing to sprint ceremonies and sprint\-level QA reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; excellent written and verbal communication.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201\) certification — demonstrates platform knowledge depth.
* PractiTest or MABL experience.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps toolchains: Copado, Gearset, or Salesforce DX (SFDX) for environment management and deployment validation.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating Salesforce automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to performance or load testing for Salesforce implementations.
* Knowledge of Salesforce Einstein AI features and experience testing AI\-powered components (Einstein Lead Scoring, Next Best Action, Agentforce).
* Experience with accessibility and compliance testing for Salesforce Experience Cloud portals (WCAG, Section 508\).
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification.
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201\). Provar / Copado Robotic Testing certification a plus. ISTQB Foundation preferred.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

* Demonstrated experience analyzing and troubleshooting performance issues at PHY/MAC layer under varying channel conditions.

 We operate at the forefront of operating systems, networking, security, and performance engineering, building the transport technologies that underpin Microsoft's cloud and platform ecosystem. Our work powers critical services and workloads across Windows, Azure, and next\-generation cloud infrastructure, enabling secure, reliable, and high\-performance communication at global scale.
   

  

 In Core OS, we are responsible for the Operating Systems that power Azure, Microsoft's Linux OS, the platforms for Windows Client and Xbox, and our Windows Server ecosystem – through all of these, we support every one of our cloud businesses and billions of customers around the world. In this era of ubiquitous computing, systems software excellence has never been more important for Microsoft. High quality, high\-efficiency operating systems and platform components underpin everything we do as a company, from making our systems more reliable for our customers, to increasing our competitiveness by reducing COGS, to delivering new features and capabilities to delight customers – that’s all us!
   

  

 The Datapath \& Transports team builds the networking technologies that carries traffic across Windows, Azure, Xbox, and Microsoft's cloud services. When you improve a congestion control algorithm or shave microseconds off the datapath here, it ships to billions of devices and some of the largest services on the planet.
   

  

 As a
 **Software Engineer II** 
 , you will design and build core transport technologies alongside experts across Windows, Azure, SQL, Security, and Developer Platform. You will work on QUIC and HTTP/3, TLS, congestion control, network acceleration, and the diagnostics and security that make them trustworthy \- solving hard problems in performance, reliability, and protocol design. It is a role that deepens your expertise in networking, systems architecture, and distributed systems, with real opportunities for impact across the industry and in open source.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and maintain features in core networking components including TCP/IP, MsQuic, and related transport technologies.
* Develop scalable and performant networking capabilities for Windows and Azure platforms.
* Contribute to next\-generation transport innovations involving QUIC, TLS, congestion control, network acceleration, and cloud\-scale networking.
* Investigate and resolve complex networking, reliability, performance, and security issues across large\-scale distributed systems.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to design robust networking APIs and developer experiences.
* Drive improvements in diagnosability, observability, telemetry, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Contribute to security initiatives including vulnerability remediation, secure protocol design, and transport\-layer hardening.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and engineering excellence initiatives.
* Work closely with global teams across Redmond and IDC to deliver high\-quality networking solutions.
* Embody our Culture and Values.

description:
**About Juspay** 




 Juspay is a leading multinational payments technology company, powering superior conversion rates, seamless customer experiences, cost optimization, and fraud reduction at scale for 500\+ top global enterprises and banks. Founded in 2012, the company processes over 300 million daily transactions, exceeding an annualized total payment volume (TPV) of $1 trillion with 99\.999% reliability. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, Juspay’s global network of 1200\+ payment experts operates across San Francisco, Dublin, São Paulo, and Singapore.
 



  





 Juspay offers a modular and interoperable product suite for merchants that includes open source payment orchestration, seamless authentication, payment tokenization, fraud \& risk management, global payouts, end\-to\-end reconciliation, unified payment analytics, and more. For banks, Juspay’s offerings include end\-to\-end white label payment gateway solutions \& real\-time payments infrastructure.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We need a design that guarantees High\-Availability of five\-nines! A distributed, fault\-tolerant system with state of art engineering techniques, spanning across multiple DCs in Active\-Active mode is an absolute necessity.
 



  





**The Challenge** 




 Building Distributed systems at this scale is still an Art. While there are standard open\-source building blocks available, the right architecture or the way to combine the components needs creativity and deep first\-principles understanding. It also takes wisdom to make the right trade offs combining product/domain expertise with engineering excellence.
 



  





**What you’ll be working on** 




 At the core, we are an engineering\-focused organization with heavy investments in pure functional programming techniques and distributed system architectures. We use Haskell for backend development, we have invested in one of the fastest real\-time data streaming technologies, we created our own polyglot database management system called DBMesh.
 



  





 We are establishing a team to upgrade our system architecture to scale to 10X our current volume and support the high\-reliability needs with a multi\-region DC Active\-Active architecture.
 



  





 Some of the current projects in our distributed systems team:
 


* Designing our architecture to work active\-active across DCs with intelligent SDK and gateway proxies to route traffic between them.
* Moving to an LSM engine based distributed DB that spans across datacenter regions
* Service mesh architecture that provides failover across Kubernetes clusters
* Event sourcing and Event\-mesh architecture to move all operations outside the critical path to a reliable async mechanism.
* A multi\-DC \+ client\-side distributed data caching system and ensuring strong eventual consistency.
* Automatic anomaly detection system with streaming data streams across varied systems
* Build unified SRE systems to manage multiple stacks across DCs and Banks.



  





**The Learning track** 




 Our teams are mostly built with freshers \- smart, vibrant, hardworking. We need a fast track learning process for them to understand the deep principles of distributed systems and also get accelerated hands\-on experiential learning
 



  





 Design from Scratch: Design from first principles a system that will support India’s scale and learn from Biology how to keep it healthy and hale! We are creating an internal school for distributed systems to fast track the first principles learning process.
 



  





 Make Production your Playground: Not just design but Play around with the systems esp. With modern Chaos testing approaches. Discover, fix, and ensure the system’s capability to withstand unexpected scenarios.
 



  





**Join the Team** 




 Our systems team has taken up this huge responsibility to concretize the vision to scale up to 300M txns/day. We are looking for deep systems thinkers and high problem\-solvers.
 



  





 System Builders: You think from first principles and understand/want to understand how things work deeply
 



  





 Chaos Engineers: What’s the best way to ensure that systems are resilient? Let’s bring them down!! (Check out chaos engineering @ Netflix)
 



  





 Responsible SREs: Can you be confident that the systems you designed and played around with will never go down??
 



  





 Do you resonate with any of the above? You may be just the right person for the team

 Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are seeking a passionate and driven Software Engineer II with strong expertise in Java, Angular, and AWS cloud services to join our high\-impact engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, test, and deploy scalable solutions for BHN, with a focus on high availability, precision, and performance.
   

  

 You will play a key role in evolving our hybrid architecture—modernizing legacy systems, enabling flexible validation flows, and integrating AI/ML capabilities into platform features. This position offers the opportunity to work across backend and frontend technologies, leverage LLMs and intelligent automation to accelerate development, contribute to architectural decisions, and push the boundaries of cloud\-native, AI\-augmented engineering.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Analyze requirements and produce high\-quality code for projects, taking ownership of individual modules from design through deployment.
* Use AI\-powered developer tools (code assistants, automated test generation, AI code review) to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality standards.
* Design event\-driven, cloud\-native microservices on AWS with automated failover, auto\-scaling, and AI\-driven observability (anomaly detection, predictive alerting, intelligent log analysis).
* Follow sound development practices, establish close collaboration with cross\-functional teams, and participate in biweekly support rotation. Design, develop, and unit test software applications, adapting and enhancing engineering processes and tools as needed.

* Demonstrate expertise in diagnosing complex issues, contribute to change management processes, and establish good engineering practices.
* Mentor team members on both traditional engineering patterns and emerging AI\-assisted development workflows, fostering a culture of continuous learning.
* Write clean, reusable code for readability and testability, ensuring products are performant, scalable, and fault\-tolerant.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and stakeholders to create and deliver exceptional product requirements, evolving the platform toward AI\-ready service boundaries.


**Qualifications:**
* 2\+ years of software development expertise, specializing in core Java, Spring Boot, and J2EE ecosystems.
* Possess advanced Java skills and demonstrate proficiency in Spring frameworks, along with the ability to develop multithreaded applications.
* Expertise in RESTful architecture, microservices design, and implementation of REST Web Services. Experience with event\-driven patterns (Kafka, SQS/SNS) preferred.
* Experience in database design using PostgreSQL, coupled with a strong grasp of SQL. Familiarity with NoSQL stores (DynamoDB, Redis) a plus.
* Exhibit robust Object\-Oriented design and development skills.
* Proficiency in Angular, React, and TypeScript with an understanding of modern component architectures.
* Hands\-on AWS experience—Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, CloudFormation or CDK, CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open\-source models)—prompt engineering, function calling, or fine\-tuning.
* Comfort using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) as part of daily development workflow.
* Showcase creative problem\-solving abilities and excellent communication skills.
* Preference given to those with experience in the finance or payment industry.


 Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

description:

 At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray, a popular open\-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.
   

  

 With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.
   

  

 Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250\+ million raised to date.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anyscale is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Infrastructure team. Anyscale aims to provide the next generation of tools and infrastructure to make developing and running distributed AI applications in the cloud as easy as on your laptop. As part of the Infra team, we build the scalable, secure, and robust backbone that enables this vision.
   

  

 Our team is responsible for both the control plane, which orchestrates cluster management, scheduling, and user access, and the data plane, which ensures high\-performance execution of distributed workloads.
   

  

 We are seeking a talented Software Engineer with a strong background in control plane and data plane development, along with expertise in Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud\-native infrastructure. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and optimizing the critical infrastructure that powers Anyscale’s cloud platform.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work on open\-source Ray, contribute to our infinite laptop proprietary product, and develop seamless integration between the two, while also delivering high\-impact features for our customers.
   

  

**A snapshot of projects you may work on**
* Design, build, and scale services that orchestrate Ray clusters across cloud and on\-prem environments, supporting both VM\-based and Kubernetes\-based deployments
* Optimize control plane components for large\-scale, distributed AI/ML workloads
* Build intelligent scheduling and resource management systems for heterogeneous compute clusters
* Develop features to enhance the reliability, performance, scalability, and observability of Anyscale\-managed Ray workloads
* Support and optimize accelerator integration (e.g., GPUs, TPUs).
* Handle container image management and dependency resolution for distributed workloads
* Participate in code reviews, design and architecture discussions
* Provide on\-call support, working closely with customer and field teams to troubleshoot infrastructure issues
* Collaborate with leading distributed systems and machine learning experts to push the boundaries of AI infrastructure


**We'd love to hear from you if have**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience writing high\-quality production code
* Hands\-on experience in building and maintaining highly available, scalable, and performant distributed system
* Expertise in cloud\-native technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes\-based deployments
* Deep understanding of networking, security, and authentication mechanisms in cloud environment
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana etc)
* Proficiency in Go and Python
* Knowledge of low\-level operating system foundations (Linux kernel, file systems, containers)

**Key Responsibilities**

**Job Category**
 Customer Success
   

  

**Job Details**
******About Salesforce******
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**About Salesforce
   

  

 Salesforce is the world's \#1 CRM platform, empowering companies of every size and industry to connect with their customers in a whole new way. We believe in doing business as the greatest platform for change — and that starts with our people. At Salesforce, we're committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.**
**About The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented Associate Technical Support Engineer – Proactive Monitoring to join our growing Technical Support Engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring platform health and customer success by proactively identifying, analyzing, and addressing potential issues before they impact our customers.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about technology, loves solving complex problems, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 The ProM team runs 24x7x365 .
   

  

 Candidates must be flexible to work on different Shifts including APAC/EMEA/AMER hours as and when required. Must be available to work on a few weekends and Holidays as part of the business need.**
**What You'll Do
   

  

 Proactive Monitoring: Continuously monitor Salesforce platform health dashboards, alerts, and telemetry signals to detect anomalies and potential issues before they escalate into customer\-impacting incidents.
   

  

 Incident Detection \& Triage: Analyze monitoring alerts, log data, and system metrics to identify root causes and escalate findings to the appropriate engineering or operations teams.
   

  

 Customer\-Centric Outreach: Proactively engage with customers affected by identified issues, providing timely communication and resolution guidance to minimize disruption.
   

  

 Case Management: Create, manage, and resolve support cases with thorough documentation of findings, actions taken, and resolutions.
   

  

 Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Operations, and senior Technical Support Engineers to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Knowledge Base Contribution: Document troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and best practices to enhance the team's collective knowledge and improve future response times.
   

  

 Tooling \& Automation: Leverage internal monitoring tools, dashboards, and scripting to streamline alert management and reduce manual effort.
   

  

 Trend Analysis: Identify recurring patterns or systemic issues from monitoring data and escalate insights to engineering teams for long\-term fixes.**
**What We're Looking For
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
   

  

 6–24 months of experience in technical support, IT operations, systems monitoring, or a related role.
   

  

 Solid understanding of cloud computing concepts, SaaS platforms, and web technologies (HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, DNS, SSL/TLS).
   

  

 Basic familiarity with monitoring tools and concepts (e.g., log analysis, alerting, dashboards).
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguous situations.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable communicating technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 A genuine passion for customer success and a customer\-first mindset.
   

  

 Salesforce Admin Experience: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Administration — including user management, profiles, roles, permission sets, flows, validation rules, and basic configuration of Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
   

  

 Salesforce Developer Experience: Working knowledge of Salesforce development fundamentals — including Apex (triggers, classes), Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL queries, and basic understanding of the Salesforce data model and deployment processes (Change Sets / Salesforce DX).
   

  

 Ability to read and interpret debug logs, error messages, and system exceptions within the Salesforce platform to assist in root cause analysis and proactive issue identification.**
**Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 Familiarity with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform, etc.) or prior experience using/supporting CRM platforms.
   

  

 Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
   

  

 Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar).
   

  

 Understanding of ITIL frameworks or incident management best practices.
   

  

 Salesforce Administrator or Developer certification is a plus.
   

  

 Experience working in an Agile or DevOps environment.**
 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

title: Site Reliability Engineer/Cloud Platform Engineer - Operations (PST Timezone)
description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems.
   

  

 Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.
   

  

 Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019\. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com or follow on X and LinkedIn.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help build and run the infrastructure that powers a multi\-tenant, security\-sensitive B2B cloud product used by enterprise customers around the world. Our platform spans multi\-tenant environments and single\-tenant (BYOC) deployments into customer cloud accounts, so the bar for automation, consistency, and reliability is high — every environment needs to be provisioned, upgraded, monitored, and recovered the same way, at scale, with minimal manual intervention.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a ticket\-queue ops role. You'll spend most of your time writing Go and Python to turn repeatable infrastructure work into platform capabilities — provisioning pipelines, internal CLIs, self\-service tooling, and automation that lets the rest of engineering ship without waiting on infrastructure as a bottleneck. You'll also carry deep operational ownership: on\-call, incident response, and root\-cause analysis on the systems you build.
   

  

**You Have**
* 4\+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with real ownership of production cloud infrastructure.
* Strong software engineering skills in Go and/or Python — you write tested, maintainable code and think of infrastructure automation as software, not scripting.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Kubernetes in production (workload scheduling, networking, autoscaling, upgrades) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tooling such as Terraform, Pulumi, or OpenTofu.
* Solid experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS or GCP or Azure); experience operating in all the three is a strong plus given our multi\-cloud footprint.
* Track record of building tools or platforms that other engineers use — internal CLIs, provisioning frameworks, self\-service portals, or automation pipelines — not just maintaining existing infrastructure.
* Comfort operating in a B2B environment with enterprise customers, where infrastructure changes carry compliance, security, and contractual weight (e.g. dedicated/BYOC deployments, uptime SLAs, audit requirements).
* Strong incident\-response instincts: you can debug distributed systems under pressure, drive a root\-cause analysis to a real fix, and communicate clearly during and after an incident.
* A bias toward root\-causing and automating away recurring problems over repeatedly firefighting the same issue.


**You Will**
* Provide operational support aligned with US time zones, ensuring system reliability and availability.
* Design and build automation that provisions and manages cloud infrastructure end\-to\-end — new environment onboarding, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning — across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP) and multiple deployment models (multi\-tenant and dedicated/BYOC).
* Write production\-grade Go and Python services and CLIs that turn infrastructure operations into self\-service platform capabilities for other engineering teams, rather than one\-off scripts or manual runbooks.
* Own and evolve the Infrastructure\-as\-Code stack (Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD) that defines every environment, and drive migrations across the fleet (Kubernetes version upgrades, node pool migrations, service mesh changes) with minimal customer impact.
* Operate and scale core platform services — Kubernetes clusters, service mesh (Istio), data stores (Aerospike, PostgreSQL), messaging (Kafka), and GPU\-backed inference workloads — with a focus on capacity planning, cost efficiency, and right\-sizing.
* Build and improve observability and alerting (metrics, logs, synthetic monitoring) so that failures are caught before customers notice, and drive the automation that turns repeat incidents into permanent fixes.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation, lead incident response for the systems you own, and write root\-cause analyses that result in concrete corrective action — not just documentation.
* Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to build guardrails (secrets management, access control, network policy, audit logging) directly into the platform, so secure\-by\-default is the path of least resistance for every team.
* Continuously identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone infrastructure work and eliminate it — the measure of success in this role is less manual toil across the org, not more tickets closed.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with service mesh (Istio/Envoy), GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), or policy\-as\-code (OPA).
* Experience operating stateful systems in production — distributed databases (Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Cassandra), message queues (Kafka), or GPU\-backed inference workloads.
* Experience with security\-sensitive or regulated environments (PCI, SOC 2, HIPAA) and building compliance controls into infrastructure by default.
* Experience with cost optimization and capacity planning at fleet scale (right\-sizing, autoscaling policy design, spot/preemptible usage).
* Contributions to open\-source infrastructure tooling, or experience building an internal developer platform (IDP).


**Our stack (roughly)**
 Go, Python
   

  

* Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD
* Terraform/OpenTofu
* AWS, GCP
* Istio
* Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Kafka
* Coralogix/Prometheus\-style observability
* GitHub Actions and Spacelift\-style CI/CD for infrastructure changes.


**Benefits**
* Work from home expense
* Excellent Health Insurance Options
* Very generous PTO
* Flexible Hours
* Generous Equity


 At Skyflow, we believe that diverse teams are the strongest teams. We invite applicants of all genders, races, ethnicities, nationalities, ages, religions, sexual orientations, disability statuses, educational experiences, family situations, and socio\-economic backgrounds.

title: Smart Factory IoT Security Engineer
description:
Our solutions are a key part of most industries \- electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more. Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations.
   

  

**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**
**Your role**
 As Smart Factory Security Engineer, you own the security of every solution onboarded into VTBA's Smart Factory and Industry 4\.0 landscape. You act as the security gatekeeper and technical authority for new OT/IIoT systems, connected production equipment, and digital manufacturing solutions from the moment they are evaluated until they are fully integrated and running in production. You embed security by design into every onboarding: assessing risk, defining and enforcing hardening and segmentation requirements, validating secure architectures, and ensuring new systems comply with IEC 62443, NIS2, and internal security policy before and after go\-live. You maintain an up\-to\-date OT/IIoT security posture and asset inventory (CMDB), act as the first point of contact for the business on security matters, and ensure that production processes are never compromised by unsecured or unmanaged systems.You support M\&A and integration due diligence from a security standpoint, securing previously unregistered or newly acquired systems, and you collaborate closely with IT, network, production, and external integration partners to guarantee a seamless and secure Industry 4\.0 rollout. In case of a security incident or outage tied to onboarded solutions, you drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures.
   

  

* Develop the Smart Factory cybersecurity strategy aligned with business and security objectives.
* Design secure architectures for manufacturing systems, Industrial IoT (IIoT), MES, and OT networks
* Own the security review and validation of all new OT/IIoT solutions being onboarded onto Smart Factory / production networks, from design through go\-live.
* Define and enforce security\-by\-design requirements (segmentation, hardening, access control, secure remote access) for new production lines, machines, and digital solutions.
* Be the first point of contact and internal security consultant for production engineers, IT teams, and solution vendors during onboarding projects.
* Maintain a secure and stable OT/IIoT environment for VTBA, including an accurate, continuously updated OT security asset inventory (CMDB).
* Support Smart Factory projects involving IoT, AI, cloud connectivity, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing platforms.
* Define and maintain OT asset inventories, security baselines, and lifecycle management processes.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing of industrial systems.
* Act as the security contact for external production and integration partners, reviewing and validating the security quality of their work before systems connect to company networks.
* Drive compliance with IEC 62443, NIS2, ANSSI\-aligned practices, and internal IT/OT security regulations across all onboarded solutions.
* Support M\&A and acquisition due diligence, assessing and securing newly acquired or previously unregistered OT/IIoT systems.
* Perform regular on\-call duty for security\-related escalations on onboarded solutions


**To Succeed You Will Need**
* 2\+ years' experience securing OT/IIoT or Industry 4\.0 environments
* Solid knowledge of IEC 62443 and familiarity with NIS2 and other relevant OT/ICS cybersecurity frameworks.
* Strong understanding of network segmentation, secure remote access, and hardening practices for industrial and IIoT systems.
* Customer Service Skills (interaction with end users and solution vendors).

description:

**Service line \- Position Title: TC\_CS\_Cyber Architecture, OT \& Engineering\_GCP\_Cloud Security\_\&\_DevSecOps\_Staff**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer to implement and optimize of cloud security tooling and governance across multi\-cloud environments. This role sits at the intersection of cloud security engineering, policy\-as\-code, and DevSecOps, driving measurable improvements in cloud risk posture and compliance maturity.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Implementation and optimization of cloud native security automation and engineering initiatives with Google Cloud and other tools/technologies to secure cloud\-native applications across containers, serverless environments, and virtual machines (VMs).
* Design secure cloud architectures and embed security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and enforce policies for secure cloud\-native deployments.
* Drive security automation and DevSecOps maturity across teams.
* Create dashboards and reports for executive visibility into cloud risk posture.
* Ensure alignment with industry standards and regulatory requirements.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Intermediate level knowledge of cloud security tools and multi\-cloud environments.
* proficiency in Python and Terraform for automation and IaC with Google cloud platform.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills across cross\-functional teams.
* Sound understanding of cloud\-native security, container security, and serverless protection.


**What We Look For**
* Minimum 2\-3 years of Cloud technology.
* Sound understanding of secured CI/CD implementation processes, advance techniques and integration knowledge.
* Good to have 1\+ years of hands\-on experience with one more CSPM tools (Prisma/Orca Security/Wiz/Defender) and implementation with Google cloud platforms to enable policy as code and other security initiatives.
* 1\+ years of Python development for automation.
* 1\+ years of Terraform experience for secured cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* 2\-3 years in cloud security and multi\-cloud governance with priority in GCP cloud.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)

**Mathura**
